        self.spi_tree.column("latency", width=120, anchor="center")
        self.spi_tree.column("speedup", width=110, anchor="center")
        self.spi_tree.column("errors", width=100, anchor="center")
        self.spi_tree.column("mag_faults", width=100, anchor="center")
        self.spi_tree.column("rate", width=100, anchor="center")
        self.spi_tree.column("status", width=140, anchor="center")
        self.spi_tree.pack(fill="x", pady=2)

    def _create_card(self, parent, title, init_val, color, row, col):
        card = ttk.Frame(parent, style="Card.TFrame", padding="8 6 8 6")
        card.grid(row=row, column=col, sticky="nsew", padx=3, pady=3)
        parent.columnconfigure(col, weight=1)

        ttk.Label(card, text=title, style="CardTitle.TLabel").pack(anchor="w")
        val_lbl = tk.Label(card, text=init_val, font=("Segoe UI", 13, "bold"), fg=color, bg="#1A2230")
        val_lbl.pack(anchor="w", pady=(2, 0))
        return val_lbl

    def _create_btn(self, parent, text, cmd, color, row, col):
        fg_col = "#000000" if color in ["#00E676", "#00E5FF", "#FFD600", "#FF9100", "#64FFDA"] else "#FFFFFF"
        b = tk.Button(parent, text=text, font=("Segoe UI", 8, "bold"), bg=color, fg=fg_col,
                      activebackground="#ECEFF1", relief="flat", padx=4, pady=4,
                      command=lambda: self._handle_btn(cmd))
        b.grid(row=row, column=col, sticky="nsew", padx=2, pady=2)
        parent.columnconfigure(col, weight=1)
        return b

    def _toggle_autoscroll(self):
        self.autoscroll_enabled = not self.autoscroll_enabled
        self.btn_autoscroll.config(
            text="Resume Scroll" if not self.autoscroll_enabled else "Pause Scroll",
            bg="#FF9100" if not self.autoscroll_enabled else "#37474F"
        )

    def _clear_log(self):
        self.log_text.delete("1.0", "end")

    def _send_custom_cmd(self):
        cmd = self.cmd_entry.get().strip()
        if cmd:
            self.reader.send_cmd(cmd)
            self.cmd_entry.delete(0, "end")

    def _set_speed_preset(self, speed_rpm):
        self.entry_target.delete(0, "end")
        self.entry_target.insert(0, str(float(speed_rpm)))
        self._set_param("t", str(float(speed_rpm)))

    def _nudge_target_rpm(self, delta):
        try:
            curr = float(self.entry_target.get().strip())
        except Exception:
            with self.reader.lock:
                curr = self.reader.last_target_rpm
        new_rpm = max(-1432.0, min(1432.0, curr + delta))
        self.entry_target.delete(0, "end")
        self.entry_target.insert(0, f"{new_rpm:.1f}")
        self._set_param("t", f"{new_rpm:.1f}")

    def _reset_gm3506_defaults(self):
        self.entry_ramp.delete(0, "end"); self.entry_ramp.insert(0, "200.0")
        self.entry_v.delete(0, "end"); self.entry_v.insert(0, "6.93")
        self.entry_max_rpm.delete(0, "end"); self.entry_max_rpm.insert(0, "1432.0")
        self.entry_p.delete(0, "end"); self.entry_p.insert(0, "0.12")
        self.entry_i.delete(0, "end"); self.entry_i.insert(0, "1.20")
        self.entry_d.delete(0, "end"); self.entry_d.insert(0, "0.000")
        self.entry_f.delete(0, "end"); self.entry_f.insert(0, "0.005")
        self.entry_lag.delete(0, "end"); self.entry_lag.insert(0, "35.0")
        self.entry_kv.delete(0, "end"); self.entry_kv.insert(0, "122.1")
        self.entry_target.delete(0, "end"); self.entry_target.insert(0, "0.0")

        self.reader.send_cmd("a200.0")
        self.reader.send_cmd("l6.93")
        self.reader.send_cmd("m1432.0")
        self.reader.send_cmd("p0.12")
        self.reader.send_cmd("i1.20")
        self.reader.send_cmd("d0.000")
        self.reader.send_cmd("f0.005")
        self.reader.send_cmd("s35.0")
        self.reader.send_cmd("q171.9")
        self.reader.send_cmd("t0.0")

    def _apply_benchmark_preset(self, target_res):
        self.entry_p.delete(0, "end"); self.entry_p.insert(0, str(target_res['p']))
        self.entry_i.delete(0, "end"); self.entry_i.insert(0, str(target_res['i']))
        self.entry_d.delete(0, "end"); self.entry_d.insert(0, str(target_res['d']))
        self.entry_f.delete(0, "end"); self.entry_f.insert(0, str(target_res['tf']))

        self._set_param("p", str(target_res['p']))
        self._set_param("i", str(target_res['i']))
        self._set_param("d", str(target_res['d']))
        self._set_param("f", str(target_res['tf']))

    def _set_param(self, prefix, val_str):
        try:
            val = float(val_str.strip())
            cmd = f"{prefix}{val}"
            self.reader.send_cmd(cmd)
        except ValueError:
            messagebox.showwarning("Input Error", f"Invalid numeric value: '{val_str}'")

    def emergency_stop(self):
        """Universal Emergency Stop: Immediately terminates all worker threads, aborts sweeps, and disables inverter."""
        self.calibrator.abort()
        self.symmetry_equalizer.abort()
        self.benchmarker.abort()

        try:
            self.btn_master_calib.config(text="🚀 1-CLICK MASTER AUTO-CALIBRATE (MULTI-METHOD)", bg="#00E676", fg="#000")
            self.btn_auto_sym.config(text="🚀 1-CLICK AUTO-EQUALIZE SYMMETRY", bg="#00E676", fg="#000")
            self.btn_benchmark.config(text="🧬 5-Min GA Auto-Tuner", bg="#00E676", fg="#000", state="normal")
            if hasattr(self, 'btn_sweep'):
                self.btn_sweep.config(text="🧪 18-Stage Sweep", bg="#00E5FF", fg="#000", state="normal")
            self.btn_run_kv.config(text="🚀 START 18-Stage KV Sweep (k)", bg="#00E676", fg="#000")
        except Exception:
            pass

        self.kv_status_var.set("🛑 EMERGENCY STOP: KV test stopped.")
        self.reader.send_emergency_stop()

    def _on_space_pressed(self, event):
        widget = event.widget
        if isinstance(widget, (tk.Entry, ttk.Entry, tk.Text)):
            return
        self.emergency_stop()

    def _handle_btn(self, cmd):
        if cmd == "x" or cmd == "X":
            self.emergency_stop()
        elif cmd == "+":
            self._nudge_target_rpm(+10.0)
        elif cmd == "-":
            self._nudge_target_rpm(-10.0)
        elif cmd == "FLASH":
            self._flash_firmware()
        elif cmd == "SAVE_JSON":
            self._export_config_dialog()
        elif cmd == "LOAD_JSON":
            self._upload_config_dialog()
        else:
            self.reader.send_cmd(cmd)

    def _export_config_dialog(self):
        filename = filedialog.asksaveasfilename(
            title="Save Calibration Profile JSON",
            defaultextension=".json",
            filetypes=[("JSON Files", "*.json"), ("All Files", "*.*")],
            initialfile="motor_config_gm3506.json"
        )
        if not filename:
            return

        with self.reader.lock:
            detected_dir = getattr(self.reader, 'last_sensor_direction', -1)
        try:
            lag_val = float(self.entry_lag.get().strip() or "35.0")
        except ValueError:
            lag_val = 35.0

        cfg = {
            "zero_electric_angle": self.symmetry_equalizer.current_zero_angle_rad,
            "sensor_direction": detected_dir,
            "sensor_lag_comp_us": lag_val,
            "motor_kv_rating": float(self.entry_kv.get().strip() or "123.0"),
            "pid_p": float(self.entry_p.get().strip() or "0.15"),
            "pid_i": float(self.entry_i.get().strip() or "1.50"),
            "pid_d": float(self.entry_d.get().strip() or "0.00"),
            "lpf_tf": float(self.entry_f.get().strip() or "0.002"),
            "date": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
        }
        try:
            with open(filename, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                json.dump(cfg, f, indent=2)
            messagebox.showinfo("Config Saved", f"Profile successfully saved to:\n{filename}")
        except Exception as e:
            messagebox.showerror("Save Error", f"Failed to save file:\n{str(e)}")

    def _upload_config_dialog(self):
        filename = filedialog.askopenfilename(
            title="Load Calibration Profile JSON",
            filetypes=[("JSON Files", "*.json"), ("All Files", "*.*")]
        )
        if not filename:
            return
        try:
            with open(filename, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                cfg = json.load(f)

            if "zero_electric_angle" in cfg:
                ang = float(cfg["zero_electric_angle"])
                self._on_zero_angle_updated(ang)
                self.reader.send_cmd(f"j{ang:.5f}")
                time.sleep(0.05)

            if "pid_p" in cfg:
                self.entry_p.delete(0, "end"); self.entry_p.insert(0, str(cfg["pid_p"]))
                self.reader.send_cmd(f"p{cfg['pid_p']}")
                time.sleep(0.05)
            if "pid_i" in cfg:
                self.entry_i.delete(0, "end"); self.entry_i.insert(0, str(cfg["pid_i"]))
                self.reader.send_cmd(f"i{cfg['pid_i']}")
                time.sleep(0.05)
            if "pid_d" in cfg:
                self.entry_d.delete(0, "end"); self.entry_d.insert(0, str(cfg["pid_d"]))
                self.reader.send_cmd(f"d{cfg['pid_d']}")
                time.sleep(0.05)
            if "lpf_tf" in cfg:
                self.entry_f.delete(0, "end"); self.entry_f.insert(0, str(cfg["lpf_tf"]))
                self.reader.send_cmd(f"f{cfg['lpf_tf']}")
                time.sleep(0.05)
            if "sensor_lag_comp_us" in cfg:
                self.entry_lag.delete(0, "end"); self.entry_lag.insert(0, str(cfg["sensor_lag_comp_us"]))
                self.reader.send_cmd(f"s{cfg['sensor_lag_comp_us']}")
                time.sleep(0.05)
            if "motor_kv_rating" in cfg:
                self.entry_kv.delete(0, "end"); self.entry_kv.insert(0, str(cfg["motor_kv_rating"]))
                self.reader.send_cmd(f"q{cfg['motor_kv_rating']}")

            messagebox.showinfo("Config Uploaded", f"Profile loaded and applied to motor controller:\n{filename}")
        except Exception as e:
            messagebox.showerror("Upload Error", f"Failed to load profile:\n{str(e)}")

    def _flash_firmware(self):
        ans = messagebox.askyesno("Flash ESP32-S3", "Upload firmware to ESP32-S3 (esp32s3_suite)?\n(ESP32-S3 should be connected in DFU / Boot mode)")
        if not ans:
            return
        self.reader.disconnect()
        self.conn_label.config(text="FLASHING...", fg="#FFD600")
        self.root.update()

        def do_flash():
            pio_exe = find_pio_executable()
            workspace_root = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "..", ".."))
            cmd = [pio_exe, "run", "-e", "esp32s3_suite", "-t", "upload"]
            try:
                res = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=workspace_root)
                if res.returncode == 0:
                    self.root.after(0, lambda: messagebox.showinfo("Flash Success", "ESP32-S3 firmware (esp32s3_suite) flashed successfully!"))
                else:
                    err_msg = res.stderr.strip() or res.stdout.strip()
                    self.root.after(0, lambda: messagebox.showerror("Flash Error", f"Upload failed:\n{err_msg[-500:]}"))
            except Exception as e:
                self.root.after(0, lambda: messagebox.showerror("Flash Error", f"Execution error: {str(e)}"))
            self.root.after(0, lambda: self._toggle_connect(force_connect=True))

        threading.Thread(target=do_flash, daemon=True).start()

    def _toggle_connect(self, force_connect=False):
        if self.reader.running and not force_connect:
            self.reader.disconnect()
            self.conn_label.config(text="DISCONNECTED", fg="#FF5252")
            self.btn_connect.config(text="Connect", bg="#00E5FF")
        else:
            self.reader.port = self.port_entry.get().strip()
            try:
                self.reader.connect()
                self.conn_label.config(text=f"ONLINE ({self.reader.port}) @ {self.reader.baud}", fg="#69F0AE")
                self.btn_connect.config(text="Disconnect", bg="#FF5252")
            except Exception as e:
                messagebox.showerror("Connection Error", f"Failed to open {self.reader.port}:\n{str(e)}")

    def _schedule_update(self):
        try:
            self._update_telemetry()
        except Exception:
            pass
        self.root.after(30, self._schedule_update)

    def _update_telemetry(self):
        lines_to_add = []
        while not self.reader.raw_log_queue.empty():
            try:
                line = self.reader.raw_log_queue.get_nowait()
                lines_to_add.append(line)
            except Exception:
                break

        if lines_to_add:
            text_block = "\n".join(lines_to_add) + "\n"
            self.log_text.insert("end", text_block)
            line_count = int(self.log_text.index("end-1c").split(".")[0])
            if line_count > 300:
                self.log_text.delete("1.0", f"{line_count - 250}.0")
            if self.autoscroll_enabled:
                self.log_text.see("end")

        with self.reader.lock:
            deg = self.reader.last_angle_deg
            rad = self.reader.last_angle_rad
            raw = self.reader.last_raw_14bit
            tgt = self.reader.last_target_rpm
            act = self.reader.last_actual_rpm
            mode = self.reader.last_control_mode
            bus = self.reader.last_bus_mode
            mag_ok = self.reader.last_mag_ok
            parity_ok = self.reader.last_parity_ok
            stall = self.reader.last_stall_alarm
            kv_active = self.reader.kv_test_active
            kv_pts = list(self.reader.kv_points)
            kv_res = dict(self.reader.kv_results)

        self.card_angle.config(text=f"{deg:.2f}°  ({rad:.3f} rad)")
        self.card_target_rpm.config(text=f"{tgt:+.1f} RPM")
        self.card_actual_rpm.config(text=f"{act:+.1f} RPM")
        self.card_raw.config(text=f"{raw} / 16383  ({(raw / 16384.0)*100:.1f}%)")

        if "KV-TEST" in mode or kv_active:
            self.lbl_mode.config(text="CTRL: KV SWEEP TEST", bg="#FF6D00", fg="#FFF")
        elif "CLOSE" in mode or "FOC" in mode:
            self.lbl_mode.config(text="CTRL: CLOSED-LOOP FOC", bg="#7C4DFF", fg="#FFF")
        elif "OPEN" in mode:
            self.lbl_mode.config(text="CTRL: OPEN-LOOP", bg="#00E5FF", fg="#000")
        elif "VOLT" in mode:
            self.lbl_mode.config(text="CTRL: CLOSED-LOOP VOLT", bg="#FFAB00", fg="#000")
        elif "ENABLE" in mode:
            self.lbl_mode.config(text="CTRL: ENABLED", bg="#00E676", fg="#000")
        else:
            self.lbl_mode.config(text="CTRL: DISABLED / STOP", bg="#455A64", fg="#FFF")

        self.lbl_bus.config(text=f"BUS: {bus.upper()}", bg="#0288D1" if bus == "4-Wire" else "#E65100", fg="#FFF")

        with self.reader.lock:
            lut_is_active = self.reader.last_lut_active
        if lut_is_active:
            self.lbl_lut.config(text="LUT: 128-PT [ACTIVE]", bg="#7C4DFF", fg="#FFFFFF")
        else:
            self.lbl_lut.config(text="LUT: RAW", bg="#455A64", fg="#B0BEC5")

        if mag_ok:
            self.lbl_mag.config(text="MAGNET: OK", bg="#69F0AE", fg="#1A2230")
        else:
            self.lbl_mag.config(text="MAGNET: FAULT", bg="#FF5252", fg="#FFFFFF")

        if parity_ok:
            self.lbl_parity.config(text="PARITY: PASS", bg="#69F0AE", fg="#1A2230")
        else:
            self.lbl_parity.config(text="PARITY: NOISE", bg="#FF5252", fg="#FFFFFF")

        if stall:
            self.lbl_stall.config(text="🚨 STALL SHUTDOWN!", bg="#D50000", fg="#FFFFFF")
        else:
            self.lbl_stall.config(text="STALL GUARD: OK", bg="#455A64", fg="#B0BEC5")

        with self.reader.lock:
            foc_khz = getattr(self.reader, "last_foc_khz", 0.0)
            lat_avg = getattr(self.reader, "last_lat_avg_us", 0.0)
            lat_max = getattr(self.reader, "last_lat_max_us", 0.0)
            spk_cnt = getattr(self.reader, "last_spikes_count", 0)

        if foc_khz > 0.0:
            self.lbl_foc.config(text=f"FOC: {foc_khz:.1f} kHz", bg="#00E676" if foc_khz >= 5.0 else "#FFD600", fg="#000000")
        else:
            self.lbl_foc.config(text="FOC: -- kHz", bg="#1B5E20", fg="#69F0AE")

        if lat_avg > 0.0:
            if spk_cnt == 0:
                self.lbl_lat.config(text=f"LAT: {lat_avg:.0f}/{lat_max:.0f} µs", bg="#00897B", fg="#FFFFFF")
            else:
                self.lbl_lat.config(text=f"LAT: {lat_avg:.0f}/{lat_max:.0f} µs | 🚨 {spk_cnt} SPK", bg="#D50000", fg="#FFFFFF")
        else:
            self.lbl_lat.config(text="LAT: -- µs", bg="#263238", fg="#B0BEC5")

        if self.reader.connected:
            self.conn_label.config(text=f"ONLINE ({self.reader.port})", fg="#69F0AE")
            self.btn_connect.config(text="Disconnect", bg="#FF5252")
        else:
            self.conn_label.config(text="RECONNECTING...", fg="#FFD600")

        # Sync Auto-Calibration UI elements
        with self.reader.lock:
            c_prog = self.reader.calib_progress_pct
            c_stage = self.reader.calib_stage_name
            c_active = self.reader.calibrating
            c_grade = self.reader.last_calib_grade

        if not self.calibrator.running and c_active:
            if c_prog > 0:
                self.calib_progress_var.set(c_prog)
            if c_stage:
                self.calib_status_var.set(c_stage)

        if c_grade:
            self.calib_grade_var.set(c_grade)
            if "GRADE A" in c_grade:
                grade_col = "#00E676"
            elif "GRADE B" in c_grade:
                grade_col = "#69F0AE"
            elif "GRADE C" in c_grade or "CERTIFIED" in c_grade:
                grade_col = "#00E5FF"
            elif "GRADE D" in c_grade:
                grade_col = "#FFD600"
            elif "GRADE E" in c_grade:
                grade_col = "#FF9100"
            else:
                grade_col = "#FF5252"
            self.lbl_calib_grade_badge.config(fg=grade_col)
        elif lut_is_active:
            self.calib_grade_var.set("128-PT LUT ACTIVE")
            self.lbl_calib_grade_badge.config(fg="#69F0AE")

        cards = {
            "kv_true": self.card_kv_true,
            "kv_r2": self.card_kv_r2,
            "kv_v0": self.card_kv_v0,
            "kv_ke": self.card_kv_ke,
            "kv_kt": self.card_kv_kt,
            "kv_sym": self.card_kv_sym,
            "kv_max_rpm": self.card_kv_max_rpm,
            "kv_code": self.card_kv_code,
            "lbl_r2_tag": self.lbl_kv_r2_tag
        }
        self.kv_analyzer.update_table_and_metrics(self.kv_tree, kv_pts, kv_res, kv_active, self.btn_run_kv, cards)
        self._update_symmetry_tab()
        self._update_harmonic_tab()
        draw_gauge(self.gauge_canvas, deg)
        draw_chart(self.chart_canvas, self.reader)
        draw_kv_scatter_plot(self.kv_canvas, kv_pts, kv_res)
        draw_symmetry_needle(self.sym_canvas, self.symmetry_equalizer.fwd_rpm, self.symmetry_equalizer.rev_rpm)

    def _update_symmetry_tab(self):
        with self.reader.lock:
            act_rpm = self.reader.last_actual_rpm
            target_uq = self.reader.last_uq

        self.card_sym_live_rpm.config(text=f"{act_rpm:+.1f} RPM")
        self.card_sym_live_uq.config(text=f"{target_uq:+.2f} V")

        fwd = self.symmetry_equalizer.fwd_rpm
        rev = self.symmetry_equalizer.rev_rpm
        delta = fwd - rev
        max_v = max(fwd, rev, 1.0)
        sym_pct = (min(fwd, rev) / max_v) * 100.0 if (fwd > 10 and rev > 10) else (100.0 if fwd == 0 and rev == 0 else 0.0)

        try:
            v_test = abs(float(self.entry_sym_v.get().strip()))
        except Exception:
            v_test = 4.0

        mean_rpm = (fwd + rev) * 0.5
        equalized_kv = mean_rpm / max(0.1, v_test) if mean_rpm > 10 else 0.0
        ke = 1.0 / (equalized_kv * (2.0 * math.pi / 60.0)) if equalized_kv > 1.0 else 0.0

        self.card_sym_fwd.config(text=f"{fwd:+.1f} RPM")
        self.card_sym_rev.config(text=f"-{rev:.1f} RPM")
        self.card_sym_delta.config(text=f"{delta:+.1f} RPM")
        self.card_sym_pct.config(text=f"{sym_pct:.1f} %")
        self.card_sym_kv.config(text=f"{equalized_kv:.1f} RPM/V")
        self.card_sym_ke.config(text=f"{ke:.4f} V·s/rad")

    def _update_harmonic_tab(self):
        with self.reader.lock:
            coeffs = dict(getattr(self.reader, 'harmonic_coeffs', {}))
            pts = list(getattr(self.reader, 'harmonic_bin_points', []))
            bench_res = dict(getattr(self.reader, 'bench_compare_results', {}))
            lut_mode = getattr(self.reader, 'last_lut_mode', -1)

        # Sync radio button if firmware reported mode
        if lut_mode in [0, 1, 2] and self.sensor_mode_var.get() != lut_mode:
            self.sensor_mode_var.set(lut_mode)

        # Update diagnostic cards
        if coeffs:
            a1 = coeffs.get("A1", 0.0); b1 = coeffs.get("B1", 0.0); h1 = coeffs.get("H1", math.hypot(a1, b1) * 57.2957795)
            a2 = coeffs.get("A2", 0.0); b2 = coeffs.get("B2", 0.0); h2 = coeffs.get("H2", math.hypot(a2, b2) * 57.2957795)
            a3 = coeffs.get("A3", 0.0); b3 = coeffs.get("B3", 0.0); h3 = coeffs.get("H3", math.hypot(a3, b3) * 57.2957795)
            a4 = coeffs.get("A4", 0.0); b4 = coeffs.get("B4", 0.0); h4 = coeffs.get("H4", math.hypot(a4, b4) * 57.2957795)

            phi1 = coeffs.get("Phi1", math.degrees(math.atan2(b1, a1)) % 360.0)
            phi2 = coeffs.get("Phi2", math.degrees(math.atan2(b2, a2)) % 360.0)
            phi3 = coeffs.get("Phi3", math.degrees(math.atan2(b3, a3)) % 360.0)
            phi4 = coeffs.get("Phi4", math.degrees(math.atan2(b4, a4)) % 360.0)

            r2 = coeffs.get("R2", 0.0)
            pk_pk = coeffs.get("PkPk", 0.0)
            rms = coeffs.get("RMS", 0.0)
            res_pk = coeffs.get("ResPkPk", 0.0)
            res_rms = coeffs.get("ResRMS", 0.0)
            lag_m = coeffs.get("LagMean", 0.0)
            lag_rip = coeffs.get("LagRipple", 0.0)
            lag_ang = coeffs.get("LagPeakAng", 0.0)

            apex1 = phi1
            apex2 = (phi2 * 0.5) % 360.0
            apex3 = (phi3 / 3.0) % 360.0
            apex4 = (phi4 * 0.25) % 360.0

            self.lbl_h1_val.config(text=f"±{h1:.4f}° mech")
            self.lbl_h1_desc.config(text=f"Apex at {apex1:.1f}° | A1={a1:+.4f}, B1={b1:+.4f}")
            self.lbl_h1_status.config(text=f"Runout: ±{(h1*1000):.1f} mdeg (φ={phi1:.1f}°)", fg="#69F0AE")

            self.lbl_h2_val.config(text=f"±{h2:.4f}° mech")
            self.lbl_h2_desc.config(text=f"Tilt Axis at {apex2:.1f}° & {(apex2+180)%360:.1f}°")
            self.lbl_h2_status.config(text=f"Tilt: ±{(h2*1000):.1f} mdeg (φ={phi2:.1f}°)", fg="#69F0AE")

            self.lbl_h3_val.config(text=f"±{h3:.4f}° mech")
            self.lbl_h3_desc.config(text=f"Pinch Apex at {apex3:.1f}° mech (every 120°)")
            if h1 > 0.02 and (h3 / h1) > 0.20:
                self.lbl_h3_status.config(text=f"⚠️ PINCH ALERT! ({h3/h1*100:.1f}% H1 at {apex3:.1f}°)", fg="#FF5252")
            else:
                pct = (h3 / h1 * 100.0) if h1 > 0.001 else 0.0
                self.lbl_h3_status.config(text=f"✅ CHASSIS PASS ({pct:.1f}% H1)", fg="#69F0AE")

            self.lbl_h4_val.config(text=f"±{h4:.4f}° mech")
            self.lbl_h4_desc.config(text=f"Mismatch Axis at {apex4:.1f}° (every 90°)")
            if h1 > 0.02 and (h4 / h1) > 0.25:
                self.lbl_h4_status.config(text=f"⚠️ FLUX SAT / BRIDGE! ({h4/h1*100:.1f}% H1)", fg="#FF5252")
            else:
                pct = (h4 / h1 * 100.0) if h1 > 0.001 else 0.0
                self.lbl_h4_status.config(text=f"✅ FLUX PASS ({pct:.1f}% H1)", fg="#69F0AE")

            # Secondary Quality & Dynamic Cards Update
            self.lbl_r2_val.config(text=f"{r2*100.0:.2f} %")
            if r2 >= 0.90:
                self.lbl_r2_status.config(text="✅ EXCELLENT (>90% fit)", fg="#69F0AE")
            elif r2 >= 0.75:
                self.lbl_r2_status.config(text="ℹ️ MODERATE (75-90%)", fg="#FFD600")
            else:
                self.lbl_r2_status.config(text="⚠️ LOW (<75% explained)", fg="#FF5252")

            reduction_pct = (1.0 - (res_pk / pk_pk)) * 100.0 if pk_pk > 1e-4 else 0.0
            self.lbl_res_val.config(text=f"±{res_pk*0.5:.4f}° mech")
            self.lbl_res_desc.config(text=f"RMS Residual: {res_rms:.4f}° mech")
            self.lbl_res_status.config(text=f"Ripple Reduction: {reduction_pct:.1f}%", fg="#69F0AE")

            self.lbl_lag_val.config(text=f"{lag_m:.4f}° mech")
            self.lbl_lag_status.config(text=f"Rotor Lag @ 38 RPM", fg="#00E5FF")

            self.lbl_fric_val.config(text=f"Δ{lag_rip:.4f}° mech")
            self.lbl_fric_desc.config(text=f"Peak Drag at {lag_ang:.1f}° mech")
            if lag_rip > 0.08:
                self.lbl_fric_status.config(text=f"⚠️ BINDING DETECTED ({lag_ang:.1f}°)", fg="#FF5252")
            else:
                self.lbl_fric_status.config(text="✅ UNIFORM ROTATION", fg="#69F0AE")

        # Redraw harmonic overlay canvas
        draw_harmonic_overlay_plot(self.harm_canvas, pts, coeffs)

        # Update Benchmark leaderboard table
        if bench_res:
            current_keys = set(bench_res.keys())
            existing_items = self.bench_tree.get_children()
            if len(existing_items) != len(current_keys):
                self.bench_tree.delete(*existing_items)
                mode_names = {
                    0: "Mode 0: Raw (Uncalibrated)",
                    1: "Mode 1: 128-PT Stepped LUT",
                    2: "Mode 2: Continuous Harmonics (Double-Angle)"
                }
                for m_id in sorted(current_keys):
                    row = bench_res[m_id]
                    self.bench_tree.insert("", "end", values=(
                        f"Mode {m_id}",
                        mode_names.get(m_id, f"Mode {m_id}"),
                        f"{row.get('latency_us', 0.0):.2f}",
                        f"{row.get('jitter_rad_s', 0.0):.3f}",
                        f"{row.get('mae_rad_s', 0.0):.3f}",
                        f"{row.get('delta_temp_c', 0.0):+.2f}",
                        f"{row.get('zero_angle_rad', 0.0):.5f}"
                    ))

        # Update SPI Benchmark leaderboard table
        with self.reader.lock:
            spi_res = list(getattr(self.reader, 'spi_bench_results', []))

        if spi_res and hasattr(self, 'spi_tree'):
            existing_spi = self.spi_tree.get_children()
            if len(existing_spi) != len(spi_res):
                self.spi_tree.delete(*existing_spi)
                base_lat = None
                best_mhz = 4.0
                fastest_stable_lat = None
                for row in spi_res:
                    freq = row.get("Freq_MHz", 4.0)
                    lat = row.get("Latency_us", 0.0)
                    errs = int(row.get("Parity_Errors", 0))
                    mags = int(row.get("Mag_Faults", 0))
                    rate = row.get("Err_Rate_Pct", 0.0)
                    is_stable = int(row.get("Stable", 0)) == 1

                    if base_lat is None and lat > 0:
                        base_lat = lat
                    speedup_str = f"{base_lat / lat:.2f}x" if (base_lat and lat > 0.01) else "1.00x"

                    if is_stable and freq >= best_mhz:
                        best_mhz = freq
                        fastest_stable_lat = lat

                    status_str = "✅ 100% STABLE" if is_stable else f"❌ {errs} ERRORS"
                    self.spi_tree.insert("", "end", values=(
                        f"{freq:.1f} MHz",
                        f"{lat:.2f} µs",
                        speedup_str,
                        str(errs),
                        str(mags),
                        f"{rate:.3f}%",
                        status_str
                    ))

                if fastest_stable_lat is not None and base_lat:
                    gain = base_lat / fastest_stable_lat
                    self.lbl_spi_recommendation.config(
                        text=f"🏆 Highest Stable SPI Clock: {best_mhz:.1f} MHz ({fastest_stable_lat:.2f} µs latency, {gain:.2f}x faster reads vs 4.0 MHz)",
                        fg="#69F0AE"
                    )

    def _start_spi_bench(self):
        with self.reader.lock:
            self.reader.spi_bench_results = []
        if hasattr(self, 'lbl_spi_recommendation'):
            self.lbl_spi_recommendation.config(text="⏳ Testing SPI Clock frequencies (4 to 16 MHz)... Please wait ~2 seconds", fg="#FFD600")
        self.reader.send_cmd("SPI_TEST")




=== FILE: 3_esp32/ESP32_Main/simplefoc_mt6816_suite/gui/benchmarker.py ===
"""
Brand New PID Benchmark & 5-Minute Genetic Algorithm (GA) Auto-Tuner for GM3506.
Features:
  1. 5-Minute Adaptive GA Optimizer:
     - 10 Generations x 10 Individuals = 100 candidate evaluations (300s total budget).
     - D is strictly 0.000.
     - LPF Tf strictly constrained between 0.8 ms (0.0008s) and 3.0 ms (0.0030s).
     - P gain in [0.04, 0.30], I gain in [0.40, 4.00].
     - Elitism, tournament selection, BLX-alpha crossover, and bounded Gaussian mutation.
     - Safety watchdog with early abort on instability / severe oscillation.
  2. 18-Stage Systematic Variations Benchmark:
     - Deterministic sweep across 6 LPF steps (0.8ms to 3.0ms), D=0.000, and multiple speeds.
  3. Leaderboard Modal:
     - Ranked evaluation results, CSV export, clipboard copy, and 1-click apply to active motor.
"""

import csv
import math
import random
import threading
import time
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import ttk, messagebox, filedialog


class BenchmarkRunner:
    def __init__(self, reader, root, progress_var, status_var, set_param_fn, on_benchmark_finish_cb=None):
        self.reader = reader
        self.root = root
        self.progress_var = progress_var
        self.status_var = status_var
        self.set_param_fn = set_param_fn
        self.on_benchmark_finish_cb = on_benchmark_finish_cb

        self.running = False
        self.thread = None
        self.results = []
        self.active_mode = None  # "ga" or "sweep"

    def toggle_ga(self, btn_ga, btn_sweep, btn_results):
        """Starts or stops the 5-Minute Genetic Algorithm Auto-Tuner."""
        if self.running:
            self.abort()
            self._reset_buttons(btn_ga, btn_sweep, btn_results)
        else:
            if not self.reader.connected:
                messagebox.showerror("Connection Error", "Please connect to motor controller serial first!")
                return
            self.running = True
            self.active_mode = "ga"
            btn_ga.config(text="⏹️ Stop GA Tuner", bg="#D50000", fg="#FFF")
            btn_sweep.config(state="disabled")
            btn_results.config(state="disabled")
            self.results = []
            self.thread = threading.Thread(target=self._run_ga_worker, args=(btn_ga, btn_sweep, btn_results), daemon=True)
            self.thread.start()

    def toggle_sweep(self, btn_sweep, btn_ga, btn_results):
        """Starts or stops the 18-Stage Systematic Variations Benchmark."""
        if self.running:
            self.abort()
            self._reset_buttons(btn_ga, btn_sweep, btn_results)
        else:
            if not self.reader.connected:
                messagebox.showerror("Connection Error", "Please connect to motor controller serial first!")
                return
            self.running = True
            self.active_mode = "sweep"
            btn_sweep.config(text="⏹️ Stop Sweep", bg="#D50000", fg="#FFF")
            btn_ga.config(state="disabled")
            btn_results.config(state="disabled")
            self.results = []
            self.thread = threading.Thread(target=self._run_sweep_worker, args=(btn_sweep, btn_ga, btn_results), daemon=True)
            self.thread.start()

    def toggle(self, btn_start, btn_results):
        """Legacy compatibility wrapper defaults to 5-Min GA."""
        if self.running:
            self.abort()
            btn_start.config(text="🧬 5-Min GA Auto-Tuner", bg="#00E676", fg="#000")
            if self.results:
                btn_results.config(state="normal")
        else:
            if not self.reader.connected:
                messagebox.showerror("Connection Error", "Please connect to motor controller serial first!")
                return
            self.running = True
            self.active_mode = "ga"
            btn_start.config(text="⏹️ Stop Benchmark", bg="#D50000", fg="#FFF")
            btn_results.config(state="disabled")
            self.results = []
            # Mock sibling button for backward compatibility
            dummy_btn = tk.Button(self.root)
            self.thread = threading.Thread(target=self._run_ga_worker, args=(btn_start, dummy_btn, btn_results), daemon=True)
            self.thread.start()

    def abort(self):
        self.running = False
        self.status_var.set("🛑 EMERGENCY STOP: Benchmark / GA aborted.")
        try:
            self.reader.send_cmd("GA_STREAM 0")
            self.reader.send_cmd("x")
        except Exception:
            pass

    def _reset_buttons(self, btn_primary, btn_secondary, btn_results):
        btn_primary.config(text="🧬 5-Min GA Auto-Tuner", bg="#00E676", fg="#000", state="normal")
        btn_secondary.config(text="🧪 18-Stage Sweep", bg="#00E5FF", fg="#000", state="normal")
        if self.results:
            btn_results.config(state="normal")

    def _ensure_foc_calibration(self):
        """Checks electrical zero alignment before tuning."""
        with self.reader.lock:
            already_calibrated = getattr(self.reader, "last_calib_success", False) and getattr(self.reader, "last_calib_zero_angle", None) is not None
        if not already_calibrated:
            self.root.after(0, lambda: self.status_var.set("Phase 0: Verifying 11-Pole Zero Alignment before tuning..."))
            with self.reader.lock:
                self.reader.last_calib_zero_angle = None
                self.reader.calibrating = True
                self.reader.last_calib_failed = False
            self.reader.send_cmd("c4.0")
            t_cal = time.time()
            time.sleep(1.0)
            while time.time() - t_cal < 35:
                if not self.running:
                    self.reader.send_cmd("x")
                    return False
                with self.reader.lock:
                    if not getattr(self.reader, "calibrating", False) and (
                        getattr(self.reader, "last_calib_zero_angle", None) is not None or getattr(self.reader, "last_calib_failed", False)
                    ):
                        break
                time.sleep(0.3)
            time.sleep(0.5)
        return True

    def _evaluate_candidate(self, p, i, d, tf, target_rpm, stage_duration=3.0, settle_time=1.0, origin_label=""):
        """
        Commands gains and measures steady-state tracking, jitter, ripple, and voltage noise.
        Uses dedicated high-rate (50 Hz) GA stream on ESP32 without requiring full telemetry streaming.
        Includes safety watchdog that detects runaway oscillation early.
        """
        # Clear dedicated sample buffer before stage
        self.reader.clear_ga_samples()

        # Command gains and target (use atomic PID_EVAL for zero latency + individual fallback)
        self.reader.send_cmd(f"PID_EVAL {p:.4f} {i:.4f} {d:.4f} {tf:.5f} {target_rpm:.1f}")
        self.reader.send_cmd(f"p{p:.4f}\ni{i:.4f}\nd{d:.4f}\nf{tf:.5f}\nt{target_rpm:.1f}")

        stage_start = time.time()
        polled_samples = []

        while time.time() - stage_start < stage_duration:
            if not self.running:
                return None

            elapsed = time.time() - stage_start

            # Read latest telemetry for fast watchdog
            with self.reader.lock:
                act = getattr(self.reader, "last_actual_rpm", 0.0)
                uq = getattr(self.reader, "last_uq", 0.0)

            # Dynamic Safety Watchdog: aborts runaway oscillation early across any target speed
            watchdog_limit = max(35.0, target_rpm * 0.28)
            if elapsed > 0.5 and abs(act - target_rpm) > watchdog_limit:
                # Early abort to prevent motor heating / driver tripping
                self.reader.send_cmd("t0")
                time.sleep(0.05)
                return {
                    "origin": origin_label,
                    "p": p, "i": i, "d": d, "tf": tf, "tf_ms": tf * 1000.0,
                    "target": target_rpm,
                    "mean_speed": act,
                    "mae": 150.0,
                    "std_dev": 99.0,
                    "ripple_pk_pk": 190.0,
                    "mean_uq": uq,
                    "score": 999.0,
                    "status": f"⚠️ UNSTABLE @ {target_rpm:.0f} RPM"
                }

            if elapsed >= settle_time:
                polled_samples.append((act, uq))

            time.sleep(0.02) # Responsive 50 Hz watchdog check loop

        # Retrieve high-rate streaming samples captured by reader
        captured = self.reader.get_ga_samples()
        valid_captured = [(pt[1], pt[2]) for pt in captured if pt[0] >= (stage_start + settle_time)]

        # Use high-rate captured samples if available (>= 10 samples), else fall back to polled samples
        samples = valid_captured if len(valid_captured) >= 10 else polled_samples

        if not samples:
            return None

        speeds = [s[0] for s in samples]
        uqs = [s[1] for s in samples]

        mean_speed = sum(speeds) / len(speeds)
        errors = [abs(s - target_rpm) for s in speeds]
        mae = sum(errors) / len(errors)

        variance = sum((s - mean_speed) ** 2 for s in speeds) / len(speeds)
        std_dev = math.sqrt(variance)

        ripple_pk_pk = max(speeds) - min(speeds)
        mean_uq = sum(uqs) / len(uqs)
        uq_var = sum((u - mean_uq) ** 2 for u in uqs) / len(uqs)
        uq_jitter = math.sqrt(uq_var)

        # Composite Fitness Metric: Lower is better
        # Balances speed tracking accuracy (MAE), high-frequency jitter (std_dev), and commutation chatter (uq_jitter)
        score = mae + (1.2 * std_dev) + (0.3 * ripple_pk_pk) + (0.5 * uq_jitter)

        return {
            "origin": origin_label,
            "p": round(p, 4),
            "i": round(i, 4),
            "d": round(d, 4),
            "tf": round(tf, 5),
            "tf_ms": round(tf * 1000.0, 2),
            "target": target_rpm,
            "mean_speed": round(mean_speed, 2),
            "mae": round(mae, 2),
            "std_dev": round(std_dev, 2),
            "ripple_pk_pk": round(ripple_pk_pk, 2),
            "mean_uq": round(mean_uq, 2),
            "score": round(score, 3),
            "status": "✅ Stable"
        }

    def _evaluate_multi_speed(self, p, i, d, tf, speeds=(50.0, 400.0, 1000.0), stage_duration=2.0, settle_time=0.6, origin_label="", on_speed_step_cb=None):
        """
        Evaluates candidate stability and tracking across 3 distinct operating regimes:
        50 RPM (low-speed cornering), 400 RPM (cruise/base), and 1000 RPM (top-end sprint).
        Returns combined multi-speed performance. If any speed is unstable, candidate is penalized.
        """
        sub_results = []
        for spd in speeds:
            if not self.running:
                return None
            if on_speed_step_cb:
                on_speed_step_cb(spd)
            res = self._evaluate_candidate(
                p, i, d, tf, spd,
                stage_duration=stage_duration, settle_time=settle_time,
                origin_label=f"{origin_label} @ {spd:.0f} RPM"
            )
            if res is None or not self.running:
                return None
            if "UNSTABLE" in res.get("status", "") or res.get("score", 999.0) >= 500.0:
                res["origin"] = origin_label
                res["target"] = "50/400/1000"
                res["status"] = f"⚠️ Unstable @ {spd:.0f} RPM"
                return res
            sub_results.append(res)

        mean_mae = sum(r["mae"] for r in sub_results) / len(sub_results)
        mean_std = sum(r["std_dev"] for r in sub_results) / len(sub_results)
        mean_rip = sum(r["ripple_pk_pk"] for r in sub_results) / len(sub_results)
        mean_uq = sum(r["mean_uq"] for r in sub_results) / len(sub_results)
        composite_score = sum(r["score"] for r in sub_results) / len(sub_results)

        return {
            "origin": origin_label,
            "p": round(p, 4),
            "i": round(i, 4),
            "d": round(d, 4),
            "tf": round(tf, 5),
            "tf_ms": round(tf * 1000.0, 2),
            "target": "50/400/1000",
            "mean_speed": round(sum(r["mean_speed"] for r in sub_results) / len(sub_results), 1),
            "mae": round(mean_mae, 2),
            "std_dev": round(mean_std, 2),
            "ripple_pk_pk": round(mean_rip, 2),
            "mean_uq": round(mean_uq, 2),
            "score": round(composite_score, 3),
            "scores_by_speed": {spd: r["score"] for spd, r in zip(speeds, sub_results)},
            "status": "✅ 3-Speed Certified (50/400/1000)"
        }

    def _run_ga_worker(self, btn_ga, btn_sweep, btn_results):
        """
        Multi-Regime Genetic Algorithm Auto-Tuner:
        Phase 1: Base Exploration @ 400 RPM (6 Generations x 10 Individuals = 60 evaluations).
        Phase 2: Multi-Speed Gauntlet (50, 400, and 1000 RPM) across 2 Refinement Generations
                 seeded with the Top 10 unique elites from Phase 1.
        Bounds:
          P: [0.04, 0.30]
          I: [0.40, 4.00]
          D: 0.000 (fixed)
          Tf: [0.0008, 0.0030] (0.8ms to 3.0ms)
        """
        if not self._ensure_foc_calibration():
            self._reset_buttons(btn_ga, btn_sweep, btn_results)
            return

        # Ensure dedicated 50 Hz GA telemetry streaming is active on ESP32 (independent of show_telemetry)
        self.reader.send_cmd("GA_STREAM 50")
        time.sleep(0.05)

        POP_SIZE = 10
        NUM_BASE_GENS = 6
        NUM_REFINE_GENS = 2
        BASE_RPM = 400.0
        MULTI_SPEEDS = (50.0, 400.0, 1000.0)

        CANDIDATE_DURATION = 2.4
        SETTLE_TIME = 0.7

        P_MIN, P_MAX = 0.04, 0.30
        I_MIN, I_MAX = 0.40, 4.00
        TF_MIN, TF_MAX = 0.0008, 0.0030  # 0.8 ms to 3.0 ms
        D_VAL = 0.000

        # Generation 0 Seeds (Proven diverse operating points in the hypercube)
        seeds = [
            {"p": 0.12, "i": 1.20, "tf": 0.0015},  # Crisp Balanced (1.5ms)
            {"p": 0.10, "i": 1.00, "tf": 0.0030},  # Smooth Baseline (3.0ms)
            {"p": 0.14, "i": 1.60, "tf": 0.0010},  # Fast Low-Lag (1.0ms)
            {"p": 0.08, "i": 0.80, "tf": 0.0020},  # Gentle Damped (2.0ms)
            {"p": 0.16, "i": 2.20, "tf": 0.0008},  # Punchy Ultra-Fast (0.8ms)
            {"p": 0.18, "i": 2.80, "tf": 0.0025},  # Stiff High-Authority (2.5ms)
            {"p": 0.06, "i": 0.60, "tf": 0.0012},  # Quiet Low-Current (1.2ms)
        ]

        population = list(seeds)
        while len(population) < POP_SIZE:
            population.append({
                "p": round(random.uniform(P_MIN, P_MAX), 3),
                "i": round(random.uniform(I_MIN, I_MAX), 2),
                "tf": round(random.uniform(TF_MIN, TF_MAX), 5)
            })

        total_base_evals = NUM_BASE_GENS * POP_SIZE
        total_refine_evals = NUM_REFINE_GENS * POP_SIZE
        total_evaluations = total_base_evals + total_refine_evals
        eval_count = 0
        start_time = time.time()
        best_overall = None
        was_aborted = False

        # --- PHASE 1: Base GA Exploration @ 400 RPM ---
        for gen_idx in range(NUM_BASE_GENS):
            if not self.running:
                was_aborted = True
                break

            gen_evaluated = []
            for ind_idx, indiv in enumerate(population):
                if not self.running:
                    was_aborted = True
                    break

                eval_count += 1
                total_progress = min(99.0, (eval_count / total_evaluations) * 100.0)
                remaining_sec = max(0, int((total_base_evals - eval_count) * (CANDIDATE_DURATION + 0.1) + total_refine_evals * 5.5))

                p_val, i_val, tf_val = indiv["p"], indiv["i"], indiv["tf"]
                origin_name = f"🧬 GA Base Gen {gen_idx+1} [#{ind_idx+1}]"

                def _update_status(g=gen_idx+1, ind=ind_idx+1, p=p_val, i=i_val, tf_ms=tf_val*1000.0,
                                   prog=total_progress, rem=remaining_sec, b=best_overall):
                    self.progress_var.set(prog)
                    b_str = f" | Best: {b['score']:.2f} (P={b['p']}, I={b['i']}, Tf={b['tf_ms']}ms)" if b else ""
                    self.status_var.set(
                        f"🧬 Phase 1 Base GA [{g}/{NUM_BASE_GENS}] Indiv [{ind}/{POP_SIZE}] @ 400 RPM: "
                        f"P={p:.3f}, I={i:.2f}, Tf={tf_ms:.2f}ms{b_str} | ~{rem}s left"
                    )
                self.root.after(0, _update_status)

                res = self._evaluate_candidate(
                    p_val, i_val, D_VAL, tf_val, BASE_RPM,
                    stage_duration=CANDIDATE_DURATION, settle_time=SETTLE_TIME, origin_label=origin_name
                )

                if res is not None:
                    gen_evaluated.append(res)
                    self.results.append(res)
                    if best_overall is None or res["score"] < best_overall["score"]:
                        best_overall = res

            if not self.running or len(gen_evaluated) < 2:
                break

            gen_evaluated.sort(key=lambda x: x["score"])

            # Reproduction for next Phase 1 generation
            if gen_idx < NUM_BASE_GENS - 1:
                next_pop = []
                next_pop.append({"p": gen_evaluated[0]["p"], "i": gen_evaluated[0]["i"], "tf": gen_evaluated[0]["tf"]})
                next_pop.append({"p": gen_evaluated[1]["p"], "i": gen_evaluated[1]["i"], "tf": gen_evaluated[1]["tf"]})

                def select_parent():
                    candidates = random.sample(gen_evaluated[:min(6, len(gen_evaluated))], 2)
                    candidates.sort(key=lambda x: x["score"])
                    return candidates[0]

                while len(next_pop) < POP_SIZE:
                    p1 = select_parent()
                    p2 = select_parent()

                    def cross(v1, v2, vmin, vmax):
                        low = min(v1, v2)
                        high = max(v1, v2)
                        d = high - low
                        val = random.uniform(low - 0.3 * d, high + 0.3 * d)
                        return max(vmin, min(vmax, val))

                    child_p = cross(p1["p"], p2["p"], P_MIN, P_MAX)
                    child_i = cross(p1["i"], p2["i"], I_MIN, I_MAX)
                    child_tf = cross(p1["tf"], p2["tf"], TF_MIN, TF_MAX)

                    if random.random() < 0.25:
                        child_p = max(P_MIN, min(P_MAX, child_p + random.gauss(0, 0.025)))
                    if random.random() < 0.25:
                        child_i = max(I_MIN, min(I_MAX, child_i + random.gauss(0, 0.35)))
                    if random.random() < 0.25:
                        child_tf = max(TF_MIN, min(TF_MAX, child_tf + random.gauss(0, 0.0003)))

                    next_pop.append({
                        "p": round(child_p, 4),
                        "i": round(child_i, 3),
                        "tf": round(child_tf, 5)
                    })
                population = next_pop

        # --- PHASE 2: Multi-Speed Gauntlet (50, 400, 1000 RPM) for 2 Generations ---
        if self.running and not was_aborted:
            # Extract Top 10 unique elites from Phase 1
            seen = set()
            top_elites = []
            stable_p1 = [r for r in self.results if "Stable" in r.get("status", "")]
            stable_p1.sort(key=lambda x: x["score"])
            for r in stable_p1:
                key = (round(r["p"], 3), round(r["i"], 2), round(r["tf"], 5))
                if key not in seen:
                    seen.add(key)
                    top_elites.append({"p": r["p"], "i": r["i"], "tf": r["tf"]})
                if len(top_elites) >= POP_SIZE:
                    break

            while len(top_elites) < POP_SIZE:
                base = top_elites[0] if top_elites else {"p": 0.12, "i": 1.2, "tf": 0.0015}
                top_elites.append({
                    "p": round(max(P_MIN, min(P_MAX, base["p"] + random.gauss(0, 0.02))), 3),
                    "i": round(max(I_MIN, min(I_MAX, base["i"] + random.gauss(0, 0.3))), 2),
                    "tf": round(max(TF_MIN, min(TF_MAX, base["tf"] + random.gauss(0, 0.0003))), 5)
                })

            multi_pop = list(top_elites)

            for refine_gen in range(NUM_REFINE_GENS):
                if not self.running:
                    was_aborted = True
                    break

                refine_evaluated = []
                for ind_idx, indiv in enumerate(multi_pop):
                    if not self.running:
                        was_aborted = True
                        break

                    eval_count += 1
                    total_progress = min(99.0, (eval_count / total_evaluations) * 100.0)
                    rem_refine = max(0, int((total_evaluations - eval_count) * 5.5))

                    p_val, i_val, tf_val = indiv["p"], indiv["i"], indiv["tf"]
                    origin_name = f"🧬 GA 3-Speed Gen {refine_gen+1} [#{ind_idx+1}]"

                    def _update_status_multi(rg=refine_gen+1, ind=ind_idx+1, p=p_val, i=i_val, tf_ms=tf_val*1000.0,
                                             prog=total_progress, rem=rem_refine, b=best_overall):
                        self.progress_var.set(prog)
                        b_str = f" | Champion: {b['score']:.2f} ({b['status']})" if b and "Certified" in b.get("status", "") else ""
                        self.status_var.set(
                            f"🏎️ Phase 2 [Gen {rg}/{NUM_REFINE_GENS}] Elite [{ind}/{POP_SIZE}]: Testing 50/400/1000 RPM "
                            f"(P={p:.3f}, I={i:.2f}, Tf={tf_ms:.2f}ms){b_str} | ~{rem}s left"
                        )
                    self.root.after(0, _update_status_multi)

                    def _on_spd(cur_spd, rg=refine_gen+1, ind=ind_idx+1, p=p_val, i=i_val, tf_ms=tf_val*1000.0, prog=total_progress):
                        self.progress_var.set(prog)
                        self.status_var.set(
                            f"🏎️ Phase 2 [Gen {rg}/{NUM_REFINE_GENS}] Elite [{ind}/{POP_SIZE}] -> Testing {cur_spd:.0f} RPM "
                            f"(P={p:.3f}, I={i:.2f}, Tf={tf_ms:.2f}ms)"
                        )

                    multi_res = self._evaluate_multi_speed(
                        p_val, i_val, D_VAL, tf_val, speeds=MULTI_SPEEDS,
                        stage_duration=2.0, settle_time=0.6, origin_label=origin_name,
                        on_speed_step_cb=lambda s: self.root.after(0, lambda sp=s: _on_spd(sp))
                    )

                    if multi_res is not None:
                        refine_evaluated.append(multi_res)
                        self.results.append(multi_res)
                        if "Certified" in multi_res.get("status", ""):
                            if best_overall is None or "Certified" not in best_overall.get("status", "") or multi_res["score"] < best_overall["score"]:
                                best_overall = multi_res

                if not self.running or len(refine_evaluated) < 2:
                    break

                refine_evaluated.sort(key=lambda x: (0 if "Certified" in x.get("status", "") else 1, x["score"]))

                # Reproduction for Refine Generation 2
                if refine_gen < NUM_REFINE_GENS - 1:
                    next_multi_pop = []
                    next_multi_pop.append({"p": refine_evaluated[0]["p"], "i": refine_evaluated[0]["i"], "tf": refine_evaluated[0]["tf"]})
                    next_multi_pop.append({"p": refine_evaluated[1]["p"], "i": refine_evaluated[1]["i"], "tf": refine_evaluated[1]["tf"]})

                    def select_multi_parent():
                        cands = random.sample(refine_evaluated[:min(5, len(refine_evaluated))], 2)
                        cands.sort(key=lambda x: (0 if "Certified" in x.get("status", "") else 1, x["score"]))
                        return cands[0]

                    while len(next_multi_pop) < POP_SIZE:
                        p1 = select_multi_parent()
                        p2 = select_multi_parent()

                        def cross(v1, v2, vmin, vmax):
                            low = min(v1, v2)
                            high = max(v1, v2)
                            d = high - low
                            val = random.uniform(low - 0.25 * d, high + 0.25 * d)
                            return max(vmin, min(vmax, val))

                        child_p = cross(p1["p"], p2["p"], P_MIN, P_MAX)
                        child_i = cross(p1["i"], p2["i"], I_MIN, I_MAX)
                        child_tf = cross(p1["tf"], p2["tf"], TF_MIN, TF_MAX)

                        if random.random() < 0.30:
                            child_p = max(P_MIN, min(P_MAX, child_p + random.gauss(0, 0.015)))
                        if random.random() < 0.30:
                            child_i = max(I_MIN, min(I_MAX, child_i + random.gauss(0, 0.20)))
                        if random.random() < 0.30:
                            child_tf = max(TF_MIN, min(TF_MAX, child_tf + random.gauss(0, 0.0002)))

                        next_multi_pop.append({
                            "p": round(child_p, 4),
                            "i": round(child_i, 3),
                            "tf": round(child_tf, 5)
                        })
                    multi_pop = next_multi_pop

        self.running = False
        try:
            self.reader.send_cmd("GA_STREAM 0")
        except Exception:
            pass
        if was_aborted:
            self.reader.send_cmd("x")
        else:
            self.reader.send_cmd("t0")

        def _finish(aborted=was_aborted):
            btn_ga.config(text="🧬 5-Min GA Auto-Tuner", bg="#00E676", fg="#000", state="normal")
            btn_sweep.config(text="🧪 18-Stage Sweep", bg="#00E5FF", fg="#000", state="normal")
            if aborted:
                self.status_var.set("GA Optimization Aborted.")
                if self.results:
                    btn_results.config(state="normal")
            elif self.results:
                # Prioritize 3-Speed Certified candidates at top of leaderboard
                self.results.sort(key=lambda x: (0 if "Certified" in x.get("status", "") else 1, x['score']))
                for rank_idx, r in enumerate(self.results):
                    r['rank'] = rank_idx + 1

                best = self.results[0]
                self.progress_var.set(100.0)
                cert_str = " (3-Speed Certified @ 50, 400 & 1000 RPM)" if "Certified" in best.get("status", "") else ""
                self.status_var.set(
                    f"✅ Multi-Speed GA Complete! Winner: #{best['rank']} (P={best['p']}, I={best['i']}, Tf={best['tf_ms']}ms, D=0){cert_str} "
                    f"| Jitter: ±{best['std_dev']:.2f} RPM | MAE: ±{best['mae']:.2f} RPM"
                )
                btn_results.config(state="normal")
                if self.on_benchmark_finish_cb:
                    self.root.after(200, self.on_benchmark_finish_cb)

        self.root.after(0, _finish)

    def _run_sweep_worker(self, btn_sweep, btn_ga, btn_results):
        """
        18-Stage Systematic Variations Benchmark:
        Strictly tests D=0.000 across 6 LPF steps (0.8ms to 3.0ms) and curated P & I bounds.
        """
        if not self._ensure_foc_calibration():
            self._reset_buttons(btn_ga, btn_sweep, btn_results)
            return

        presets = [
            # Group 1: 0.8 ms LPF (Ultra-Fast Razor Response)
            {"name": "0.8ms Ultra-Fast Baseline",   "p": 0.10, "i": 1.00, "d": 0.000, "tf": 0.0008, "target": 80.0},
            {"name": "0.8ms Crisp Punchy",         "p": 0.14, "i": 1.50, "d": 0.000, "tf": 0.0008, "target": 120.0},
            {"name": "0.8ms Stiff High-Speed",     "p": 0.18, "i": 2.20, "d": 0.000, "tf": 0.0008, "target": 200.0},

            # Group 2: 1.2 ms LPF (Direct Cornering Fast Filter)
            {"name": "1.2ms Low-Current Smooth",   "p": 0.08, "i": 0.80, "d": 0.000, "tf": 0.0012, "target": 80.0},
            {"name": "1.2ms Balanced Track",       "p": 0.12, "i": 1.30, "d": 0.000, "tf": 0.0012, "target": 120.0},
            {"name": "1.2ms Aggressive Sprint",    "p": 0.16, "i": 2.00, "d": 0.000, "tf": 0.0012, "target": 250.0},

            # Group 3: 1.5 ms LPF (Crisp Balanced)
            {"name": "1.5ms Smooth Cruiser",       "p": 0.10, "i": 1.00, "d": 0.000, "tf": 0.0015, "target": 80.0},
            {"name": "1.5ms Folkrace Direct",      "p": 0.14, "i": 1.60, "d": 0.000, "tf": 0.0015, "target": 150.0},
            {"name": "1.5ms High-I Authority",     "p": 0.12, "i": 2.50, "d": 0.000, "tf": 0.0015, "target": 150.0},

            # Group 4: 2.0 ms LPF (Low-Lag Damped)
            {"name": "2.0ms Gentle Low-Vibration", "p": 0.08, "i": 0.90, "d": 0.000, "tf": 0.0020, "target": 80.0},
            {"name": "2.0ms Balanced Optimal",     "p": 0.12, "i": 1.40, "d": 0.000, "tf": 0.0020, "target": 120.0},
            {"name": "2.0ms High Torque Rigidity", "p": 0.18, "i": 2.40, "d": 0.000, "tf": 0.0020, "target": 250.0},

            # Group 5: 2.5 ms LPF (Quiet Damped Tracking)
            {"name": "2.5ms Quiet Baseline",       "p": 0.10, "i": 1.10, "d": 0.000, "tf": 0.0025, "target": 80.0},
            {"name": "2.5ms Stiff Load Recovery",  "p": 0.15, "i": 2.20, "d": 0.000, "tf": 0.0025, "target": 150.0},
            {"name": "2.5ms Top-End 350 RPM",      "p": 0.16, "i": 1.80, "d": 0.000, "tf": 0.0025, "target": 350.0},

            # Group 6: 3.0 ms LPF (Firmware Default Smooth)
            {"name": "3.0ms Default Smooth",       "p": 0.12, "i": 1.20, "d": 0.000, "tf": 0.0030, "target": 80.0},
            {"name": "3.0ms Heavy Damped Sprint",  "p": 0.15, "i": 1.80, "d": 0.000, "tf": 0.0030, "target": 180.0},
            {"name": "3.0ms Maximum Velocity 400", "p": 0.16, "i": 1.60, "d": 0.000, "tf": 0.0030, "target": 400.0},
        ]

        # Ensure dedicated 50 Hz GA telemetry streaming is active on ESP32
        self.reader.send_cmd("GA_STREAM 50")
        time.sleep(0.05)

        total_stages = len(presets)
        stage_duration = 6.0
        settle_time = 1.5
        start_time = time.time()
        was_aborted = False

        for idx, p in enumerate(presets):
            if not self.running:
                was_aborted = True
                break

            total_elapsed = time.time() - start_time
            total_progress = min(99.0, (idx / total_stages) * 100.0)
            remaining_sec = max(0, int((total_stages - idx) * stage_duration))

            def _update_status(i=idx, pr=p, prog=total_progress, rem=remaining_sec):
                self.progress_var.set(prog)
                self.status_var.set(
                    f"🧪 Sweep [{i+1}/{total_stages}] '{pr['name']}' (P={pr['p']}, I={pr['i']}, Tf={pr['tf']*1000:.1f}ms, D=0) | "
                    f"Target: {pr['target']:.0f} RPM | {rem}s remaining"
                )
            self.root.after(0, _update_status)

            res = self._evaluate_candidate(
                p["p"], p["i"], p["d"], p["tf"], p["target"],
                stage_duration=stage_duration, settle_time=settle_time, origin_label=f"🧪 {p['name']}"
            )

            if res is not None:
                self.results.append(res)

        self.running = False
        try:
            self.reader.send_cmd("GA_STREAM 0")
        except Exception:
            pass
        if was_aborted:
            self.reader.send_cmd("x")
        else:
            self.reader.send_cmd("t0")

        def _finish(aborted=was_aborted):
            btn_sweep.config(text="🧪 18-Stage Sweep", bg="#00E5FF", fg="#000", state="normal")
            btn_ga.config(text="🧬 5-Min GA Auto-Tuner", bg="#00E676", fg="#000", state="normal")
            if aborted:
                self.status_var.set("Benchmark Aborted.")
                if self.results:
                    btn_results.config(state="normal")
            elif self.results:
                self.results.sort(key=lambda x: x['score'])
                for rank_idx, r in enumerate(self.results):
                    r['rank'] = rank_idx + 1

                best = self.results[0]
                self.progress_var.set(100.0)
                self.status_var.set(
                    f"✅ Sweep Complete! Best Preset: #{best['rank']} '{best['origin']}' "
                    f"(P={best['p']}, I={best['i']}, Tf={best['tf_ms']}ms | Jitter: ±{best['std_dev']:.2f} RPM)"
                )
                btn_results.config(state="normal")
                if self.on_benchmark_finish_cb:
                    self.root.after(200, self.on_benchmark_finish_cb)

        self.root.after(0, _finish)

    def show_results_modal(self, apply_callback=None):
        if not self.results:
            messagebox.showinfo("No Results", "Please run either the 5-minute GA tuner or variations sweep first!")
            return

        modal = tk.Toplevel(self.root)
        modal.title("🏆 PID Benchmark & 5-Min GA Leaderboard (D=0, LPF 0.8-3.0ms)")
        modal.geometry("980x560")
        modal.configure(bg="#12161E")
        modal.transient(self.root)

        header = tk.Frame(modal, bg="#1A2230", padx=15, pady=12)
        header.pack(fill="x")

        best = self.results[0]
        tk.Label(header, text="🏆 PID TUNING & SPEED VARIATION LEADERBOARD", font=("Segoe UI", 14, "bold"), fg="#00E5FF", bg="#1A2230").pack(anchor="w")
        tk.Label(
            header,
            text=f"Top Performer: #{best.get('rank', 1)} {best['origin']} | P={best['p']}, I={best['i']}, D={best['d']} (D=0), "
                 f"Tf={best['tf_ms']:.2f} ms | Jitter: ±{best['std_dev']:.2f} RPM | MAE: ±{best['mae']:.2f} RPM | Ripple: {best['ripple_pk_pk']:.1f} RPM",
            font=("Segoe UI", 10, "bold"),
            fg="#69F0AE",
            bg="#1A2230"
        ).pack(anchor="w", pady=(4, 0))

        table_frame = tk.Frame(modal, bg="#12161E", padx=10, pady=10)
        table_frame.pack(fill="both", expand=True)

        cols = ("Rank", "Source / Preset", "P Gain", "I Gain", "D Gain", "LPF (ms)", "Target", "Actual", "MAE Err", "StdDev (Jitter)", "Ripple Pk-Pk", "Score")
        tree = ttk.Treeview(table_frame, columns=cols, show="headings", height=12)

        col_widths = [45, 190, 55, 55, 50, 65, 90, 65, 70, 95, 85, 60]
        for c, w in zip(cols, col_widths):
            tree.heading(c, text=c)
            tree.column(c, width=w, anchor="center")

        for r in self.results:
            tgt_disp = f"{r['target']:.1f}" if isinstance(r.get('target'), (int, float)) else str(r.get('target', ''))
            values = (
                f"#{r.get('rank', '-')}",
                r['origin'],
                f"{r['p']:.3f}",
                f"{r['i']:.2f}",
                f"{r['d']:.3f}",
                f"{r['tf_ms']:.2f} ms",
                tgt_disp,
                f"{r['mean_speed']:.1f}",
                f"±{r['mae']:.2f}",
                f"±{r['std_dev']:.2f} RPM",
                f"{r['ripple_pk_pk']:.1f} RPM",
                f"{r['score']:.2f}"
            )
            tree.insert("", "end", values=values)

        tree.pack(fill="both", expand=True)

        btn_bar = tk.Frame(modal, bg="#12161E", padx=15, pady=10)
        btn_bar.pack(fill="x")

        def apply_selected():
            sel = tree.selection()
            if not sel:
                target_res = self.results[0]
            else:
                idx = tree.index(sel[0])
                target_res = self.results[idx]

            if apply_callback:
                apply_callback(target_res)

            messagebox.showinfo("Preset Applied", f"Applied Preset #{target_res.get('rank', 1)} '{target_res['origin']}' to active motor controller!")
            modal.destroy()

        def copy_report():
            lines = [
                "=== PID BENCHMARK & MULTI-SPEED GA AUTO-TUNER LEADERBOARD ===",
                f"Top Ranked Winner: #{best.get('rank', 1)} {best['origin']} (Score: {best['score']:.2f})",
                f"Gains: P={best['p']}, I={best['i']}, D={best['d']}, Tf={best['tf_ms']:.2f}ms",
                f"Metrics: Jitter=±{best['std_dev']:.2f} RPM, MAE=±{best['mae']:.2f} RPM, Ripple={best['ripple_pk_pk']:.1f} RPM",
                "----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------",
                f"{'Rank':<5} | {'Source / Preset':<24} | {'P':<6} | {'I':<6} | {'D':<6} | {'LPF (ms)':<8} | {'Target':<12} | {'Actual':<6} | {'StdDev':<10} | {'Score':<6}",
                "------+--------------------------+--------+--------+--------+----------+--------------+--------+------------+-------"
            ]
            for r in self.results:
                tgt_str = f"{r['target']:<12.1f}" if isinstance(r.get('target'), (int, float)) else f"{str(r.get('target', '')):<12}"
                lines.append(
                    f"#{r.get('rank', '-'):<4} | {r['origin']:<24} | {r['p']:<6.3f} | {r['i']:<6.2f} | {r['d']:<6.3f} | "
                    f"{r['tf_ms']:<8.2f} | {tgt_str} | {r['mean_speed']:<6.1f} | ±{r['std_dev']:<8.2f} | {r['score']:<6.2f}"
                )
            text_rep = "\n".join(lines)
            self.root.clipboard_clear()
            self.root.clipboard_append(text_rep)
            messagebox.showinfo("Report Copied", "Leaderboard text successfully copied to clipboard!")

        def export_csv():
            filename = filedialog.asksaveasfilename(
                title="Save Benchmark Leaderboard CSV",
                defaultextension=".csv",
                filetypes=[("CSV Files", "*.csv"), ("All Files", "*.*")],
                initialfile="pid_benchmark_results.csv"
            )
            if not filename:
                return
            try:
                with open(filename, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                    writer = csv.writer(f)
                    writer.writerow(["Rank", "Source_Preset", "P", "I", "D", "LPF_Tf_s", "LPF_Tf_ms", "Target_RPM", "Actual_RPM", "MAE_RPM", "StdDev_RPM", "Ripple_RPM", "Score"])
                    for r in self.results:
                        writer.writerow([
                            r.get('rank', '-'), r['origin'], r['p'], r['i'], r['d'], r['tf'], r['tf_ms'],
                            r['target'], r['mean_speed'], r['mae'], r['std_dev'], r['ripple_pk_pk'], r['score']
                        ])
                messagebox.showinfo("CSV Exported", f"Successfully saved {len(self.results)} benchmark records to {filename}!")
            except Exception as e:
                messagebox.showerror("Export Error", f"Failed to export CSV: {e}")

        tk.Button(
            btn_bar, text="🚀 Apply Selected / #1 Best Preset", font=("Segoe UI", 10, "bold"),
            bg="#00E676", fg="#000", padx=12, pady=6, relief="flat", command=apply_selected
        ).pack(side="left", padx=5)

        tk.Button(
            btn_bar, text="📋 Copy Report", font=("Segoe UI", 9, "bold"),
            bg="#00E5FF", fg="#000", padx=10, pady=6, relief="flat", command=copy_report
        ).pack(side="left", padx=5)

        tk.Button(
            btn_bar, text="💾 Export CSV", font=("Segoe UI", 9, "bold"),
            bg="#FFD600", fg="#000", padx=10, pady=6, relief="flat", command=export_csv
        ).pack(side="left", padx=5)

        tk.Button(
            btn_bar, text="Close", font=("Segoe UI", 9), bg="#455A64", fg="#FFF", padx=10, pady=6, relief="flat",
            command=modal.destroy
        ).pack(side="right", padx=5)


=== FILE: 3_esp32/ESP32_Main/simplefoc_mt6816_suite/gui/calibrator.py ===
"""
Master Auto-Calibration Orchestrator for ESP32 SimpleFOC & MT6816/MT6818.
Coordinates 128-point dual-pass LUT calibration, 11-pole continuous alignment fallback,
verification spins, and automatic NVS profile commitment.
"""

import threading
import time
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import messagebox


class Calibrator:
    def __init__(self, reader, root, progress_var, status_var, grade_var, align_volt_var, boost_retry_var, verify_var, on_calib_finish_cb=None):
        self.reader = reader
        self.root = root
        self.progress_var = progress_var
        self.status_var = status_var
        self.grade_var = grade_var
        self.align_volt_var = align_volt_var
        self.boost_retry_var = boost_retry_var
        self.verify_var = verify_var
        self.on_calib_finish_cb = on_calib_finish_cb

        self.running = False
        self.thread = None

    def toggle(self, btn_calib):
        if self.running:
            self.running = False
            btn_calib.config(text="🚀 1-CLICK MASTER AUTO-CALIBRATE (MULTI-METHOD)", bg="#00E676", fg="#000")
            self.status_var.set("Calibration Aborted by User.")
            self.reader.send_cmd("x")
        else:
            if not self.reader.connected:
                messagebox.showerror("Connection Error", "Please connect to ESP32-S3 first!")
                return
            self.running = True
            btn_calib.config(text="⏹️ Abort Master Calibration", bg="#D50000", fg="#FFF")
            self.thread = threading.Thread(target=self._run_worker, args=(btn_calib,), daemon=True)
            self.thread.start()

    def abort(self):
        self.running = False
        self.status_var.set("🛑 EMERGENCY STOP: All operations terminated.")

    def _cleanup_ui(self, btn_calib):
        self.running = False
        self.root.after(0, lambda: btn_calib.config(text="🚀 1-CLICK MASTER AUTO-CALIBRATE (MULTI-METHOD)", bg="#00E676", fg="#000"))

    def _run_worker(self, btn_calib):
        try:
            align_v = float(self.align_volt_var.get().strip())
        except Exception:
            align_v = 4.0

        # Step 0: Pre-Flight Hardware Qualification
        self.root.after(0, lambda: [
            self.progress_var.set(2.0),
            self.status_var.set("Step 0/5: Checking Sensor & SPI Bus Diagnostics (r)...")
        ])
        self.reader.send_cmd("r")
        time.sleep(0.4)

        with self.reader.lock:
            mag_ok = self.reader.last_mag_ok
            parity_ok = self.reader.last_parity_ok
            raw_cnt = self.reader.last_raw_14bit

        if not mag_ok or not parity_ok or raw_cnt == 0 or raw_cnt == 16383:
            self.root.after(0, lambda: [
                self.status_var.set("❌ Pre-Flight Failed: Magnet Fault or Parity Errors! Check wiring."),
                self.grade_var.set("SENSOR FAULT")
            ])
            self._cleanup_ui(btn_calib)
            return

        # METHOD 1: HIGH-PRECISION 128-PT DUAL-PASS LUT CALIBRATION ('w')
        self.root.after(0, lambda: [
            self.status_var.set(f"Step 1/5: Running 128-Point Dual-Pass LUT Sweep at {align_v:.1f}V..."),
            self.progress_var.set(5.0)
        ])

        lut_success = self._execute_firmware_sweep(f"w{align_v:.2f}", timeout_sec=200)

        # Retry with higher voltage if stalled or cogging occurred
        if not lut_success and self.boost_retry_var.get() and self.running:
            boost_v = min(4.2, align_v + 0.2)
            self.root.after(0, lambda bv=boost_v: self.status_var.set(f"⚠️ LUT Retrying with Boost Voltage {bv:.1f}V to overcome cogging/stiction..."))
            time.sleep(2.0)
            lut_success = self._execute_firmware_sweep(f"w{boost_v:.2f}", timeout_sec=200)

        # METHOD 2: 11-POLE ROUND-TRIP ALIGNMENT ('c') FALLBACK (IF LUT FAILED)
        c_success = lut_success
        if not lut_success and self.running:
            fallback_v = min(4.2, align_v + 0.2)
            self.root.after(0, lambda fv=fallback_v: self.status_var.set(f"Step 2/5: Fallback to High-Torque 11-Pole Round-Trip Alignment ({fv:.1f}V)..."))
            time.sleep(1.0)
            c_success = self._execute_firmware_sweep(f"c{fallback_v:.2f}", timeout_sec=60)
            if not c_success and self.running:
                # Retry once more with max safe voltage
                time.sleep(1.5)
                c_success = self._execute_firmware_sweep("c4.20", timeout_sec=60)

        if not self.running:
            self._cleanup_ui(btn_calib)
            return

        if not c_success:
            self.root.after(0, lambda: [
                self.grade_var.set("GRADE F (FAILED)"),
                self.status_var.set("❌ Calibration failed. Check motor wiring, power supply, and mechanical friction.")
            ])
            self._cleanup_ui(btn_calib)
            return

        # POST-CALIBRATION: CLOSED-LOOP VERIFICATION PULSE
        verified = False
        if self.verify_var.get() and self.running:
            self.root.after(0, lambda: [
                self.status_var.set("Step 4/5: Running Dual-Direction Closed-Loop Verification Spin (±1.5V)..."),
                self.progress_var.set(90.0)
            ])
            verified = self._verify_closed_loop_motion()
        else:
            verified = True

        # AUTO-SAVE TO FLASH (NVS) & FINALIZE
        if self.running and verified:
            self.root.after(0, lambda: [
                self.status_var.set("Step 5/5: Auto-Saving Certified Profile to Flash Memory (NVS)..."),
                self.progress_var.set(100.0)
            ])
            self.reader.send_cmd("save")
            time.sleep(0.4)
            with self.reader.lock:
                grade = self.reader.last_calib_grade or "CERTIFIED"
                zero_a = self.reader.last_zero_electric_angle or 0.97555
            self.root.after(0, lambda g=grade, a=zero_a: [
                self.grade_var.set(g),
                self.status_var.set(f"🎉 Calibration Certified! Zero: {a:.5f} rad ({a*57.29578:.1f}°) | {g} | Saved to Flash.")
            ])
            if self.on_calib_finish_cb:
                self.root.after(0, lambda a=zero_a: self.on_calib_finish_cb(a))
        elif self.running and not verified:
            self.root.after(0, lambda: self.status_var.set("⚠️ Verification failed: Low rotation detected. Profile not saved to Flash."))

        self._cleanup_ui(btn_calib)

    def _execute_firmware_sweep(self, cmd, timeout_sec=200):
        with self.reader.lock:
            self.reader.last_calib_success = False
            self.reader.last_calib_failed = False
            self.reader.calibrating = True
        self.reader.send_cmd(cmd)
        t_start = time.time()
        while time.time() - t_start < timeout_sec:
            if not self.running:
                self.reader.send_cmd("x")
                return False
            with self.reader.lock:
                done = (not self.reader.calibrating) and (self.reader.last_calib_success or self.reader.last_calib_failed)
                success = self.reader.last_calib_success
                failed = self.reader.last_calib_failed
                p_pct = self.reader.calib_progress_pct
                st_name = self.reader.calib_stage_name
            if p_pct > 0:
                self.root.after(0, lambda p=p_pct: self.progress_var.set(p))
            if st_name:
                self.root.after(0, lambda s=st_name: self.status_var.set(s))
            if done:
                return success and not failed
            time.sleep(0.1)
        return False

    def _verify_closed_loop_motion(self):
        # Forward test (+1.5V)
        self.reader.send_cmd("v1.50")
        t0 = time.time()
        fwd_speeds = []
        while time.time() - t0 < 0.6:
            if not self.running:
                self.reader.send_cmd("v0.0")
                return False
            with self.reader.lock:
                fwd_speeds.append(abs(self.reader.last_actual_rpm))
            time.sleep(0.05)
        self.reader.send_cmd("v0.0")
        time.sleep(0.3)

        # Reverse test (-1.5V)
        self.reader.send_cmd("v-1.50")
        t1 = time.time()
        rev_speeds = []
        while time.time() - t1 < 0.6:
            if not self.running:
                self.reader.send_cmd("v0.0")
                return False
            with self.reader.lock:
                rev_speeds.append(abs(self.reader.last_actual_rpm))
            time.sleep(0.05)
        self.reader.send_cmd("v0.0")
        time.sleep(0.2)

        max_fwd = max(fwd_speeds) if fwd_speeds else 0.0
        max_rev = max(rev_speeds) if rev_speeds else 0.0

        if max_fwd >= 20.0 and max_rev >= 20.0:
            return True
        else:
            self.root.after(0, lambda mf=max_fwd, mr=max_rev: self.status_var.set(f"⚠️ Verification: Low rotation (Fwd={mf:.0f}, Rev={mr:.0f} RPM)."))
            return False
