"""
Closed-Loop Motor KV Analyzer Lab:
Firmware test control, real-time data table formatting, report CSV/text export, and snippet generation.
"""

import time
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import filedialog, messagebox


class KVAnalyzer:
    def __init__(self, reader, root, progress_var, status_var):
        self.reader = reader
        self.root = root
        self.progress_var = progress_var
        self.status_var = status_var
        self.table_finalized = False

    def start_test(self, btn_run, kv_tree):
        if not self.reader.connected:
            messagebox.showerror("Connection Error", "Please connect to ESP32-S3 first!")
            return

        with self.reader.lock:
            self.reader.kv_points = []
            self.reader.kv_results = {}
            self.reader.kv_test_active = True

        for item in kv_tree.get_children():
            kv_tree.delete(item)

        self.table_finalized = False
        btn_run.config(text="🔄 Running KV Sweep...", bg="#FF9100", fg="#000")
        self.progress_var.set(5.0)
        self.status_var.set("Initiating FOC Alignment & Voltage Sweep...")
        self.reader.send_cmd("k")

    def abort_test(self, btn_run):
        self.reader.send_cmd("x")
        btn_run.config(text="🚀 START 18-Stage KV Sweep (k)", bg="#00E676", fg="#000")
        self.status_var.set("KV Test Aborted by User.")
        with self.reader.lock:
            self.reader.kv_test_active = False

    def apply_kv_to_motor(self, entry_kv, set_param_fn):
        with self.reader.lock:
            res = dict(self.reader.kv_results)
        kv = res.get('KV', 171.9)
        entry_kv.delete(0, "end")
        entry_kv.insert(0, f"{kv:.1f}")
        set_param_fn("q", f"{kv:.1f}")
        messagebox.showinfo("KV Applied", f"Motor KV rating set to {kv:.1f} RPM/V on ESP32-S3 controller and updated in Live Tuning Panel.")

    def copy_simplefoc_snippet(self):
        with self.reader.lock:
            res = dict(self.reader.kv_results)
        kv = res.get('KV', 130.0)
        snippet = f"motor.KV_rating = {kv:.1f}f; // GM3506 Measured Closed-Loop KV"
        self.root.clipboard_clear()
        self.root.clipboard_append(snippet)
        messagebox.showinfo("Copied", f"Copied SimpleFOC configuration to clipboard:\n\n{snippet}")

    def export_report(self):
        with self.reader.lock:
            pts = list(self.reader.kv_points)
            res = dict(self.reader.kv_results)

        if not pts and not res:
            messagebox.showinfo("No Data", "Please run the KV test first before exporting!")
            return

        file_path = filedialog.asksaveasfilename(
            defaultextension=".csv",
            filetypes=[("CSV File", "*.csv"), ("Text Report", "*.txt"), ("All Files", "*.*")],
            title="Export Closed-Loop KV Test Report"
        )
        if not file_path:
            return

        try:
            with open(file_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                f.write("# FOLKRACE — CLOSED-LOOP MOTOR KV TEST REPORT\n")
                f.write(f"# Date: {time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}\n")
                f.write("# Motor: GM3506 (11 Pole Pairs) @ 12V SpaceVectorPWM\n")
                f.write("# Sensor: MT6816/MT6818 14-Bit SPI Magnetic Encoder\n")
                f.write("# ====================================================================\n")
                if res:
                    f.write(f"# True Motor KV: {res.get('KV', 0):.2f} RPM/V\n")
                    f.write(f"# Phase KV (Uq): {res.get('PhaseKV', res.get('KV', 0) * 1.7320508):.2f} RPM/V\n")
                    f.write(f"# Forward KV (CW): {res.get('FwdKV', 0):.2f} RPM/V\n")
                    f.write(f"# Reverse KV (CCW): {res.get('RevKV', 0):.2f} RPM/V\n")
                    f.write(f"# Linearity (R^2): {res.get('R2', 0):.5f}\n")
                    f.write(f"# Friction Voltage (V0): {res.get('V0', 0):.3f} V\n")
                    f.write(f"# Back-EMF Constant (Ke): {res.get('Ke', 0):.5f} V*s/rad\n")
                    f.write(f"# Torque Constant (Kt): {res.get('Kt', 0):.5f} N*m/A\n")
                    f.write(f"# Max No-Load Speed @ 12V: {res.get('MaxRPM', 0):.1f} RPM\n")
                    f.write(f"# CW/CCW Symmetry: {res.get('Symmetry', 0):.1f} %\n")
                    f.write("# ====================================================================\n\n")

                f.write("Stage,Voltage_V,Measured_RPM,Speed_Ripple_RPM,StdDev_RPM\n")
                for p in pts:
                    f.write(f"{p['stage']},{p['voltage']:.2f},{p['rpm']:.2f},{p['ripple']:.2f},{p['std_dev']:.3f}\n")

            messagebox.showinfo("Export Success", f"KV test report successfully saved to:\n{file_path}")
        except Exception as e:
            messagebox.showerror("Export Error", f"Failed to save report:\n{str(e)}")

    def update_table_and_metrics(self, kv_tree, kv_pts, kv_res, kv_active, btn_run, cards):
        if kv_active:
            btn_run.config(text="🔄 Running KV Sweep...", bg="#FF9100", fg="#000")
            if kv_pts:
                last_pt = kv_pts[-1]
                pct = (last_pt['stage'] / last_pt['total_stages']) * 100.0
                self.progress_var.set(pct)
                self.status_var.set(
                    f"Stage [{last_pt['stage']}/{last_pt['total_stages']}]: Commanded Uq = {last_pt['voltage']:+.1f}V | "
                    f"Measured Speed = {last_pt['rpm']:+.1f} RPM | Ripple = ±{last_pt['ripple']*0.5:.1f} RPM"
                )
        else:
            if kv_res:
                btn_run.config(text="🚀 START 18-Stage KV Sweep (v)", bg="#00E676", fg="#000")
                self.progress_var.set(100.0)
                self.status_var.set(
                    f"✅ KV Sweep Complete! True Motor KV = {kv_res.get('KV', 0):.1f} RPM/V (R² = {kv_res.get('R2', 0):.5f})"
                )

        if kv_res:
            kv_val = kv_res.get('KV', 0.0)
            r2_val = kv_res.get('R2', 0.0)
            v0_val = kv_res.get('V0', 0.0)
            ke_val = kv_res.get('Ke', 0.0)
            kt_val = kv_res.get('Kt', 0.0)
            sym_val = kv_res.get('Symmetry', 0.0)
            max_rpm = kv_res.get('MaxRPM', 0.0)

            cards["kv_true"].config(text=f"{kv_val:.1f} RPM/V")
            cards["kv_r2"].config(text=f"{r2_val:.5f}")
            cards["kv_v0"].config(text=f"{v0_val:.2f} V")
            cards["kv_ke"].config(text=f"{ke_val:.4f} V·s/rad")
            cards["kv_kt"].config(text=f"{kt_val:.4f} N·m/A")
            cards["kv_sym"].config(text=f"{sym_val:.1f} %")
            cards["kv_max_rpm"].config(text=f"{max_rpm:.1f} RPM")
            cards["kv_code"].config(text=f"motor.KV_rating = {kv_val:.1f}f;")
            cards["lbl_r2_tag"].config(text=f"R² Fit: {r2_val:.5f} | KV: {kv_val:.1f} RPM/V")

        current_rows = len(kv_tree.get_children())
        slope = kv_res.get('PhaseKV', kv_res.get('KV', 130.0) * 1.7320508) if kv_res else (130.0 * 1.7320508)
        v0 = kv_res.get('V0', 0.0) if kv_res else 0.0

        if len(kv_pts) > current_rows:
            for i in range(current_rows, len(kv_pts)):
                p = kv_pts[i]
                v = p['voltage']
                rpm = p['rpm']
                if v >= 0:
                    fit_rpm = max(0.0, (v - v0) * slope)
                else:
                    fit_rpm = min(0.0, (v + v0) * slope)
                residual = rpm - fit_rpm

                row_vals = (
                    f"#{p['stage']}",
                    f"{v:+.1f} V",
                    f"{rpm:+.1f} RPM",
                    f"{fit_rpm:+.1f} RPM",
                    f"{residual:+.1f}",
                    f"±{p['ripple']*0.5:.1f}",
                    f"±{p['std_dev']:.2f}"
                )
                kv_tree.insert("", "end", values=row_vals)
            children = kv_tree.get_children()
            if children:
                kv_tree.see(children[-1])
        elif kv_res and not self.table_finalized:
            children = kv_tree.get_children()
            if len(children) == len(kv_pts) and len(kv_pts) > 0:
                for idx, child_id in enumerate(children):
                    p = kv_pts[idx]
                    v = p['voltage']
                    rpm = p['rpm']
                    if v >= 0:
                        fit_rpm = max(0.0, (v - v0) * slope)
                    else:
                        fit_rpm = min(0.0, (v + v0) * slope)
                    residual = rpm - fit_rpm
                    kv_tree.item(child_id, values=(
                        f"#{p['stage']}",
                        f"{v:+.1f} V",
                        f"{rpm:+.1f} RPM",
                        f"{fit_rpm:+.1f} RPM",
                        f"{residual:+.1f}",
                        f"±{p['ripple']*0.5:.1f}",
                        f"±{p['std_dev']:.2f}"
                    ))
                self.table_finalized = True


=== FILE: 3_esp32/ESP32_Main/simplefoc_mt6816_suite/gui/plots.py ===
"""
Canvas drawing utilities:
14-Bit Absolute Angle Compass Dial, Real-Time Oscilloscope,
KV Scatter & Linear Regression Plot, and Rotational Symmetry Needle Meter.
"""

import math


def draw_gauge(canvas, deg):
    try:
        canvas.delete("all")
        w = canvas.winfo_width()
        h = canvas.winfo_height()
        if w < 10 or h < 10:
            return

        cx, cy = w / 2, h / 2
        r = min(cx, cy) - 18

        canvas.create_oval(cx - r, cy - r, cx + r, cy + r, outline="#2A374A", width=3, fill="#121824")
        canvas.create_oval(cx - (r - 10), cy - (r - 10), cx + (r - 10), cy + (r - 10), outline="#1F2A38", width=1)

        for a in range(0, 360, 30):
            rad_a = math.radians(a - 90)
            inner_r = r - 14 if a % 90 == 0 else r - 7
            x1 = cx + (r - 2) * math.cos(rad_a)
            y1 = cy + (r - 2) * math.sin(rad_a)
            x2 = cx + inner_r * math.cos(rad_a)
            y2 = cy + inner_r * math.sin(rad_a)
            color = "#00E5FF" if a % 90 == 0 else "#4A5D78"
            canvas.create_line(x1, y1, x2, y2, fill=color, width=2 if a % 90 == 0 else 1)

            if a % 90 == 0:
                lx = cx + (r - 24) * math.cos(rad_a)
                ly = cy + (r - 24) * math.sin(rad_a)
                canvas.create_text(lx, ly, text=f"{a}°", fill="#8A99AD", font=("Segoe UI", 8, "bold"))

        canvas.create_oval(cx - 8, cy - 8, cx + 8, cy + 8, fill="#00E5FF", outline="#FFFFFF", width=2)

        needle_rad = math.radians(deg - 90)
        nx = cx + (r - 15) * math.cos(needle_rad)
        ny = cy + (r - 15) * math.sin(needle_rad)

        perp_rad = needle_rad + math.pi / 2
        bx1 = cx + 6 * math.cos(perp_rad)
        by1 = cy + 6 * math.sin(perp_rad)
        bx2 = cx - 6 * math.cos(perp_rad)
        by2 = cy - 6 * math.sin(perp_rad)

        canvas.create_polygon(bx1, by1, nx, ny, bx2, by2, fill="#FF5252", outline="#FF1744", width=1)
        canvas.create_line(cx, cy, nx, ny, fill="#FFFFFF", width=2)
        canvas.create_text(cx, cy + (r / 2) + 6, text=f"{deg:.1f}°", fill="#00E5FF", font=("Segoe UI", 14, "bold"))
    except Exception:
        pass


def draw_chart(canvas, reader):
    try:
        with reader.lock:
            hist_act = list(reader.history_actual_rpm)
            hist_tgt = list(reader.history_target_rpm)

        canvas.delete("all")
        w = canvas.winfo_width()
        h = canvas.winfo_height()
        if w < 20 or h < 20 or len(hist_act) < 2:
            return

        cy = h / 2
        canvas.create_line(0, cy, w, cy, fill="#2A374A", width=1, dash=(4, 4))
        canvas.create_text(30, cy - 8, text="0 RPM", fill="#546E7A", font=("Segoe UI", 8))

        max_val = max(100.0, max([abs(x) for x in hist_act + hist_tgt] + [100.0]))
        scale_y = (h / 2 - 10) / max_val

        n = len(hist_act)
        dx = w / max(n - 1, 1)

        pts_tgt = []
        for i, val in enumerate(hist_tgt):
            x = i * dx
            y = cy - (val * scale_y)
            pts_tgt.append((x, y))
        for i in range(len(pts_tgt) - 1):
            canvas.create_line(pts_tgt[i][0], pts_tgt[i][1], pts_tgt[i+1][0], pts_tgt[i+1][1], fill="#FFD600", width=2)

        pts_act = []
        for i, val in enumerate(hist_act):
            x = i * dx
            y = cy - (val * scale_y)
            pts_act.append((x, y))
        for i in range(len(pts_act) - 1):
            canvas.create_line(pts_act[i][0], pts_act[i][1], pts_act[i+1][0], pts_act[i+1][1], fill="#69F0AE", width=2)
    except Exception:
        pass


def draw_kv_scatter_plot(canvas, kv_pts, kv_res):
    try:
        canvas.delete("all")
        w = canvas.winfo_width()
        h = canvas.winfo_height()
        if w < 40 or h < 40:
            return

        pad_left = 80
        pad_right = 30
        pad_top = 30
        pad_bottom = 40

        pw = w - pad_left - pad_right
        ph = h - pad_top - pad_bottom

        cx = pad_left + pw / 2
        cy = pad_top + ph / 2

        canvas.create_rectangle(pad_left, pad_top, pad_left + pw, pad_top + ph, fill="#121722", outline="#222D3E", width=1)

        v_max = 12.0
        rpm_max = 1600.0

        for rpm_val in [-1500, -1000, -500, 0, 500, 1000, 1500]:
            y = cy - (rpm_val / rpm_max) * (ph / 2)
            color = "#37474F" if rpm_val == 0 else "#1F2837"
            width = 2 if rpm_val == 0 else 1
            dash = () if rpm_val == 0 else (2, 4)
            canvas.create_line(pad_left, y, pad_left + pw, y, fill=color, width=width, dash=dash)
            canvas.create_text(pad_left - 8, y, text=f"{rpm_val:+} RPM", fill="#8A99AD", font=("Segoe UI", 8), anchor="e")

        for v_val in [-12, -8, -4, 0, 4, 8, 12]:
            x = cx + (v_val / v_max) * (pw / 2)
            color = "#37474F" if v_val == 0 else "#1F2837"
            width = 2 if v_val == 0 else 1
            dash = () if v_val == 0 else (2, 4)
            canvas.create_line(x, pad_top, x, pad_top + ph, fill=color, width=width, dash=dash)
            canvas.create_text(x, pad_top + ph + 14, text=f"{v_val:+} V", fill="#8A99AD", font=("Segoe UI", 8), anchor="center")

        canvas.create_text(pad_left + pw / 2, pad_top + ph + 30, text="Commanded Q-Axis Voltage Uq (V)", fill="#00E5FF", font=("Segoe UI", 9, "bold"))
        canvas.create_text(18, pad_top + ph / 2, text="Actual Speed (RPM)", fill="#69F0AE", font=("Segoe UI", 9, "bold"), angle=90)

        if kv_res and kv_res.get('KV', 0) > 1.0:
            kv = kv_res['KV']
            v0 = kv_res.get('V0', 0.0)

            # Positive voltage line
            x_start_pos = cx + (v0 / v_max) * (pw / 2)
            y_start_pos = cy
            calc_pos_rpm = (12.0 - v0) * kv
            if calc_pos_rpm > rpm_max:
                v_pos_end = v0 + (rpm_max / kv)
                x_end_pos = cx + (v_pos_end / v_max) * (pw / 2)
                y_end_pos = pad_top
            else:
                x_end_pos = cx + (12.0 / v_max) * (pw / 2)
                y_end_pos = cy - (calc_pos_rpm / rpm_max) * (ph / 2)
            canvas.create_line(x_start_pos, y_start_pos, x_end_pos, y_end_pos, fill="#69F0AE", width=2)

            # Negative voltage line
            x_start_neg = cx - (v0 / v_max) * (pw / 2)
            y_start_neg = cy
            if calc_pos_rpm > rpm_max:
                v_neg_end = v0 + (rpm_max / kv)
                x_end_neg = cx - (v_neg_end / v_max) * (pw / 2)
                y_end_neg = pad_top + ph
            else:
                x_end_neg = cx - (12.0 / v_max) * (pw / 2)
                y_end_neg = cy + (calc_pos_rpm / rpm_max) * (ph / 2)
            canvas.create_line(x_start_neg, y_start_neg, x_end_neg, y_end_neg, fill="#69F0AE", width=2)

            eq_text = f"y = {kv:.1f} · (Uq - {v0:.2f}V)  [R² = {kv_res.get('R2', 0):.5f}]"
            canvas.create_text(pad_left + 15, pad_top + 15, text=eq_text, fill="#69F0AE", font=("Segoe UI", 9, "bold"), anchor="w")

        for pt in kv_pts:
            v = pt['voltage']
            rpm = pt['rpm']
            ripple = pt.get('ripple', 0.0)

            px = cx + (v / v_max) * (pw / 2)
            py = cy - (rpm / rpm_max) * (ph / 2)

            if ripple > 0.5:
                r_half = (ripple * 0.5 / rpm_max) * (ph / 2)
                canvas.create_line(px, py - r_half, px, py + r_half, fill="#546E7A", width=1)
                canvas.create_line(px - 3, py - r_half, px + 3, py - r_half, fill="#546E7A", width=1)
                canvas.create_line(px - 3, py + r_half, px + 3, py + r_half, fill="#546E7A", width=1)

            pt_col = "#00E5FF" if v >= 0 else "#FF4081"
            canvas.create_oval(px - 4, py - 4, px + 4, py + 4, fill=pt_col, outline="#FFFFFF", width=1)
    except Exception:
        pass


def draw_symmetry_needle(canvas, fwd_rpm, rev_rpm):
    try:
        canvas.delete("all")
        w = canvas.winfo_width()
        h = canvas.winfo_height()
        if w < 20 or h < 20:
            return

        cx = w / 2
        cy = h - 25
        r = min(w / 2 - 40, h - 45)

        # Arc background
        canvas.create_arc(cx - r, cy - r, cx + r, cy + r, start=30, extent=120, style="arc", outline="#2A374A", width=4)
        # Center target balanced zone (±10 deg arc)
        canvas.create_arc(cx - r, cy - r, cx + r, cy + r, start=82, extent=16, style="arc", outline="#69F0AE", width=6)

        # Center mark
        canvas.create_line(cx, cy - r - 8, cx, cy - r + 8, fill="#69F0AE", width=2)
        canvas.create_text(cx, cy - r - 16, text="PERFECT 1:1 SYMMETRY", fill="#69F0AE", font=("Segoe UI", 8, "bold"))

        # Reverse (left) and Forward (right) markers
        canvas.create_text(cx - r + 15, cy - 10, text="◀ CCW Faster", fill="#FF4081", font=("Segoe UI", 8, "bold"), anchor="w")
        canvas.create_text(cx + r - 15, cy - 10, text="CW Faster ▶", fill="#00E5FF", font=("Segoe UI", 8, "bold"), anchor="e")

        # Balance deflection angle: -45 deg to +45 deg
        delta = fwd_rpm - rev_rpm
        denom = max(fwd_rpm + rev_rpm, 100.0)
        deflection = (delta / denom) * 45.0
        deflection = max(-50.0, min(50.0, deflection))

        needle_angle_rad = math.radians(90.0 - deflection)
        nx = cx + (r - 10) * math.cos(needle_angle_rad)
        ny = cy - (r - 10) * math.sin(needle_angle_rad)

        needle_col = "#69F0AE" if abs(delta) < 15.0 and fwd_rpm > 10 and rev_rpm > 10 else ("#00E5FF" if delta > 0 else "#FF4081")
        canvas.create_line(cx, cy, nx, ny, fill=needle_col, width=3, arrow="last", arrowshape=(10, 12, 4))
        canvas.create_oval(cx - 6, cy - 6, cx + 6, cy + 6, fill=needle_col, outline="#FFF", width=2)

        diff_str = f"Speed Difference: {delta:+.1f} RPM"
        canvas.create_text(cx, cy + 12, text=diff_str, fill="#FFFFFF", font=("Segoe UI", 9, "bold"))
    except Exception:
        pass


def draw_harmonic_overlay_plot(canvas, bin_points, h_coeffs):
    """
    Draws the 128-slot discrete drag-free spatial bin error points alongside
    the reconstructed smooth analytical harmonic curve (H1 + H2 + H4).
    Displays diagnostic badges for eccentricity, tilt, clamping distortion, and flux saturation.
    """
    try:
        canvas.delete("all")
        w = canvas.winfo_width()
        h = canvas.winfo_height()
        if w < 40 or h < 40:
            return

        pad_left = 65
        pad_right = 30
        pad_top = 40
        pad_bottom = 35

        pw = w - pad_left - pad_right
        ph = h - pad_top - pad_bottom
        cx = pad_left + pw / 2
        cy = pad_top + ph / 2

        # Dark card plot background
        canvas.create_rectangle(pad_left, pad_top, pad_left + pw, pad_top + ph, fill="#121722", outline="#222D3E", width=1)

        # Determine y-axis scale in mechanical degrees
        y_max = 1.0  # default minimum scale +-1.0 deg
        if bin_points:
            # bin_points are in radians -> convert to deg
            max_pt = max(abs(x * 57.2957795) for x in bin_points)
            y_max = max(1.0, max_pt * 1.25)
        elif h_coeffs and h_coeffs.get("PkPk", 0) > 0:
            y_max = max(1.0, (h_coeffs["PkPk"] * 0.5) * 1.3)

        # Horizontal gridlines & Y-labels
        grid_steps = 4
        for step in range(-grid_steps, grid_steps + 1):
            deg_val = (step / grid_steps) * y_max
            y = cy - (deg_val / y_max) * (ph / 2)
            is_zero = (step == 0)
            col = "#37474F" if is_zero else "#1C2433"
            width = 2 if is_zero else 1
            dash = () if is_zero else (2, 4)
            canvas.create_line(pad_left, y, pad_left + pw, y, fill=col, width=width, dash=dash)
            canvas.create_text(pad_left - 8, y, text=f"{deg_val:+.2f}°", fill="#8A99AD" if not is_zero else "#00E5FF",
                               font=("Segoe UI", 8), anchor="e")

        # Vertical gridlines & X-labels (Mechanical Angle 0 to 360 deg)
        for a in [0, 45, 90, 135, 180, 225, 270, 315, 360]:
            x = pad_left + (a / 360.0) * pw
            canvas.create_line(x, pad_top, x, pad_top + ph, fill="#1C2433", width=1, dash=(2, 4))
            canvas.create_text(x, pad_top + ph + 12, text=f"{a}°", fill="#8A99AD", font=("Segoe UI", 8), anchor="center")

        # X-Axis label
        canvas.create_text(pad_left + pw / 2, pad_top + ph + 24, text="Mechanical Rotor Angle θ (degrees)",
                           fill="#8A99AD", font=("Segoe UI", 8, "bold"))

        # Y-Axis label
        canvas.create_text(16, pad_top + ph / 2, text="Angular Error (deg mech)",
                           fill="#00E5FF", font=("Segoe UI", 8, "bold"), angle=90)

        # Plot 128 discrete spatial bin error points (Cyan circles)
        if bin_points and len(bin_points) >= 128:
            pts_count = len(bin_points)
            for i, rad_err in enumerate(bin_points):
                deg_err = rad_err * 57.2957795
                angle_deg = ((i + 0.5) / float(pts_count)) * 360.0
                px = pad_left + (angle_deg / 360.0) * pw
                py = cy - (deg_err / y_max) * (ph / 2)
                py = max(pad_top + 2, min(pad_top + ph - 2, py))
                canvas.create_oval(px - 2.5, py - 2.5, px + 2.5, py + 2.5, fill="#00E5FF", outline="#FFFFFF", width=1)

        # Plot continuous analytical harmonic curve (Green line)
        if h_coeffs and ("A1" in h_coeffs or "H1" in h_coeffs):
            a1 = h_coeffs.get("A1", 0.0)
            b1 = h_coeffs.get("B1", 0.0)
            a2 = h_coeffs.get("A2", 0.0)
            b2 = h_coeffs.get("B2", 0.0)
            a4 = h_coeffs.get("A4", 0.0)
            b4 = h_coeffs.get("B4", 0.0)

            curve_pts = []
            N_STEPS = 240
            for k in range(N_STEPS + 1):
                th = (float(k) / float(N_STEPS)) * (2.0 * math.pi)
                # Double angle identities evaluation:
                sin1 = math.sin(th)
                cos1 = math.cos(th)
                sin2 = 2.0 * sin1 * cos1
                cos2 = cos1 * cos1 - sin1 * sin1
                sin4 = 2.0 * sin2 * cos2
                cos4 = cos2 * cos2 - sin2 * sin2
                harm_rad = (a1 * cos1 + b1 * sin1) + (a2 * cos2 + b2 * sin2) + (a4 * cos4 + b4 * sin4)
                harm_deg = harm_rad * 57.2957795

                px = pad_left + (float(k) / float(N_STEPS)) * pw
                py = cy - (harm_deg / y_max) * (ph / 2)
                py = max(pad_top + 1, min(pad_top + ph - 1, py))
                curve_pts.append((px, py))

            for k in range(len(curve_pts) - 1):
                canvas.create_line(curve_pts[k][0], curve_pts[k][1], curve_pts[k+1][0], curve_pts[k+1][1],
                                   fill="#69F0AE", width=2)

        # Header Legend & Diagnostic Summary
        legend_x = pad_left + 10
        legend_y = pad_top - 24

        # Legend dots
        canvas.create_oval(legend_x, legend_y - 4, legend_x + 8, legend_y + 4, fill="#00E5FF", outline="#FFF")
        canvas.create_text(legend_x + 12, legend_y, text="128-Bin Drag-Free Samples", fill="#00E5FF", font=("Segoe UI", 8, "bold"), anchor="w")

        canvas.create_line(legend_x + 180, legend_y, legend_x + 200, legend_y, fill="#69F0AE", width=2)
        canvas.create_text(legend_x + 205, legend_y, text="Reconstructed Harmonics (H1+H2+H4)", fill="#69F0AE", font=("Segoe UI", 8, "bold"), anchor="w")

        # Diagnostics Badges (Right-aligned in header)
        if h_coeffs:
            h1 = h_coeffs.get("H1", 0.0)
            h2 = h_coeffs.get("H2", 0.0)
            h3 = h_coeffs.get("H3", 0.0)
            h4 = h_coeffs.get("H4", 0.0)
            pk = h_coeffs.get("PkPk", 0.0)
            r2 = h_coeffs.get("R2", 0.0)
            res_pk = h_coeffs.get("ResPkPk", 0.0)

            clamp_alert = h1 > 0.05 and h3 > 0.20 * h1
            sat_alert = h1 > 0.05 and h4 > 0.25 * h1

            r2_str = f" | R²: {r2*100.0:.1f}%" if r2 > 0 else ""
            res_str = f" | Res: ±{res_pk*0.5:.3f}°" if res_pk > 0 else ""
            stat_txt = f"H1: ±{h1:.3f}° | H2: ±{h2:.3f}° | H3: ±{h3:.3f}°{' ⚠️' if clamp_alert else ''} | H4: ±{h4:.3f}°{' ⚠️' if sat_alert else ''} | Pk-Pk: {pk:.3f}°{r2_str}{res_str}"
            canvas.create_text(w - pad_right, legend_y, text=stat_txt, fill="#FFD600" if (clamp_alert or sat_alert) else "#E0E0E0",
                               font=("Segoe UI", 8, "bold"), anchor="e")
        else:
            if not bin_points:
                canvas.create_text(cx, cy, text="Click '🚀 Continuous Harmonic Calib' to sweep and render 128-slot spatial harmonic model",
                                   fill="#546E7A", font=("Segoe UI", 10, "italic"))
    except Exception:
        pass



=== FILE: 3_esp32/ESP32_Main/simplefoc_mt6816_suite/gui/serial_comm.py ===
"""
High-Speed Serial Communication Engine for ESP32-S3 SimpleFOC & MT6816/MT6818.
Handles asynchronous RX parsing, thread safety, auto-reconnect, and emergency stop bursts.
"""

import math
import queue
import re
import threading
import time
import serial

from .utils import find_esp32_port


class ESP32SerialReader:
    def __init__(self, port=None, baud=921600):
        self.port = port
        self.baud = baud
        self.ser = None
        self.running = False
        self.connected = False
        self.thread = None
        self.raw_log_queue = queue.Queue(maxsize=3000)
        self.lock = threading.Lock()

        # Telemetry State
        self.last_angle_deg = 0.0
        self.last_angle_rad = 0.0
        self.last_raw_14bit = 0
        self.last_target_rpm = 0.0
        self.last_actual_rpm = 0.0
        self.last_uq = 0.0
        self.last_ud = 0.0
        self.last_pwm_deg = 0.0
        self.last_pwm_duty = 0.0
        self.last_pwm_freq = 0
        self.last_control_mode = "DISABLED"
        self.last_bus_mode = "4-Wire"
        self.last_lut_active = False
        self.last_mag_ok = True
        self.last_parity_ok = True
        self.last_stall_alarm = False
        self.last_stall_guard = False
        self.last_foc_khz = 0.0
        self.last_lat_avg_us = 0.0
        self.last_lat_max_us = 0.0
        self.last_spikes_count = 0
        self.calibrating = False
        self.calib_stage_name = "Ready"
        self.calib_progress_pct = 0.0
        self.calib_cooldown_sec = 0
        self.last_calib_zero_angle = None
        self.last_zero_electric_angle = 0.97555
        self.last_calib_success = False
        self.last_calib_failed = False
        self.last_calib_grade = ""
        self.last_calib_error = ""
        self.last_sensor_direction = -1
        self.msg_count = 0

        # Harmonic Calibration & Benchmark State
        self.harmonic_results = {}
        self.harmonic_bins = []
        self.bench_compare_results = {}
        self.last_correction_mode = 0
        self.spi_bench_results = []
        self.active_spi_mhz = 4.0

        # KV Test Streaming & Results State
        self.kv_test_active = False
        self.kv_points = []
        self.kv_results = {}

        # Dedicated GA Telemetry State & Sample Buffer
        self.ga_stream_active = False
        self.ga_samples = []

        self.history_time = []
        self.history_target_rpm = []
        self.history_actual_rpm = []
        self.history_angle = []
        self.start_time = time.time()

    def connect(self):
        if not self.port:
            self.port = find_esp32_port()
        if not self.port:
            raise RuntimeError("No ESP32-S3 USB Serial port found! Ensure ESP32-S3 is plugged in.")
        try:
            self.disconnect()
            self.ser = serial.Serial(self.port, self.baud, timeout=0.05, write_timeout=0.2)
            self.ser.dtr = True
            self.ser.rts = True
            self.running = True
            self.connected = True
            self.thread = threading.Thread(target=self._read_loop, daemon=True)
            self.thread.start()
            return True
        except Exception as e:
            self.running = False
            self.connected = False
            raise e

    def disconnect(self):
        self.running = False
        self.connected = False
        if self.ser:
            try:
                if self.ser.is_open:
                    self.ser.close()
            except Exception:
                pass
    def clear_ga_samples(self):
        with self.lock:
            self.ga_samples.clear()

    def get_ga_samples(self):
        with self.lock:
            return list(self.ga_samples)

    def send_cmd(self, cmd_str):
        if self.ser and self.ser.is_open and self.connected:
            try:
                if not cmd_str.endswith("\n"):
                    cmd_str += "\n"
                self.ser.write(cmd_str.encode("utf-8"))
            except Exception:
                self.connected = False

    def send_emergency_stop(self):
        """High-priority emergency stop burst that guarantees packet delivery even with dirty RX buffer."""
        with self.lock:
            self.kv_test_active = False
            self.calibrating = False
        if self.ser and self.ser.is_open:
            try:
                # Transmit a clean newline break followed by multiple 'x' commands
                burst = b"\n\nx\nx\nx\n"
                self.ser.write(burst)
                try:
                    self.ser.flush()
                except Exception:
                    pass
                self.connected = True
            except Exception:
                self.connected = False
        else:
            # If temporarily marked disconnected, attempt quick connect and send
            try:
                if self.port:
                    self.ser = serial.Serial(self.port, self.baud, timeout=0.05, write_timeout=0.2)
                    self.ser.write(b"\n\nx\nx\nx\n")
                    self.ser.flush()
                    self.connected = True
            except Exception:
                pass

    def _read_loop(self):
        buffer = ""
        while self.running:
            if not self.ser or not self.ser.is_open or not self.connected:
                time.sleep(0.5)
                try:
                    if self.ser:
                        try:
                            self.ser.close()
                        except Exception:
                            pass
                        self.ser = None
                    port = self.port or find_esp32_port()
                    if port:
                        self.port = port
                        self.ser = serial.Serial(self.port, self.baud, timeout=0.05, write_timeout=0.2)
                        self.ser.dtr = True
                        self.ser.rts = True
                        self.connected = True
                        buffer = ""
                except Exception:
                    continue

            try:
                data = self.ser.read(256).decode("utf-8", errors="ignore")
                if not data:
                    time.sleep(0.005)
                    continue
                buffer += data
                while "\n" in buffer:
                    line, buffer = buffer.split("\n", 1)
                    line = line.strip("\r")
                    if line:
                        if not line.startswith("[GA]:"):
                            try:
                                self.raw_log_queue.put_nowait(line)
                            except queue.Full:
                                try:
                                    self.raw_log_queue.get_nowait()
                                    self.raw_log_queue.put_nowait(line)
                                except Exception:
                                    pass
                        self._parse_line(line)
            except Exception:
                self.connected = False
                try:
                    if self.ser and self.ser.is_open:
                        self.ser.close()
                except Exception:
                    pass
                time.sleep(0.2)

    def _parse_line(self, line):
        if line.startswith("[GA]:"):
            try:
                payload = line[5:].strip()
                parts = payload.split(",")
                act = float(parts[0])
                uq = float(parts[1])
                t_now = time.time()
                with self.lock:
                    self.last_actual_rpm = act
                    self.last_uq = uq
                    self.ga_samples.append((t_now, act, uq))
                    if len(self.ga_samples) > 2000:
                        self.ga_samples = self.ga_samples[-1000:]
                    self.history_time.append(t_now - self.start_time)
                    self.history_target_rpm.append(self.last_target_rpm)
                    self.history_actual_rpm.append(act)
                    self.history_angle.append(self.last_angle_deg)
                    if len(self.history_time) > 150:
                        self.history_time.pop(0)
                        self.history_target_rpm.pop(0)
                        self.history_actual_rpm.pop(0)
                        self.history_angle.pop(0)
                    self.msg_count += 1
            except Exception:
                pass
            return

        if "SAFETY SHUTDOWN: Motor Stall" in line or "Motor stall/overload" in line or "Motor Stall / Overload" in line:
            with self.lock:
                self.last_stall_alarm = True
                self.last_control_mode = "DISABLED"
            return

        if "[KV_START]" in line:
            with self.lock:
                self.kv_test_active = True
                self.kv_points = []
                self.kv_results = {}
            return

        if "[KV_POINT]:" in line:
            try:
                m_stg = re.search(r'Stage=(\d+)/(\d+)', line)
                m_v = re.search(r'V=([+-]?\d+\.?\d*)', line)
                m_rpm = re.search(r'RPM=([+-]?\d+\.?\d*)', line)
                m_rip = re.search(r'Ripple=([+-]?\d+\.?\d*)', line)
                m_sd = re.search(r'StdDev=([+-]?\d+\.?\d*)', line)
                if m_v and m_rpm:
                    pt = {
                        "stage": int(m_stg.group(1)) if m_stg else len(self.kv_points) + 1,
                        "total_stages": int(m_stg.group(2)) if m_stg else 18,
                        "voltage": float(m_v.group(1)),
                        "rpm": float(m_rpm.group(1)),
                        "ripple": float(m_rip.group(1)) if m_rip else 0.0,
                        "std_dev": float(m_sd.group(1)) if m_sd else 0.0
                    }
                    with self.lock:
                        self.kv_points.append(pt)
                        self.kv_test_active = True
            except Exception:
                pass
            return

        if "[KV_RESULT]:" in line:
            try:
                res = {}
                for item in line.split("[KV_RESULT]:")[1].split(","):
                    if "=" in item:
                        k, v = item.strip().split("=", 1)
                        res[k.strip()] = float(v.strip())

=== FILE: 3_esp32/ESP32_Main/simplefoc_mt6816_suite/gui/symmetry_equalizer.py ===
"""
Rotational symmetry test, multi-resolution brute-force electrical zero optimizer,
and CW/CCW directional equalizer engine for SimpleFOC.
"""

import math
import threading
import time
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import ttk, messagebox


class SymmetryEqualizer:
    def __init__(self, reader, root, progress_var, status_var, on_zero_angle_updated=None):
        self.reader = reader
        self.root = root
        self.progress_var = progress_var
        self.status_var = status_var
        self.on_zero_angle_updated = on_zero_angle_updated

        self.current_zero_angle_rad = 0.97555
        self.running = False
        self.thread = None
        self.fwd_rpm = 0.0
        self.rev_rpm = 0.0

    def toggle(self, btn_auto_sym, sym_tree, entry_sym_v, entry_zero_angle, entry_align_v, entry_kv, chk_recalib_var):
        if self.running:
            self.running = False
            btn_auto_sym.config(text="🚀 1-CLICK AUTO-EQUALIZE SYMMETRY", bg="#00E676", fg="#000")
            self.status_var.set("Auto Equalizer Aborted by User.")
            self.reader.send_cmd("v0.0")
        else:
            if not self.reader.connected:
                messagebox.showerror("Connection Error", "Please connect to ESP32-S3 first!")
                return
            self.running = True
            btn_auto_sym.config(text="⏹️ Stop Auto Equalizer", bg="#D50000", fg="#FFF")
            self.thread = threading.Thread(
                target=self._run_worker,
                args=(btn_auto_sym, sym_tree, entry_sym_v, entry_zero_angle, entry_align_v, entry_kv, chk_recalib_var),
                daemon=True
            )
            self.thread.start()

    def abort(self):
        self.running = False
        self.status_var.set("🛑 EMERGENCY STOP: Stator coils de-energized.")

    def _cleanup_ui(self, btn_auto_sym):
        self.running = False
        self.root.after(0, lambda: btn_auto_sym.config(text="🚀 1-CLICK AUTO-EQUALIZE SYMMETRY", bg="#00E676", fg="#000"))

    def _measure_candidate_angle(self, candidate_angle, stage_name, v_test, base_zero, sym_tree):
        if not self.running:
            return None

        # 1. Update Zero Angle on ESP32-S3
        self.reader.send_cmd(f"j{candidate_angle:.5f}")
        self.current_zero_angle_rad = candidate_angle
        if self.on_zero_angle_updated:
            self.root.after(0, lambda a=candidate_angle: self.on_zero_angle_updated(a))
        time.sleep(0.05)

        # 2. Forward Spin (+V): Smooth 1.8s settle with stall penalty (no E-stop shutdown)
        self.reader.send_cmd(f"v{v_test:.2f}")
        t_spin = time.time()
        stall_time_s = 0.0
        last_t = time.time()
        while time.time() - t_spin < 1.8:
            if not self.running:
                self.reader.send_cmd("v0.0")
                return None

            now = time.time()
            dt = now - last_t
            last_t = now

            with self.reader.lock:
                live_spd = abs(self.reader.last_actual_rpm)

            if (now - t_spin) > 0.2:
                if live_spd < 3.0:
                    stall_time_s += dt
                    if stall_time_s >= 0.50:
                        self.reader.send_cmd("v0.0")
                        time.sleep(0.3)
                        self._record_sym_row(sym_tree, stage_name, candidate_angle, base_zero, 0.0, 0.0, "[STALL - 0 RPM]", v_test=v_test)
                        return {"angle": candidate_angle, "fwd": 0, "rev": 0, "delta": 0, "sym": 0, "kv": 0, "score": 0, "status": "[STALL]", "is_valid": False}
                else:
                    stall_time_s = 0.0
            time.sleep(0.02)

        fwd_samples = []
        for _ in range(30):  # 30 samples over ~0.9s for noise immunity
            if not self.running:
                self.reader.send_cmd("v0.0")
                return None
            with self.reader.lock:
                fwd_samples.append(abs(self.reader.last_actual_rpm))
            time.sleep(0.03)
        fwd_rpm = sum(fwd_samples) / max(1, len(fwd_samples))
        self.fwd_rpm = fwd_rpm

        # Soft stop & cool-down pause
        self.reader.send_cmd("v0.0")
        t_stop = time.time()
        while time.time() - t_stop < 0.50:
            if not self.running:
                return None
            time.sleep(0.02)

        if not self.running:
            return None

        # 3. Reverse Spin (-V): Smooth 1.8s settle
        self.reader.send_cmd(f"v-{v_test:.2f}")
        t_rev = time.time()
        stall_time_s = 0.0
        last_t = time.time()
        while time.time() - t_rev < 1.8:
            if not self.running:
                self.reader.send_cmd("v0.0")
                return None

            now = time.time()
            dt = now - last_t
            last_t = now

            with self.reader.lock:
                live_spd = abs(self.reader.last_actual_rpm)

            if (now - t_rev) > 0.2:
                if live_spd < 3.0:
                    stall_time_s += dt
                    if stall_time_s >= 0.50:
                        self.reader.send_cmd("v0.0")
                        time.sleep(0.3)
                        self._record_sym_row(sym_tree, stage_name, candidate_angle, base_zero, fwd_rpm, 0.0, "[STALL - 0 RPM]", v_test=v_test)
                        return {"angle": candidate_angle, "fwd": fwd_rpm, "rev": 0, "delta": 0, "sym": 0, "kv": 0, "score": 0, "status": "[STALL]", "is_valid": False}
                else:
                    stall_time_s = 0.0
            time.sleep(0.02)

        rev_samples = []
        for _ in range(30):
            if not self.running:
                self.reader.send_cmd("v0.0")
                return None
            with self.reader.lock:
                rev_samples.append(abs(self.reader.last_actual_rpm))
            time.sleep(0.03)
        rev_rpm = sum(rev_samples) / max(1, len(rev_samples))
        self.rev_rpm = rev_rpm

        # Soft stop & inter-candidate cooldown
        self.reader.send_cmd("v0.0")
        t_stop2 = time.time()
        while time.time() - t_stop2 < 0.50:
            if not self.running:
                return None
            time.sleep(0.02)

        # 4. Evaluation & Precision Score
        delta_rpm = fwd_rpm - rev_rpm
        is_stalled = (fwd_rpm < 15.0 or rev_rpm < 15.0)
        mean_rpm = (fwd_rpm + rev_rpm) * 0.5
        stage_kv = mean_rpm / max(0.1, v_test)
        max_rpm = max(fwd_rpm, rev_rpm, 1.0)
        sym_pct = (min(fwd_rpm, rev_rpm) / max_rpm) * 100.0 if not is_stalled else 0.0

        if is_stalled:
            score = 0.0
            status = "[STALL - LOW RPM]"
            is_valid = False
        else:
            score = sym_pct * (1.0 + 0.001 * mean_rpm)
            status = f"OK ({sym_pct:.1f}%)"
            is_valid = True

        self._record_sym_row(sym_tree, stage_name, candidate_angle, base_zero, fwd_rpm, rev_rpm, status, v_test=v_test)

        return {
            "angle": candidate_angle,
            "fwd": fwd_rpm,
            "rev": rev_rpm,
            "delta": delta_rpm,
            "sym": sym_pct,
            "kv": stage_kv,
            "score": score,
            "status": status,
            "is_valid": is_valid
        }

    def _record_sym_row(self, sym_tree, stage_name, candidate_angle, base_zero, fwd_rpm, rev_rpm, status, v_test=4.0):
        nudge_val = (candidate_angle - base_zero + math.pi) % (2.0 * math.pi) - math.pi
        delta_rpm = fwd_rpm - rev_rpm
        max_rpm = max(fwd_rpm, rev_rpm, 1.0)
        sym_pct = (min(fwd_rpm, rev_rpm) / max_rpm) * 100.0 if (fwd_rpm > 5.0 and rev_rpm > 5.0) else 0.0
        stage_kv = ((fwd_rpm + rev_rpm) * 0.5) / max(0.1, v_test)

        row_data = (
            stage_name,
            f"{candidate_angle:.5f}",
            f"{candidate_angle*57.29578:.2f}°",
            f"{nudge_val:+.5f} rad",
            f"{fwd_rpm:+.1f} RPM",
            f"-{rev_rpm:.1f} RPM",
            f"{delta_rpm:+.1f} RPM",
            f"{sym_pct:.1f} %",
            f"{stage_kv:.1f} RPM/V",
            status
        )
        self.root.after(0, lambda r=row_data: [
            sym_tree.insert("", "end", values=r),
            sym_tree.see(sym_tree.get_children()[-1])
        ])

    def _run_worker(self, btn_auto_sym, sym_tree, entry_sym_v, entry_zero_angle, entry_align_v, entry_kv, chk_recalib_var):
        try:
            v_test = abs(float(entry_sym_v.get().strip()))
        except Exception:
            v_test = 4.0

        # Clear report table in UI
        self.root.after(0, lambda: [
            sym_tree.delete(item) for item in sym_tree.get_children()
        ])

        # Step 0: If checked, re-run 11-pole continuous alignment first
        if chk_recalib_var.get() and self.running:
            self.status_var.set("Phase 0/3: Re-running 11-Pole Alignment Sweep first...")
            with self.reader.lock:
                self.reader.last_calib_zero_angle = None
                self.reader.calibrating = True
                self.reader.last_calib_failed = False
            cal_v = entry_align_v.get().strip() or "4.0"
            self.reader.send_cmd(f"c{cal_v}")
            t_align = time.time()
            time.sleep(1.0)
            while time.time() - t_align < 35:
                if not self.running:
                    self.reader.send_cmd("x")
                    return
                with self.reader.lock:
                    if not self.reader.calibrating and (self.reader.last_calib_zero_angle is not None or self.reader.last_calib_failed):
                        break
                time.sleep(0.3)
            time.sleep(0.5)

        # Baseline Zero
        with self.reader.lock:
            latest_zero = self.reader.last_calib_zero_angle or self.reader.last_zero_electric_angle
        try:
            base_zero = latest_zero if (chk_recalib_var.get() and latest_zero is not None) else float(entry_zero_angle.get().strip())
        except ValueError:
            base_zero = latest_zero if latest_zero is not None else self.current_zero_angle_rad

        if self.on_zero_angle_updated:
            self.root.after(0, lambda z=base_zero: self.on_zero_angle_updated(z))

        self.current_zero_angle_rad = base_zero
        all_results = []

        # PASS 1: WIDE COARSE EXPLORATION (±0.040 rad / ±2.3° elec)
        self.status_var.set("Pass 1/3: Coarse Bracket Sweep across Baseline ±0.040 rad...")
        coarse_offsets = [0.0000, +0.0200, -0.0200, +0.0400, -0.0400]
        pass1_results = []

        for i, off in enumerate(coarse_offsets, 1):
            if not self.running:
                break
            self.progress_var.set((i / len(coarse_offsets)) * 35.0)
            ang = (base_zero + off) % (2.0 * math.pi)
            label = f"Coarse #{i} ({off:+.4f})"
            res = self._measure_candidate_angle(ang, label, v_test, base_zero, sym_tree)
            if res:
                pass1_results.append(res)
                all_results.append(res)

        valid_pass1 = [r for r in pass1_results if r["is_valid"]]
        if not valid_pass1:
            self.status_var.set("❌ Motor stalled or no valid movements recorded during Pass 1.")
            self._cleanup_ui(btn_auto_sym)
            return

        best_coarse = max(valid_pass1, key=lambda r: r["score"])
        best_angle = best_coarse["angle"]

        # PASS 2: MEDIUM ZOOM SWEEP (±0.008 rad around Coarse Winner)
        pass2_results = [best_coarse]
        if self.running:
            self.status_var.set(f"Pass 2/3: Medium Zooming around Winner ({best_angle*57.3:.2f}°)...")
            med_offsets = [+0.0080, -0.0080, +0.0040, -0.0040]

            for i, off in enumerate(med_offsets, 1):
                if not self.running:
                    break
                self.progress_var.set(35.0 + (i / len(med_offsets)) * 35.0)
                ang = (best_angle + off) % (2.0 * math.pi)
                label = f"Med #{i} ({off:+.4f})"
                res = self._measure_candidate_angle(ang, label, v_test, base_zero, sym_tree)
                if res:
                    pass2_results.append(res)
                    all_results.append(res)

        valid_pass2 = [r for r in pass2_results if r["is_valid"]]
        best_med = max(valid_pass2, key=lambda r: r["score"]) if valid_pass2 else best_coarse
        best_angle2 = best_med["angle"]

        # PASS 3: FINE MICRO-TRIM (±0.0015 rad for >99% Symmetry)
        pass3_results = [best_med]
        if self.running:
            self.status_var.set("Pass 3/3: Fine Micro-Trimming for >99% Symmetry...")
            fine_offsets = [+0.0015, -0.0015, +0.0007, -0.0007]

            for i, off in enumerate(fine_offsets, 1):
                if not self.running:
                    break
                self.progress_var.set(70.0 + (i / len(fine_offsets)) * 30.0)
                ang = (best_angle2 + off) % (2.0 * math.pi)
                label = f"Fine #{i} ({off:+.4f})"
                res = self._measure_candidate_angle(ang, label, v_test, base_zero, sym_tree)
                if res:
                    pass3_results.append(res)
                    all_results.append(res)

        valid_pass3 = [r for r in pass3_results if r["is_valid"]]
        winner = max(valid_pass3, key=lambda r: r["score"]) if valid_pass3 else best_med

        if not self.running:
            self.status_var.set("Auto Equalizer Aborted by User.")
            self._cleanup_ui(btn_auto_sym)
            self.reader.send_cmd("v0.0")
            return

        final_ang = winner["angle"]
        final_kv = max(100.0, min(180.0, winner.get("kv", 130.0)))
        final_sym = winner.get("sym", 95.0)

        self.current_zero_angle_rad = final_ang
        self.reader.send_cmd(f"j{final_ang:.5f}")
        self.reader.send_cmd("v0.0")

        self.progress_var.set(100.0)
        self.status_var.set(
            f"🎉 Optimization Complete! Neutral Zero = {final_ang:.5f} rad ({final_ang*57.29578:.2f}°) | Sym = {final_sym:.1f}% | Δ = {winner['delta']:+.1f} RPM"
        )
        self._cleanup_ui(btn_auto_sym)

        # Update UI Entries
        self.root.after(0, lambda k=final_kv, a=final_ang: [
            entry_kv.delete(0, "end"),
            entry_kv.insert(0, f"{k:.1f}"),
        ])
        if self.on_zero_angle_updated:
            self.root.after(0, lambda a=final_ang: self.on_zero_angle_updated(a))


=== FILE: 3_esp32/ESP32_Main/simplefoc_mt6816_suite/gui/utils.py ===
"""
Utilities for finding PlatformIO and ESP32 serial COM ports.
"""

import os
import shutil
import serial.tools.list_ports


def find_pio_executable():
    """Locate platformio executable in PATH or user home directory."""
    for name in ["pio", "platformio", "pio.exe", "platformio.exe"]:
        p = shutil.which(name)
        if p:
            return p
    user_home = os.path.expanduser("~")
    candidates = [
        os.path.join(user_home, ".platformio", "penv", "Scripts", "platformio.exe"),
        os.path.join(user_home, ".platformio", "penv", "Scripts", "pio.exe"),
        os.path.join(user_home, ".platformio", "penv", "bin", "platformio"),
        os.path.join(user_home, ".platformio", "penv", "bin", "pio"),
    ]
    for c in candidates:
        if os.path.isfile(c):
            return c
    return "platformio"


def find_esp32_port():
    """Auto-detect connected ESP32 USB serial COM port."""
    for p in serial.tools.list_ports.comports():
        hw = (p.hwid or "").upper()
        desc = (p.description or "").upper()
        if (
            "303A" in hw
            or "1A86" in hw
            or "10C4" in hw
            or "ESP" in desc
            or "CH34" in desc
            or "CP210" in desc
            or "USB" in desc
            or "SERIAL" in desc
        ):
            return p.device
    return "COM5"

// ============================================================================
// FOLKRACE — ESP32-S3 MT6816 SPI ENCODER & SIMPLEFOC SUITE (GM3506 @ 12V)
// 11-POLE CONTINUOUS ZERO VECTOR + 2-HARMONIC FOURIER + DYNAMIC SPEED LAG TRIM
// + NVS FLASH SAVE / LOAD PROFILE PERSISTENCE
// ============================================================================
// Target Board : ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1 (240MHz Dual Core)
// Driver Pins  : GPIO 15 (Phase A), GPIO 16 (Phase B), GPIO 17 (Phase C), GPIO
// 2 (EN) Encoder Pins : GPIO 12 (SCK), GPIO 11 (MOSI), GPIO 13 (MISO), GPIO 10
// (CS) Thermistor   : GPIO 4 (ADC1_CH3)
// ============================================================================

#include "esp_cpu.h"
#include "esp_task_wdt.h"
#include <Arduino.h>
#include <Preferences.h>
#include <SPI.h>
#include <SimpleFOC.h>

// 1. MOTOR & HARDWARE CONFIGURATION
#define MOTOR_POLE_PAIRS 11              // GM3506 (24N22P = 11 Pole Pairs)
#define MOTOR_PHASE_RESISTANCE_OHM 5.60f // Phase-to-Phase / 2 = 5.6 Ohm
#define POWER_SUPPLY_VOLTAGE 12.0f       // 12V DC Regulated Bench Supply
#define CALIBRATION_VOLTAGE                                                    \
  4.00f // Default Open-Loop Calibration Step Voltage (4.0V ~ 0.65A)
#define CALIBRATION_HOLD_VOLTAGE                                               \
  2.40f // Thermal Relief Hold Voltage during Settle & Sample for LUT (2.4V)
#define CALIBRATION_BOOST_VOLTAGE                                              \
  4.20f // Automatic Boost Voltage on Stall / Pole-Slip Detection (4.2V)

// 2. BUS & PROTOCOL SETTINGS
#define SPI_SPEED_DEFAULT_HZ                                                   \
  4000000 // MT6816 SPI Master Baud (4 MHz with 15cm 22R termination)
#define SPI_USE_3WIRE_DEFAULT false // Default 4-Wire Hardware SPI
#define SENSOR_LAG_COMP_DEFAULT_US                                             \
  35.0f // Default Dynamic Lag Lead Compensation (us)
#define DEFAULT_LPF_TF_MS                                                      \
  3.0f // Velocity Low-Pass Filter Tf in ms (3.0 ms gives razor-sharp response)
#define DEFAULT_LPF_TF_SEC (DEFAULT_LPF_TF_MS * 0.001f)

// 3. 128-POINT ENCODER NON-LINEARITY LUT CONSTANTS
#define ENCODER_LUT_SIZE 128 // 128-point calibration table
// Maximum allowed single-point correction before pole-slip is declared:
#define LUT_ANOMALY_THRESHOLD_RAD                                              \
  0.035f // > 2.0 deg mech (~22 deg elec) = pole slip / stall
// Maximum allowed peak-to-peak span across the whole table:
#define LUT_PKPK_LIMIT_RAD                                                     \
  0.06f // > 3.44 deg mech (~38 deg elec) = bad sweep / binding
#define CALIB_SWEEP_STEPS                                                      \
  256 // Number of micro-steps across 360 mechanical degrees
#define CALIB_SWEEP_DAMP_SETTLE_MS                                             \
  65 // High-accuracy damp settle before sampling (65 ms for conservative
     // margin)
#define CALIB_SWEEP_OVERSAMPLE_COUNT                                           \
  96 // Static samples per sweep point for noise rejection
#define ALIGNMENT_OVERSAMPLE_COUNT                                             \
  96 // Samples per pole point during electrical zero alignment
#define CALIB_COOLDOWN_PAUSE_SEC 5 // Thermal relief cooldown duration between calibration passes (seconds)

// 4. TIMING, LOOP RATES & SAMPLING FREQUENCIES
#define TELEMETRY_STREAM_INTERVAL_MS                                           \
  50 // Serial Live Streaming Interval (50ms = 20 Hz)

// 5. REAL-TIME TUNABLE DEFAULT FOC PARAMETERS
#define DEFAULT_VOLTAGE_LIMIT                                                  \
  (POWER_SUPPLY_VOLTAGE / 1.7320508f) // 6.93V Maximum linear phase voltage (V) for SpaceVectorPWM
#define DEFAULT_VELOCITY_LIMIT_RPM                                             \
  1432.0f // Maximum velocity limit (1432 RPM = 150 rad/s)
#define DEFAULT_OUTPUT_RAMP_V_PER_S                                            \
  200.0f                      // Output voltage ramp rate limit (200 V/s)
#define DEFAULT_PID_P 0.1200f // Velocity Proportional Gain
#define DEFAULT_PID_I 1.2000f // Velocity Integral Gain
#define DEFAULT_PID_D 0.0000f // Velocity Derivative Gain
#define DEFAULT_MOTOR_KV_RATING                                                \
  130.0f // Initial Back-EMF Feedforward KV rating (RPM/V)

// 6. AUTOMATED CLOSED-LOOP KV TEST PARAMETERS
#define KV_DWELL_TIME_MS                                                       \
  1200 // Settle time for motor to reach steady terminal velocity (ms)
#define KV_SAMPLE_TIME_MS 600      // Velocity sampling window duration (ms)
#define KV_SAMPLE_INTERVAL_US 5000 // Velocity sampling rate (5000 us = 200 Hz)
#define STAGE_SAMPLE_CAP 200

// ============================================================================
// ESP32-S3 PIN DEFINITIONS
// ============================================================================
#define PIN_SCK 12   // SPI2 SCK (Clock)
#define PIN_MOSI 11  // SPI2 MOSI (Master Out / 3-Wire SDAT)
#define PIN_MISO 13  // SPI2 MISO (Master In)
#define PIN_CS_M1 10 // Dedicated Encoder 1 CS

// Motor 1 Inverter Driver Pins (MCPWM0)
#define M1_PWM_A 15 // Phase A (MCPWM0_OP0A)
#define M1_PWM_B 16 // Phase B (MCPWM0_OP0B)
#define M1_PWM_C 17 // Phase C (MCPWM0_OP1A)
#define M1_EN 2     // Gate Driver Enable

// Analog Sensors
#define PIN_THERM_M1 4 // ADC1_CH3

// ============================================================================
// MT6816 Sensor Driver with Fourier Harmonic Linearization
// ============================================================================
class MT6816Sensor : public Sensor {
public:
  int cs_pin;
  uint32_t spi_speed;
  uint8_t spi_mode;
  bool use_3wire;

  // Mode Selector: 0 = Raw, 1 = 128-Point Stepped LUT, 2 = Continuous Analytical Harmonics
  uint8_t correction_mode;

  // Active Harmonic Coefficients (Analytical runtime reconstruction)
  float fourier_A1, fourier_B1; // 1st Harmonic: Eccentricity / Runout
  float fourier_A2, fourier_B2; // 2nd Harmonic: Magnet Tilt / Ellipticity
  float fourier_A3, fourier_B3; // 3rd Harmonic: 3-Point Mechanical Clamping Distortion (Diagnostic)
  float fourier_A4, fourier_B4; // 4th Harmonic: Hall Bridge Mismatch & Flux Saturation
  float lut_errors[ENCODER_LUT_SIZE];
  bool is_lut_calibrated;

  // Harmonic Fit & Physical Diagnostic Metrics
  float harmonic_r_squared;
  float harmonic_pk_pk_deg;
  float harmonic_rms_deg;
  float harmonic_res_pk_pk_deg;
  float harmonic_res_rms_deg;
  float harmonic_mean_lag_deg;
  float harmonic_lag_ripple_deg;
  float harmonic_max_drag_angle_deg;

  // Diagnostics & Tracking
  uint32_t total_reads;
  uint32_t parity_errors;
  uint32_t parity_retries;
  uint32_t mag_faults;
  bool last_no_mag;
  bool last_parity_ok;
  uint8_t last_raw_h;
  uint8_t last_raw_l;
  uint16_t last_raw_14bit;
  float zero_offset_deg;

  MT6816Sensor()
      : cs_pin(PIN_CS_M1), spi_speed(SPI_SPEED_DEFAULT_HZ), spi_mode(SPI_MODE3),
        use_3wire(SPI_USE_3WIRE_DEFAULT), correction_mode(0),
        fourier_A1(0.0f), fourier_B1(0.0f),
        fourier_A2(0.0f), fourier_B2(0.0f),
        fourier_A3(0.0f), fourier_B3(0.0f),
        fourier_A4(0.0f), fourier_B4(0.0f),
        is_lut_calibrated(false),
        harmonic_r_squared(0.0f), harmonic_pk_pk_deg(0.0f), harmonic_rms_deg(0.0f),
        harmonic_res_pk_pk_deg(0.0f), harmonic_res_rms_deg(0.0f),
        harmonic_mean_lag_deg(0.0f), harmonic_lag_ripple_deg(0.0f),
        harmonic_max_drag_angle_deg(0.0f),
        total_reads(0), parity_errors(0), parity_retries(0), mag_faults(0), last_no_mag(false),
        last_parity_ok(true), last_raw_h(0), last_raw_l(0), last_raw_14bit(0),
        zero_offset_deg(0.0f) {
    memset(lut_errors, 0, sizeof(lut_errors));
  }

  void setMode(bool three_wire) {
    if (!use_3wire) {
      SPI.endTransaction();
    }
    use_3wire = three_wire;
    if (use_3wire) {
      SPI.end();
      pinMode(PIN_SCK, OUTPUT);
      digitalWrite(PIN_SCK, HIGH);
      pinMode(PIN_MOSI, INPUT_PULLUP);
    } else {
      SPI.begin(PIN_SCK, PIN_MISO, PIN_MOSI, -1);
      pinMode(PIN_MISO, INPUT_PULLUP);
      SPISettings settings(spi_speed, MSBFIRST, spi_mode);
      SPI.beginTransaction(settings);
    }
  }

  void setSPISpeed(uint32_t speed_hz) {
    spi_speed = speed_hz;
    if (!use_3wire) {
      SPI.endTransaction();
      SPISettings settings(spi_speed, MSBFIRST, spi_mode);
      SPI.beginTransaction(settings);
    }
  }


  void init() {
    pinMode(cs_pin, OUTPUT);
    digitalWrite(cs_pin, HIGH);

    setMode(SPI_USE_3WIRE_DEFAULT);
    delay(30);

    for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
      uint8_t h = 0, l = 0;
      uint16_t raw14 = 0;
      bool no_mag = false, parity_ok = false;
      readCurrent(h, l, raw14, no_mag, parity_ok);
      last_raw_h = h;
      last_raw_l = l;
      last_raw_14bit = raw14;
      last_no_mag = no_mag;
      last_parity_ok = parity_ok;
      delay(2);
    }

    this->Sensor::init();
  }

  static bool parityCheck(uint16_t data) {
    int count = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
      if (data & (1 << i))
        count++;
    }
    return (count % 2 == 0);
  }

  void read4WireHW(int target_cs, uint8_t &h, uint8_t &l) {
    digitalWrite(target_cs, LOW);
    uint16_t rx_h = SPI.transfer16(0x8300);
    digitalWrite(target_cs, HIGH);

    delayMicroseconds(1); // CS deassertion hold time (t_CS_HIGH >= 150ns)

    digitalWrite(target_cs, LOW);
    uint16_t rx_l = SPI.transfer16(0x8400);
    digitalWrite(target_cs, HIGH);

    h = rx_h & 0xFF;
    l = rx_l & 0xFF;
  }

  static uint8_t transfer3WireByte(uint8_t out_byte, bool read_mode) {
    uint8_t in_byte = 0;
    if (!read_mode) {
      pinMode(PIN_MOSI, OUTPUT);
      for (int i = 7; i >= 0; i--) {
        digitalWrite(PIN_MOSI, (out_byte & (1 << i)) ? HIGH : LOW);
        delayMicroseconds(1);
        digitalWrite(PIN_SCK, LOW);
        delayMicroseconds(1);
        digitalWrite(PIN_SCK, HIGH);
        delayMicroseconds(1);
      }
    } else {
      pinMode(PIN_MOSI, INPUT_PULLUP);
      for (int i = 7; i >= 0; i--) {
        digitalWrite(PIN_SCK, LOW);
        delayMicroseconds(1);
        digitalWrite(PIN_SCK, HIGH);
        delayMicroseconds(1);
        if (digitalRead(PIN_MOSI))
          in_byte |= (1 << i);
      }
    }
    return in_byte;
  }

  void read3WireAtomic(int target_cs, uint8_t &h, uint8_t &l) {
    pinMode(PIN_SCK, OUTPUT);
    digitalWrite(PIN_SCK, HIGH);

    digitalWrite(target_cs, LOW);
    delayMicroseconds(2);
    transfer3WireByte(0x83, false);
    h = transfer3WireByte(0x00, true);
    delayMicroseconds(2);
    digitalWrite(target_cs, HIGH);
    delayMicroseconds(2);

    digitalWrite(target_cs, LOW);
    delayMicroseconds(2);
    transfer3WireByte(0x84, false);
    l = transfer3WireByte(0x00, true);
    delayMicroseconds(2);
    digitalWrite(target_cs, HIGH);
    delayMicroseconds(2);
  }

  bool readCurrent(uint8_t &h, uint8_t &l, uint16_t &raw14, bool &no_mag,
                   bool &parity_ok) {
    for (int retry = 0; retry < 2; retry++) {
      if (use_3wire) {
        read3WireAtomic(cs_pin, h, l);
      } else {
        read4WireHW(cs_pin, h, l);
      }

      uint16_t angle_data = ((uint16_t)h << 8) | l;
      raw14 = ((uint16_t)h << 6) | ((l & 0xFC) >> 2);
      no_mag = (l & 0x02) != 0;
      parity_ok = parityCheck(angle_data);

      if (parity_ok) {
        if (retry > 0)
          parity_retries++;
        break;
      }
      delayMicroseconds(2);
    }

    total_reads++;
    if (!parity_ok)
      parity_errors++;
    if (no_mag)
      mag_faults++;

    return parity_ok;
  }

  float getRawMechanicalAngle() {
    uint8_t h, l;
    uint16_t raw;
    bool no_mag, parity_ok;
    readCurrent(h, l, raw, no_mag, parity_ok);

    if (parity_ok || last_raw_14bit == 0) {
      last_raw_h = h;
      last_raw_l = l;
      last_raw_14bit = raw;
      last_no_mag = no_mag;
      last_parity_ok = true;
    } else {
      last_parity_ok = false;
    }

    return ((float)last_raw_14bit / 16384.0f) * _2PI;
  }

  float getSensorAngle() override {
    float raw_rad = getRawMechanicalAngle();

    // Mode 0: Raw (Uncalibrated)
    if (correction_mode == 0) {
      return raw_rad;
    }

    // Mode 1: 128-Point Stepped LUT (Zero-mean piecewise linear interpolation)
    if (correction_mode == 1) {
      if (!is_lut_calibrated) {
        return raw_rad;
      }

      float norm_rad = raw_rad;
      while (norm_rad < 0.0f)
        norm_rad += _2PI;
      while (norm_rad >= _2PI)
        norm_rad -= _2PI;

      const float lut_step = _2PI / (float)ENCODER_LUT_SIZE;
      int idx0 = (int)(norm_rad / lut_step);
      if (idx0 >= ENCODER_LUT_SIZE)
        idx0 = ENCODER_LUT_SIZE - 1;
      int idx1 = (idx0 + 1) % ENCODER_LUT_SIZE;
      float frac = (norm_rad - (float)idx0 * lut_step) / lut_step;

      float offset = (1.0f - frac) * lut_errors[idx0] + frac * lut_errors[idx1];
      float calib_rad = raw_rad - offset;
      while (calib_rad < 0.0f)
        calib_rad += _2PI;
      while (calib_rad >= _2PI)
        calib_rad -= _2PI;
      return calib_rad;
    }

    // Mode 2: Continuous Analytical Harmonics (Zero-mean trigonometric evaluation via double-angle identities)
    if (correction_mode == 2) {
      float sin1 = sinf(raw_rad);
      float cos1 = cosf(raw_rad);

      // 2nd Harmonic: double angle products
      float sin2 = 2.0f * sin1 * cos1;
      float cos2 = cos1 * cos1 - sin1 * sin1;

      // 4th Harmonic: double angle of 2nd harmonic
      float sin4 = 2.0f * sin2 * cos2;
      float cos4 = cos2 * cos2 - sin2 * sin2;

      // Zero-mean analytical correction (H1 + H2 + H4)
      float correction = (fourier_A1 * cos1 + fourier_B1 * sin1) +
                         (fourier_A2 * cos2 + fourier_B2 * sin2) +
                         (fourier_A4 * cos4 + fourier_B4 * sin4);

      float calib_rad = raw_rad - correction;
      while (calib_rad < 0.0f)
        calib_rad += _2PI;
      while (calib_rad >= _2PI)
        calib_rad -= _2PI;
      return calib_rad;
    }

    return raw_rad;
  }

  float getSingleTurnDeg() {
    float rad = angle_prev;
    float d = (rad / _2PI) * 360.0f - zero_offset_deg;
    while (d < 0.0f)
      d += 360.0f;
    while (d >= 360.0f)
      d -= 360.0f;
    return d;
  }

  void zeroCurrentPosition() {
    float rad = getMechanicalAngle();
    zero_offset_deg = (rad / _2PI) * 360.0f;
    full_rotations = 0;
  }

  float getVelocity() override {
    uint32_t now_us = micros();
    float Ts = (now_us - vel_angle_prev_ts) * 1e-6f;
    if (Ts <= 0.0f || Ts > 0.5f) {
      vel_angle_prev_ts = now_us;
      vel_angle_prev = angle_prev;
      vel_full_rotations = full_rotations;
      return velocity;
    }

    if (Ts < 0.001f) {
      return velocity;
    }

    float angle_curr = (float)full_rotations * _2PI + angle_prev;
    float angle_old = (float)vel_full_rotations * _2PI + vel_angle_prev;
    float d_angle = angle_curr - angle_old;

    float raw_vel = d_angle / Ts;
    if (raw_vel > 1500.0f)
      raw_vel = 1500.0f;
    if (raw_vel < -1500.0f)
      raw_vel = -1500.0f;

    velocity = raw_vel;
    vel_angle_prev = angle_prev;
    vel_full_rotations = full_rotations;
    vel_angle_prev_ts = now_us;
    return velocity;
  }
};

Preferences prefs;

BLDCMotor motor1 = BLDCMotor(MOTOR_POLE_PAIRS);
BLDCDriver3PWM driver1(M1_PWM_A, M1_PWM_B, M1_PWM_C, M1_EN);

float target_velocity_rpm = 0.0f;
float target_voltage = 0.0f;
bool is_enabled = false;
bool is_calibrated = false;
bool show_telemetry = true;
uint32_t last_telemetry_time_ms = 0;
bool ga_stream_active = false;
uint32_t last_ga_stream_time_ms = 0;
uint32_t ga_stream_interval_ms = 20; // 50 Hz default optimal rate for PID GA (20ms)

float calib_align_voltage = CALIBRATION_VOLTAGE;
float calib_hold_voltage = CALIBRATION_HOLD_VOLTAGE;
bool calib_user_aborted = false;
float base_zero_electric_angle = 0.0f;
float sensor_lag_comp_us = SENSOR_LAG_COMP_DEFAULT_US;
float motor_kv_rating = DEFAULT_MOTOR_KV_RATING;

// 11-Pole Continuous Zero Vector (Eliminates inter-pole phase dispersion)
float calibrated_pole_zeros[MOTOR_POLE_PAIRS] = {0};
bool use_pole_specific_zeros = true;

// Continuous Interpolation across all 11 Poles
float getInterpolatedElectricalZero(float mech_angle_rad) {
  if (!use_pole_specific_zeros || !is_calibrated) {
    return base_zero_electric_angle;
  }
  float norm = _normalizeAngle(mech_angle_rad);
  if (norm < 0.0f)
    norm += _2PI;
  float pole_pos = (norm / _2PI) * (float)MOTOR_POLE_PAIRS;
  int p0 = (int)pole_pos % MOTOR_POLE_PAIRS;
  int p1 = (p0 + 1) % MOTOR_POLE_PAIRS;
  float frac = pole_pos - (float)((int)pole_pos);

  float z0 = calibrated_pole_zeros[p0];
  float z1 = calibrated_pole_zeros[p1];
  float dz = z1 - z0;
  while (dz > _PI)
    dz -= _2PI;
  while (dz < -_PI)
    dz += _2PI;
  return _normalizeAngle(z0 + frac * dz);
}
