# SINGLE ZONE CARD WIDGET (VERTICALLY EXPANDING)
# =============================================================================
class ZoneTelemetryCard(QFrame):
    """
    Renders all multi-target details for one single zone:
      - Zone name & angle label
      - Resolved distance (large bold readout) + Proximity Bar + Reason Badge
      - Main Target (Target 0) distance & ST status pill
      - 2nd Target  (Target 1) distance & ST status pill
      - Active SPAD count bar & lens contact alert
    """
    def __init__(self, sensor_id: int, zone_idx: int, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.sensor_id = sensor_id
        self.zone_idx = zone_idx
        self.meta = SENSOR_META[sensor_id]
        self.zone_id = self.meta["zones"][zone_idx]
        self.label_text = self.meta["labels"][zone_idx]

        self.setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Expanding, QSizePolicy.Expanding)
        self.setFrameShape(QFrame.StyledPanel)
        self.setStyleSheet("""
            ZoneTelemetryCard {
                background-color: #1E293B;
                border: 1px solid #334155;
                border-radius: 8px;
            }
            ZoneTelemetryCard:hover {
                border: 1px solid #475569;
            }
        """)

        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(12, 10, 12, 10)
        layout.setSpacing(6)

        # Row 1: Header (Zone ID + Angle + Reason Pill)
        hdr = QHBoxLayout()
        hdr.setSpacing(6)
        self.lbl_zone = QLabel(self.label_text)
        self.lbl_zone.setStyleSheet(f"font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; color: {self.meta['color']};")

        self.lbl_reason = QLabel("IDLE")
        self.lbl_reason.setStyleSheet("""
            font-size: 10px; font-weight: bold; color: #94A3B8;
            background-color: #0F172A; border-radius: 4px; padding: 3px 7px;
        """)
        hdr.addWidget(self.lbl_zone)
        hdr.addStretch()
        hdr.addWidget(self.lbl_reason)
        layout.addLayout(hdr)

        # Row 2: Resolved Distance (Large readout) + Distance Bar
        dist_row = QHBoxLayout()
        dist_row.setSpacing(8)

        self.lbl_main_dist = QLabel("--- mm")
        self.lbl_main_dist.setStyleSheet("font-size: 24px; font-weight: 900; color: #38BDF8; font-family: Consolas;")

        self.lbl_main_dist_m = QLabel("(--- m)")
        self.lbl_main_dist_m.setStyleSheet("font-size: 13px; font-weight: bold; color: #94A3B8; font-family: Consolas;")

        dist_row.addWidget(self.lbl_main_dist)
        dist_row.addWidget(self.lbl_main_dist_m)
        dist_row.addStretch()
        layout.addLayout(dist_row)

        # Depth Bar (0 to 3000 mm)
        self.bar_depth = QProgressBar()
        self.bar_depth.setRange(0, 3000)
        self.bar_depth.setValue(3000)
        self.bar_depth.setTextVisible(False)
        self.bar_depth.setFixedHeight(6)
        self.bar_depth.setStyleSheet("""
            QProgressBar {
                background-color: #0F172A;
                border: 1px solid #334155;
                border-radius: 3px;
            }
            QProgressBar::chunk {
                background-color: #38BDF8;
                border-radius: 2px;
            }
        """)
        layout.addWidget(self.bar_depth)

        # Row 3: Target 0 vs Target 1 Grid Box (Expands to fill vertical card space)
        targets_frame = QFrame()
        targets_frame.setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Expanding, QSizePolicy.Expanding)
        targets_frame.setStyleSheet("""
            background-color: #0F172A;
            border-radius: 6px;
            border: 1px solid #1E293B;
        """)
        t_layout = QGridLayout(targets_frame)
        t_layout.setContentsMargins(10, 8, 10, 8)
        t_layout.setHorizontalSpacing(14)
        t_layout.setVerticalSpacing(4)

        # Col Headers
        lbl_t0_title = QLabel("TARGET 1 (MAIN)")
        lbl_t0_title.setStyleSheet("font-size: 10px; font-weight: bold; color: #64748B; letter-spacing: 0.5px;")
        lbl_t1_title = QLabel("TARGET 2")
        lbl_t1_title.setStyleSheet("font-size: 10px; font-weight: bold; color: #64748B; letter-spacing: 0.5px;")
        t_layout.addWidget(lbl_t0_title, 0, 0)
        t_layout.addWidget(lbl_t1_title, 0, 1)

        # Distances
        self.lbl_t0_dist = QLabel("--- mm")
        self.lbl_t0_dist.setStyleSheet("font-size: 16px; font-weight: 800; color: #F1F5F9; font-family: Consolas;")
        self.lbl_t1_dist = QLabel("--- mm")
        self.lbl_t1_dist.setStyleSheet("font-size: 16px; font-weight: 800; color: #F1F5F9; font-family: Consolas;")
        t_layout.addWidget(self.lbl_t0_dist, 1, 0)
        t_layout.addWidget(self.lbl_t1_dist, 1, 1)

        # Status Pills
        self.lbl_t0_status = QLabel("---")
        self.lbl_t0_status.setStyleSheet("font-size: 10px; color: #94A3B8; font-weight: bold;")
        self.lbl_t1_status = QLabel("---")
        self.lbl_t1_status.setStyleSheet("font-size: 10px; color: #94A3B8; font-weight: bold;")
        t_layout.addWidget(self.lbl_t0_status, 2, 0)
        t_layout.addWidget(self.lbl_t1_status, 2, 1)

        layout.addWidget(targets_frame, 1)

        # Row 4: SPAD Count Bar
        spad_row = QHBoxLayout()
        spad_row.setSpacing(8)
        lbl_spad_tag = QLabel("Active SPADs:")
        lbl_spad_tag.setStyleSheet("font-size: 10px; color: #94A3B8; font-weight: bold;")

        self.bar_spad = QProgressBar()
        self.bar_spad.setRange(0, 16384)
        self.bar_spad.setValue(0)
        self.bar_spad.setTextVisible(False)
        self.bar_spad.setFixedHeight(8)
        self.bar_spad.setStyleSheet("""
            QProgressBar {
                background-color: #0F172A;
                border: 1px solid #334155;
                border-radius: 4px;
            }
            QProgressBar::chunk {
                background-color: #38BDF8;
                border-radius: 3px;
            }
        """)

        self.lbl_spad_val = QLabel("---")
        self.lbl_spad_val.setStyleSheet("font-size: 11px; font-weight: bold; color: #CBD5E1; font-family: Consolas;")

        spad_row.addWidget(lbl_spad_tag)
        spad_row.addWidget(self.bar_spad, 1)
        spad_row.addWidget(self.lbl_spad_val)
        layout.addLayout(spad_row)

    def set_data(self, dist_mm: int, t0_mm: int, t1_mm: int,
                 t0_st: int, t1_st: int, spad_cnt: int, is_52: bool = True):
        # 1. Resolve distance dynamically based on valid status codes
        valid_statuses = VALID_STATUS_CODES
        v0 = (t0_st in valid_statuses and t0_mm > 0)
        v1 = (t1_st in valid_statuses and t1_mm > 0)
        near0 = (t0_st != 0 and t0_st != 255 and 1 <= t0_mm <= 30)
        near1 = (t1_st != 0 and t1_st != 255 and 1 <= t1_mm <= 30)

        if is_52:
            if v0 and v1:
                dist_mm = min(t0_mm, t1_mm)
            elif v0:
                dist_mm = t0_mm
            elif v1:
                dist_mm = t1_mm
            else:
                if near0 and near1:
                    dist_mm = min(t0_mm, t1_mm)
                elif near0:
                    dist_mm = t0_mm
                elif near1:
                    dist_mm = t1_mm
                elif spad_cnt == 1024:
                    dist_mm = 30
                else:
                    dist_mm = 3000

        # Every reading below 30mm is reported as 30mm to pi
        if dist_mm < 30:
            dist_mm = 30

        m_val = dist_mm / 1000.0
        self.lbl_main_dist.setText(f"{dist_mm:d} mm")
        self.lbl_main_dist_m.setText(f"({m_val:.2f} m)")

        # Color
        c = distance_color(dist_mm)
        self.lbl_main_dist.setStyleSheet(f"font-size: 24px; font-weight: 900; color: {c.name()}; font-family: Consolas;")

        # Update depth bar
        self.bar_depth.setValue(min(3000, dist_mm))
        self.bar_depth.setStyleSheet(f"""
            QProgressBar {{
                background-color: #0F172A;
                border: 1px solid #334155;
                border-radius: 3px;
            }}
            QProgressBar::chunk {{
                background-color: {c.name()};
                border-radius: 2px;
            }}
        """)

        # 2. Reason badge
        if not is_52:
            self.lbl_reason.setText("LEGACY 20B")
            self.lbl_reason.setStyleSheet("font-size: 10px; font-weight: bold; color: #38BDF8; background-color: #0F172A; border-radius: 4px; padding: 3px 7px;")
        elif (near0 or near1) and not (v0 or v1):
            self.lbl_reason.setText("NEAR CONTACT (<30mm -> 30mm)")
            self.lbl_reason.setStyleSheet("font-size: 10px; font-weight: bold; color: #EF4444; background-color: #450A0A; border-radius: 4px; padding: 3px 7px;")
        elif spad_cnt == 1024 and not v0 and not v1:
            self.lbl_reason.setText("1024 SPAD CONTACT (30mm)")
            self.lbl_reason.setStyleSheet("font-size: 10px; font-weight: bold; color: #EF4444; background-color: #450A0A; border-radius: 4px; padding: 3px 7px;")
        elif not v0 and not v1:
            self.lbl_reason.setText("OPEN SPACE (3000mm)")
            self.lbl_reason.setStyleSheet("font-size: 10px; font-weight: bold; color: #10B981; background-color: #064E3B; border-radius: 4px; padding: 3px 7px;")
        elif v0 and v1:
            if t0_mm <= t1_mm:
                self.lbl_reason.setText("T1 CHOSEN (CLOSER)")
                self.lbl_reason.setStyleSheet("font-size: 10px; font-weight: bold; color: #22C55E; background-color: #14532D; border-radius: 4px; padding: 3px 7px;")
            else:
                self.lbl_reason.setText("T2 CHOSEN (CLOSER)")
                self.lbl_reason.setStyleSheet("font-size: 10px; font-weight: bold; color: #EAB308; background-color: #713F12; border-radius: 4px; padding: 3px 7px;")
        elif v0:
            self.lbl_reason.setText("T1 VALID")
            self.lbl_reason.setStyleSheet("font-size: 10px; font-weight: bold; color: #22C55E; background-color: #14532D; border-radius: 4px; padding: 3px 7px;")
        elif v1:
            self.lbl_reason.setText("T2 VALID")
            self.lbl_reason.setStyleSheet("font-size: 10px; font-weight: bold; color: #EAB308; background-color: #713F12; border-radius: 4px; padding: 3px 7px;")

        # 3. Target 0 / Target 1 Details
        self.lbl_t0_dist.setText(f"{t0_mm:d} mm" if t0_mm > 0 else "---")
        self.lbl_t1_dist.setText(f"{t1_mm:d} mm" if t1_mm > 0 else "---")

        st0_text, st0_color, _ = get_status_info(t0_st)
        st1_text, st1_color, _ = get_status_info(t1_st)

        self.lbl_t0_status.setText(f"{t0_st}: {st0_text}")
        self.lbl_t0_status.setStyleSheet(f"font-size: 10px; font-weight: bold; color: {st0_color};")

        self.lbl_t1_status.setText(f"{t1_st}: {st1_text}")
        self.lbl_t1_status.setStyleSheet(f"font-size: 10px; font-weight: bold; color: {st1_color};")

        # 4. SPAD bar
        self.bar_spad.setValue(min(16384, spad_cnt))
        if spad_cnt == 1024 and not v0 and not v1:
            self.lbl_spad_val.setText(f"{spad_cnt} (CONTACT)")
            self.lbl_spad_val.setStyleSheet("font-size: 11px; font-weight: bold; color: #EF4444; font-family: Consolas;")
            self.bar_spad.setStyleSheet("""
                QProgressBar { background-color: #0F172A; border: 1px solid #7F1D1D; border-radius: 4px; }
                QProgressBar::chunk { background-color: #EF4444; border-radius: 3px; }
            """)
        else:
            self.lbl_spad_val.setText(f"{spad_cnt}")
            self.lbl_spad_val.setStyleSheet("font-size: 11px; font-weight: bold; color: #CBD5E1; font-family: Consolas;")
            self.bar_spad.setStyleSheet("""
                QProgressBar { background-color: #0F172A; border: 1px solid #334155; border-radius: 4px; }
                QProgressBar::chunk { background-color: #38BDF8; border-radius: 3px; }
            """)


# =============================================================================
# SENSOR COLUMN COMPONENT (VERTICALLY EXPANDING)
# =============================================================================
class SensorTelemetryColumn(QFrame):
    """
    Renders 1 complete ToF sensor column (Header + 4 Vertically Distributed Cards).
    """
    def __init__(self, sensor_id: int, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.sensor_id = sensor_id
        self.meta = SENSOR_META[sensor_id]

        self.setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Expanding, QSizePolicy.Expanding)
        self.setFrameShape(QFrame.StyledPanel)
        self.setStyleSheet(f"""
            SensorTelemetryColumn {{
                background-color: #0F172A;
                border: 1px solid #334155;
                border-top: 4px solid {self.meta["color"]};
                border-radius: 8px;
            }}
        """)

        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(10, 10, 10, 10)
        layout.setSpacing(8)

        # Header Section
        hdr_frame = QFrame()
        hdr_frame.setStyleSheet("background-color: #1E293B; border-radius: 6px; padding: 2px;")
        hdr_layout = QVBoxLayout(hdr_frame)
        hdr_layout.setContentsMargins(10, 8, 10, 8)
        hdr_layout.setSpacing(3)

        title_row = QHBoxLayout()
        self.lbl_title = QLabel(self.meta["name"])
        self.lbl_title.setStyleSheet(f"font-size: 14px; font-weight: 800; color: {self.meta['color']};")
        self.lbl_hz = QLabel("0.0 Hz")
        self.lbl_hz.setStyleSheet("font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold; color: #38BDF8; font-family: Consolas;")
        title_row.addWidget(self.lbl_title)
        title_row.addStretch()
        title_row.addWidget(self.lbl_hz)
        hdr_layout.addLayout(title_row)

        sub_row = QHBoxLayout()
        self.lbl_role = QLabel(self.meta["role"])
        self.lbl_role.setStyleSheet("font-size: 11px; color: #94A3B8;")
        self.lbl_rx = QLabel("Rx: 0")
        self.lbl_rx.setStyleSheet("font-size: 11px; color: #94A3B8; font-family: Consolas;")
        sub_row.addWidget(self.lbl_role)
        sub_row.addStretch()
        sub_row.addWidget(self.lbl_rx)
        hdr_layout.addLayout(sub_row)

        self.lbl_pins = QLabel(self.meta["pins"])
        self.lbl_pins.setStyleSheet("font-size: 9px; color: #64748B; font-family: Consolas;")
        hdr_layout.addWidget(self.lbl_pins)

        layout.addWidget(hdr_frame)

        # 4 Zone Cards: Each card gets stretch factor 1 to evenly fill vertical space
        self.cards = []
        for i in range(4):
            card = ZoneTelemetryCard(sensor_id, i, self)
            self.cards.append(card)
            layout.addWidget(card, 1)

    def update_sensor_data(self, sdata: dict):
        hz = sdata.get("hz", 0.0)
        rx = sdata.get("rx_count", 0)
        active = sdata.get("active", False)

        if active:
            self.lbl_hz.setText(f"{hz:.1f} Hz")
            self.lbl_hz.setStyleSheet("font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold; color: #38BDF8; font-family: Consolas;")
        else:
            self.lbl_hz.setText("OFFLINE")
            self.lbl_hz.setStyleSheet("font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold; color: #EF4444; font-family: Consolas;")

        self.lbl_rx.setText(f"Rx: {rx:d}")

        f = sdata.get("frame")
        if not f:
            return

        dist_mm = f.get("dist_mm", [0]*4)
        t0_mm = f.get("target0_mm", [0]*4)
        t1_mm = f.get("target1_mm", [0]*4)
        t0_st = f.get("target0_st", [0]*4)
        t1_st = f.get("target1_st", [0]*4)
        spad_cnt = f.get("spad_cnt", [0]*4)
        is_52 = f.get("is_52", True)

        for i in range(4):
            if i < len(self.cards):
                self.cards[i].set_data(
                    dist_mm=dist_mm[i] if i < len(dist_mm) else 0,
                    t0_mm=t0_mm[i] if i < len(t0_mm) else 0,
                    t1_mm=t1_mm[i] if i < len(t1_mm) else 0,
                    t0_st=t0_st[i] if i < len(t0_st) else 0,
                    t1_st=t1_st[i] if i < len(t1_st) else 0,
                    spad_cnt=spad_cnt[i] if i < len(spad_cnt) else 0,
                    is_52=is_52,
                )


# =============================================================================
# FLASH ESP32 DIALOG (ONE-CLICK ASYNC FLASH)
# =============================================================================
class FlashDialog(QDialog):
    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setWindowTitle("ESP32 ToF Firmware Uploader (PlatformIO)")
        self.resize(650, 400)
        self.setStyleSheet("background-color: #0F172A; color: #F8FAFC;")

        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        self.lbl_status = QLabel("Ready to upload ESP32 ToF firmware...")
        self.lbl_status.setStyleSheet("font-size: 13px; font-weight: bold; color: #38BDF8;")
        layout.addWidget(self.lbl_status)

        self.text_log = QTextEdit()
        self.text_log.setReadOnly(True)
        self.text_log.setStyleSheet("background-color: #020617; border: 1px solid #334155; font-family: Consolas; font-size: 11px;")
        layout.addWidget(self.text_log)

        btn_row = QHBoxLayout()
        self.btn_start = QPushButton("Start Upload (pio run -e esp32_tof -t upload)")
        self.btn_start.setStyleSheet("background-color: #2563EB; color: white; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 6px; font-weight: bold;")
        self.btn_start.clicked.connect(self.run_upload)
        self.btn_close = QPushButton("Close")
        self.btn_close.setStyleSheet("background-color: #334155; color: white; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 6px;")
        self.btn_close.clicked.connect(self.accept)
        btn_row.addWidget(self.btn_start)
        btn_row.addStretch()
        btn_row.addWidget(self.btn_close)
        layout.addLayout(btn_row)

    def run_upload(self):
        self.btn_start.setEnabled(False)
        self.lbl_status.setText("Compiling and flashing firmware to ESP32 on COM7...")
        self.lbl_status.setStyleSheet("font-size: 13px; font-weight: bold; color: #F59E0B;")

        def worker():
            try:
                cmd = ["pio", "run", "-e", "esp32_tof", "-t", "upload"]
                proc = subprocess.Popen(
                    cmd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                    universal_newlines=True, cwd=os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))
                )
                for line in proc.stdout:
                    self.text_log.append(line.rstrip())
                proc.wait()
                if proc.returncode == 0:
                    self.lbl_status.setText("SUCCESS: ESP32 ToF firmware flashed successfully!")
                    self.lbl_status.setStyleSheet("font-size: 13px; font-weight: bold; color: #22C55E;")
                else:
                    self.lbl_status.setText(f"FAILED with exit code {proc.returncode}")
                    self.lbl_status.setStyleSheet("font-size: 13px; font-weight: bold; color: #EF4444;")
            except Exception as e:
                self.text_log.append(f"\nError: {e}")
                self.lbl_status.setText("FAILED to start upload process")
                self.lbl_status.setStyleSheet("font-size: 13px; font-weight: bold; color: #EF4444;")
            finally:
                self.btn_start.setEnabled(True)

        threading.Thread(target=worker, daemon=True).start()

class ToFMultiTargetMainWindow(QMainWindow):

        self.setWindowTitle("Folkrace — ESP32 Quad VL53L8CX 4-Zone Telemetry Studio")

        self.setMinimumSize(1100, 720)

        self.receiver = None

        # Root Dark Theme
        self.setStyleSheet("""
            QMainWindow {
                background-color: #090D16;

    def refresh_ports(self):
        current = self.combo_port.currentText()
        self.combo_port.clear()
        ports = serial.tools.list_ports.comports()
        preferred_idx = 0
        for i, p in enumerate(ports):
            self.combo_port.addItem(p.device)
            # Prioritize COM7 or USB-Enhanced / CH343 / ESP32
            desc = (p.description or "").lower()
            if "com7" in p.device.lower() or "ch343" in desc or "usb-enhanced" in desc or "esp" in desc:
                preferred_idx = i

        if self.combo_port.count() > 0:
            self.combo_port.setCurrentIndex(preferred_idx)

    def auto_connect(self):
        if self.combo_port.count() > 0 and not self.receiver:
            self.toggle_connection()

    def toggle_connection(self):
        if self.receiver and self.receiver.isRunning():
            try:
                self.receiver.send_bytes(b"L\n")
                time.sleep(0.05)
            except Exception:
                pass
            self.receiver.stop()
            self.receiver = None
            self.btn_connect.setText("Connect")
            self.btn_connect.setStyleSheet("background-color: #2563EB;")
            self.lbl_status.setText("Disconnected")
            self.lbl_status.setStyleSheet("font-size: 11px; color: #EF4444; font-weight: bold;")
        else:
            port = self.combo_port.currentText()
            baud = int(self.combo_baud.currentText())
            if not port:
                return

            self.receiver = TelemetryReceiverThread(port, baud)
            self.receiver.connection_changed.connect(self.on_connection_changed)
            self.receiver.start()
            self.btn_connect.setText("Disconnect")
            self.btn_connect.setStyleSheet("background-color: #DC2626;")

    def on_connection_changed(self, connected: bool, msg: str):
        if connected:
            self.lbl_status.setText(msg)
            self.lbl_status.setStyleSheet("font-size: 11px; color: #22C55E; font-weight: bold;")
            if self.receiver and self.receiver.isRunning():
                # Switch ESP32 to 52-byte multi-target debug stream for GUI
                self.receiver.send_bytes(b"D\n")
        else:
            self.lbl_status.setText(msg)
            self.lbl_status.setStyleSheet("font-size: 11px; color: #EF4444; font-weight: bold;")
            self.btn_connect.setText("Connect")
            self.btn_connect.setStyleSheet("background-color: #2563EB;")

    def reset_mcu(self):
        if self.receiver and self.receiver.isRunning():
            self.receiver.pulse_reset()

    def open_flash_dialog(self):
        # Disconnect serial first so port is free
        was_connected = (self.receiver and self.receiver.isRunning())
        if was_connected:
            self.toggle_connection()

        dlg = FlashDialog(self)
        dlg.exec_()

        # Reconnect if was connected
        if was_connected:
            QTimer.singleShot(1000, self.toggle_connection)

    def update_gui(self):
        if not self.receiver or not self.receiver.isRunning():
            return

        snap, chk_errs, is_52 = self.receiver.get_snapshot()

        total_hz = sum(snap[s]["hz"] for s in snap)
        self.lbl_total_hz.setText(f"Total: {total_hz:.1f} Hz")
        self.lbl_chk_errs.setText(f"Errors: {chk_errs}")

        if is_52:
            self.lbl_protocol.setText("Proto: 52B Multi-Target")
            self.lbl_protocol.setStyleSheet("font-size: 11px; font-weight: bold; color: #34D399; font-family: Consolas;")
        else:
            self.lbl_protocol.setText("Proto: 20B Legacy")
            self.lbl_protocol.setStyleSheet("font-size: 11px; font-weight: bold; color: #F59E0B; font-family: Consolas;")

        # Update columns
        for sid in SENSOR_ORDER:
            if sid in self.columns and sid in snap:
                self.columns[sid].update_sensor_data(snap[sid])

    def closeEvent(self, event):
        if self.receiver:
            try:
                self.receiver.send_bytes(b"L\n")
                time.sleep(0.05)
            except Exception:
                pass
            self.receiver.stop()
        event.accept()


# =============================================================================
# ENTRY POINT
# =============================================================================
def main():
    app = QApplication(sys.argv)
    window = ToFMultiTargetMainWindow()
    window.showMaximized()
    sys.exit(app.exec_())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()


=== FILE: 3_esp32/ESP32_ToF/tof_pin_solver.py ===
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
tof_pin_solver.py
=================
ESP32-S3 Mathematical Pinout Solver, EMI Shielding & Quad VL53L8CX Hardware Verifier
Target: ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1 (N16R8 Octal Flash/PSRAM)
Base Reference: feat/tof-s4-fallback (Working Hardware Architecture)

Priorities:
  1st Priority: Hardware functionality & conflict-freedom (dedicated MISO per ToF, 0 collisions).
  2nd Priority: EMI crosstalk avoidance (Clock-to-MISO physical isolation, DC guard shields).
"""

import sys
import math

# ==============================================================================
# 1. ESP32-S3 SILICON CONSTRAINTS & PHYSICAL HEADER MODEL
# ==============================================================================
ALL_SILICON_GPIOS = set(range(0, 49))
NON_EXISTENT_GPIOS = {22, 23, 24, 25}
FORBIDDEN_OCTAL_FLASH_PSRAM = set(range(26, 38))  # GPIO 26-37: Internal Octal Flash/PSRAM
ONBOARD_WS2812_LED = {48}
INPUT_ONLY_GPIOS = {46}  # GPIO 46 lacks output driver transistors
STRAPPING_GPIOS = {0, 3, 45, 46}
XTAL32K_GPIOS = {15, 16}
NATIVE_USB_GPIOS = {19, 20}

# Physical 2D Pin Mapping on ESP32-S3 DevKitC-1: (side, row_1_to_22)
# Side: 'left' (Header J1), 'right' (Header J3)
PHYSICAL_GRID = {
    # Header J1 (Left Side)
    "3V3_1": ("left", 1), "3V3_2": ("left", 2), "EN": ("left", 3),
    4: ("left", 4), 5: ("left", 5), 6: ("left", 6), 7: ("left", 7),
    15: ("left", 8), 16: ("left", 9), 17: ("left", 10), 18: ("left", 11),
    8: ("left", 12), 3: ("left", 13), 46: ("left", 14),
    9: ("left", 15), 10: ("left", 16), 11: ("left", 17), 12: ("left", 18),
    13: ("left", 19), 14: ("left", 20), "5V": ("left", 21), "GND_J1": ("left", 22),

    # Header J3 (Right Side)
    "GND_J3_1": ("right", 1), 43: ("right", 2), 44: ("right", 3),
    1: ("right", 4), 2: ("right", 5), 42: ("right", 6), 41: ("right", 7),
    40: ("right", 8), 39: ("right", 9), 38: ("right", 10),
    37: ("right", 11), 36: ("right", 12), 35: ("right", 13),
    0: ("right", 14), 45: ("right", 15), 48: ("right", 16),
    47: ("right", 17), 21: ("right", 18), 20: ("right", 19), 19: ("right", 20),
    "GND_J3_21": ("right", 21), "GND_J3_22": ("right", 22),
}

# ==============================================================================
# 2. PROVEN DEDICATED-MISO QUAD-TOF ALLOCATION (feat/tof-s4-fallback)
# ==============================================================================
ALLOCATION = {
    # Shared SPI Master Bus (Header J1 Pins 19-20)
    "TOF_SHARED_SCK":  {"gpio": 13, "dir": "OUT", "bus": "SPI_MASTER", "role": "Shared SPI Clock (Fast dv/dt Aggressor)"},
    "TOF_SHARED_MOSI": {"gpio": 14, "dir": "OUT", "bus": "SPI_MASTER", "role": "Shared SPI MOSI (Master Out)"},

    # ToF 1 (Front Left / Sensor 1) — Header J1 Pins 4-7: [ MISO -> LPN -> INT -> CS ]
    "TOF1_MISO":       {"gpio": 4,  "dir": "IN",  "bus": "DEDICATED",  "role": "ToF 1 Dedicated MISO (Input)"},
    "TOF1_LPN":        {"gpio": 5,  "dir": "OUT", "bus": "GPIO",       "role": "ToF 1 Power Enable (DC Guard Wire)"},
    "TOF1_INT":        {"gpio": 6,  "dir": "IN",  "bus": "GPIO",       "role": "ToF 1 Data Ready Interrupt"},
    "TOF1_CS":         {"gpio": 7,  "dir": "OUT", "bus": "GPIO",       "role": "ToF 1 Chip Select (Active LOW)"},

    # ToF 2 (Front Right / Sensor 2) — Header J1 Pins 15-18: [ MISO -> LPN -> INT -> CS ]
    "TOF2_MISO":       {"gpio": 9,  "dir": "IN",  "bus": "DEDICATED",  "role": "ToF 2 Dedicated MISO (Input)"},
    "TOF2_LPN":        {"gpio": 10, "dir": "OUT", "bus": "GPIO",       "role": "ToF 2 Power Enable (DC Guard Wire)"},
    "TOF2_INT":        {"gpio": 11, "dir": "IN",  "bus": "GPIO",       "role": "ToF 2 Data Ready Interrupt"},
    "TOF2_CS":         {"gpio": 12, "dir": "OUT", "bus": "GPIO",       "role": "ToF 2 Chip Select (DC Shield Guard)"},

    # ToF 3 (Side Left / Sensor 3) — Header J3 Pins 4-7: [ MISO -> LPN -> INT -> CS ]
    "TOF3_MISO":       {"gpio": 1,  "dir": "IN",  "bus": "DEDICATED",  "role": "ToF 3 Dedicated MISO (Input)"},
    "TOF3_LPN":        {"gpio": 2,  "dir": "OUT", "bus": "GPIO",       "role": "ToF 3 Power Enable (DC Guard Wire)"},
    "TOF3_INT":        {"gpio": 42, "dir": "IN",  "bus": "GPIO",       "role": "ToF 3 Data Ready Interrupt"},
    "TOF3_CS":         {"gpio": 41, "dir": "OUT", "bus": "GPIO",       "role": "ToF 3 Chip Select (Active LOW)"},

    # ToF 4 (Side Right / Sensor 4) — Header J3 Pins 8-10, 17: [ MISO -> LPN -> INT -> CS ]
    "TOF4_MISO":       {"gpio": 40, "dir": "IN",  "bus": "DEDICATED",  "role": "ToF 4 Dedicated MISO (Input)"},
    "TOF4_LPN":        {"gpio": 39, "dir": "OUT", "bus": "GPIO",       "role": "ToF 4 Power Enable (DC Guard Wire)"},
    "TOF4_INT":        {"gpio": 38, "dir": "IN",  "bus": "GPIO",       "role": "ToF 4 Data Ready Interrupt"},
    "TOF4_CS":         {"gpio": 47, "dir": "OUT", "bus": "GPIO",       "role": "ToF 4 Chip Select (Active LOW)"},

    # Host High-Speed Telemetry (UART0 to Raspberry Pi 4/5 / PC) — Header J3 Pins 2-3
    "HOST_UART_TX":    {"gpio": 43, "dir": "OUT", "bus": "UART0",      "role": "TX -> Pi Pin 28 (GPIO 1 / RXD2)"},
    "HOST_UART_RX":    {"gpio": 44, "dir": "IN",  "bus": "UART0",      "role": "RX <- Pi Pin 27 (GPIO 0 / TXD2)"},
}


# ==============================================================================
# 3. MATHEMATICAL PROOFS & EMI SHIELDING ANALYSIS
# ==============================================================================
def calc_pin_distance(g1, g2):
    """Calculates physical distance in 2.54mm pin pitch units across board grid."""
    side1, r1 = PHYSICAL_GRID[g1]
    side2, r2 = PHYSICAL_GRID[g2]
    if side1 == side2:
        return float(abs(r1 - r2))
    # Distance between Left and Right headers: 7.0 pin pitches (17.78 mm) across MCU
    return math.sqrt(7.0**2 + (r1 - r2)**2)


def evaluate_hardware_and_emi():
    assigned = {}
    violations = []

    for name, item in ALLOCATION.items():
        g = item["gpio"]
        direction = item["dir"]

        # Proof 1: Strict Injectivity (no pin collisions)
        if g in assigned:
            violations.append(f"COLLISION: GPIO {g} assigned to both '{assigned[g]}' and '{name}'")
        assigned[g] = name

        # Proof 2: Silicon Safety
        if g in NON_EXISTENT_GPIOS:
            violations.append(f"INVALID SILICON: GPIO {g} does not exist in ESP32-S3")
        if g in FORBIDDEN_OCTAL_FLASH_PSRAM:
            violations.append(f"FATAL CONFLICT: GPIO {g} interferes with internal Octal Flash/PSRAM")
        if g in ONBOARD_WS2812_LED:
            violations.append(f"RGB LED CONFLICT: GPIO {g} is wired to onboard WS2812")
        if g in STRAPPING_GPIOS:
            violations.append(f"BOOTLOADER CONFLICT: GPIO {g} interferes with boot strapping")

        # Proof 3: Direction Validity
        if direction == "OUT" and g in INPUT_ONLY_GPIOS:
            violations.append(f"DIRECTION ERROR: GPIO {g} is input-only; cannot drive '{name}'")

    if violations:
        print("ERROR: Hardware validation failed:")
        for v in violations:
            print("  *", v)
        sys.exit(1)

    # Proof 4: EMI Clock-to-MISO Isolation Analysis
    sck_gpio = ALLOCATION["TOF_SHARED_SCK"]["gpio"]
    miso_signals = ["TOF1_MISO", "TOF2_MISO", "TOF3_MISO", "TOF4_MISO"]
    miso_distances = {}

    for msig in miso_signals:
        mgpio = ALLOCATION[msig]["gpio"]
        d_pitch = calc_pin_distance(sck_gpio, mgpio)
        miso_distances[msig] = {
            "gpio": mgpio,
            "dist_pitch": d_pitch,
            "dist_mm": d_pitch * 2.54,
        }

    min_sck_miso_pitch = min(m["dist_pitch"] for m in miso_distances.values())
    min_sck_miso_mm = min_sck_miso_pitch * 2.54

    # Proof 5: DC Guard Shield Verification
    # On Header J1, verify what sits directly between SCK (Row 19) and nearest MISO (Row 15)
    guard_row_18 = PHYSICAL_GRID[12]  # TOF2_CS is at Row 18
    guard_row_16 = PHYSICAL_GRID[10]  # TOF2_LPN is at Row 16
    has_dc_guard = (guard_row_18[1] == 18 and guard_row_16[1] == 16)

    # Proof 6: Cable-Bundle Internal Shielding
    # Verify that in every 4-pin sensor ribbon [ MISO -> LPN -> INT -> CS ],
    # MISO is directly flanked by DC LPN (held continuous 3.3V)
    cable_shield_ok = all(
        ALLOCATION[f"TOF{i}_LPN"]["dir"] == "OUT" for i in range(1, 5)
    )

    return {
        "total_assigned": len(assigned),
        "miso_distances": miso_distances,
        "min_sck_miso_pitch": min_sck_miso_pitch,
        "min_sck_miso_mm": min_sck_miso_mm,
        "has_dc_guard": has_dc_guard,
        "cable_shield_ok": cable_shield_ok,
    }


# ==============================================================================
# 4. STRUCTURED, COMPACT OUTPUT REPORT
# ==============================================================================
def display_results():
    metrics = evaluate_hardware_and_emi()

    print("=" * 80)
    print("  ESP32-S3 QUAD-TOF & UART PIN SOLVER REPORT")
    print("  Target: ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1 (N16R8 Octal Flash/PSRAM)")
    print("  Base Reference: feat/tof-s4-fallback (Working Hardware Architecture)")
    print("=" * 80)

    print("\n[MATHEMATICAL PROOF & HARDWARE VALIDATION]")
    print(f"  * Total Signals Assigned          : {metrics['total_assigned']} pins")
    print(f"  * Pin Collision Check             : PASSED (0 overlaps, strict 1:1 mapping)")
    print(f"  * Dedicated MISO Architecture     : 4 Separate MISO Lines (zero tri-state bus contention)")
    print(f"  * Dynamic MISO Switching          : Attached via spiAttachMISO() on read")
    print(f"  * Octal Flash/PSRAM (GPIO 26-37)  : SAFE (100% untouched)")
    print(f"  * Boot Strapping Pins (0,3,45,46) : SAFE (100% untouched)")
    print(f"  * Onboard RGB LED (GPIO 48)       : SAFE (100% untouched)")
    print(f"  * Native USB CDC (GPIO 19, 20)    : SAFE (100% untouched)")

    print("\n[EMI ISOLATION & NOISE IMMUNITY METRICS]")
    print(f"  * Minimum SCK-to-MISO Clearance   : {metrics['min_sck_miso_pitch']:.2f} pin pitches ({metrics['min_sck_miso_mm']:.2f} mm)")
    for msig, info in metrics["miso_distances"].items():
        print(f"    - {msig:<10} (GPIO {info['gpio']:<2}) : {info['dist_pitch']:5.2f} pitches ({info['dist_mm']:5.2f} mm from Clock)")
    print("  * Header J1 Clock Shielding       : GPIO 12 (TOF2_CS) acts as static DC barrier adjacent to SCK")
    print("  * Cable-Bundle Guard Wire         : Active (MISO is flanked by DC LPN on Wire 2 in all cables)")

    def get_header_pin(gpio):
        if gpio in PHYSICAL_GRID:
            side, row = PHYSICAL_GRID[gpio]
            h = "J1" if side == "left" else "J3"
            return f"Header {h} Pin {row:<2}"
        return "N/A"

    # Structured, compact table with exactly ONE pin per line
    print("\n" + "-" * 95)
    print(f"  {'SIGNAL':<18} | {'HEADER PIN':<17} | {'GPIO':<9} | {'BUS / TYPE':<14} | {'FUNCTION / ROLE':<31}")
    print("-" * 95)

    # Shared SPI Master Bus
    print("  [SHARED SPI MASTER BUS -- CLOCK & COMMANDS]")
    for sig in ["TOF_SHARED_SCK", "TOF_SHARED_MOSI"]:
        item = ALLOCATION[sig]
        hpin = get_header_pin(item["gpio"])
        print(f"  {sig:<18} | {hpin:<17} | GPIO {item['gpio']:<4} | {item['bus']:<14} | {item['role']:<31}")

    # ToF 1
    print("\n  [TOF 1 -- FRONT LEFT (HEADER J1 PINS 4-7)]")
    for sig in ["TOF1_MISO", "TOF1_LPN", "TOF1_INT", "TOF1_CS"]:
        item = ALLOCATION[sig]
        hpin = get_header_pin(item["gpio"])
        print(f"  {sig:<18} | {hpin:<17} | GPIO {item['gpio']:<4} | {item['bus']:<14} | {item['role']:<31}")

    # ToF 2
    print("\n  [TOF 2 -- FRONT RIGHT (HEADER J1 PINS 15-18)]")
    for sig in ["TOF2_MISO", "TOF2_LPN", "TOF2_INT", "TOF2_CS"]:
        item = ALLOCATION[sig]
        hpin = get_header_pin(item["gpio"])
        print(f"  {sig:<18} | {hpin:<17} | GPIO {item['gpio']:<4} | {item['bus']:<14} | {item['role']:<31}")

    # ToF 3
    print("\n  [TOF 3 -- SIDE LEFT (HEADER J3 PINS 4-7)]")
    for sig in ["TOF3_MISO", "TOF3_LPN", "TOF3_INT", "TOF3_CS"]:
        item = ALLOCATION[sig]
        hpin = get_header_pin(item["gpio"])
        print(f"  {sig:<18} | {hpin:<17} | GPIO {item['gpio']:<4} | {item['bus']:<14} | {item['role']:<31}")

    # ToF 4
    print("\n  [TOF 4 -- SIDE RIGHT (HEADER J3 PINS 8-10, 17)]")
    for sig in ["TOF4_MISO", "TOF4_LPN", "TOF4_INT", "TOF4_CS"]:
        item = ALLOCATION[sig]
        hpin = get_header_pin(item["gpio"])
        print(f"  {sig:<18} | {hpin:<17} | GPIO {item['gpio']:<4} | {item['bus']:<14} | {item['role']:<31}")

    # Host Telemetry
    print("\n  [HOST TELEMETRY HIGHWAY (HEADER J3 PINS 2-3)]")
    for sig in ["HOST_UART_TX", "HOST_UART_RX"]:
        item = ALLOCATION[sig]
        hpin = get_header_pin(item["gpio"])
        print(f"  {sig:<18} | {hpin:<17} | GPIO {item['gpio']:<4} | {item['bus']:<14} | {item['role']:<31}")
    print("  * Alternative: Connect via USB-C cable directly to Pi USB port (/dev/ttyACM0).")

    print("-" * 95 + "\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    display_results()

# ESP32 Dual-Controller Architecture

The Folkrace platform delegates low-level embedded responsibilities between **two dedicated ESP32-S3 microcontrollers** to separate high-frequency optical sensor processing from hard real-time chassis dynamics and motor orchestration:

1. **[ESP32 Main (`ESP32_Main/`)](file:///c:/Users/nurmi/Documents/Folkrace/3_esp32/ESP32_Main/)**: Real-time vehicle dynamics engine, BNO08x 9-DOF IMU reading, steering servo actuation, 4WD electronic differential, and master UART links to both front and rear STM32 FOC motor controllers.
2. **[ESP32 ToF Hub (`ESP32_ToF/`)](file:///c:/Users/nurmi/Documents/Folkrace/3_esp32/ESP32_ToF/)**: Dedicated perception co-processor interfacing with 4x VL53L8CX multizone Time-of-Flight sensors over a shared SPI bus, executing outlier filtering, and streaming 16 distance readings to the Raspberry Pi 4.

---

## 1. Subsystem Division of Responsibilities

---

## 2. ESP32 Main: Motion, Dynamics & Chassis Master

### Key Responsibilities
* **400 Hz Real-Time Dynamics Loop**:
  * Receives target longitudinal speed `v` and virtual steering angle `delta` from Raspberry Pi 4.
  * Calculates geometric front wheel Ackermann angles for steering servo.
  * **4WD Electronic Differential**:
    * Rear axle speeds: `v_RL = v - (omega_cmd * W_r * 0.5)`, `v_RR = v + (omega_cmd * W_r * 0.5)`
    * Front axle speeds: computed along independent Ackermann wheel vectors.
    * Proportional saturation scaling preserves turning radius without inducing uncommanded yaw jerks.
* **BNO08x 9-DOF IMU Interface**:
  * High-speed SPI communication with interrupt pin (`INT`).
  * Extracts zero-drift quaternions, calibrated yaw rate (`omega_z`), and lateral acceleration.
  * Streams 42-byte binary telemetry frames to Raspberry Pi 4 at 100 Hz.
* **Traction Control & Slip Detection**:
  * Compares commanded kinematic yaw rate with IMU gyro feedback.
  * Detects wheel spinout or severe understeer and clamps motor speed targets.
* **Dual STM32 Communication**:
  * High-speed UART link @ 921,600 baud streaming binary target RPM packets to the front and rear axle STM32 controllers.

### Hardware Pinout (ESP32-S3 DevKitC-1)
| Function | GPIO Pin | Connected Device / Role | Notes |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **STM32 UART 1 TX** | GPIO 17 | STM32 Front PA10 RX | Motor target velocity packets (921,600 baud) |
| **STM32 UART 1 RX** | GPIO 18 | STM32 Front PA9 TX | Motor actual RPM telemetry packets |
| **STM32 UART 2 TX** | GPIO 15 | STM32 Rear PA10 RX | Motor target velocity packets (921,600 baud) |
| **STM32 UART 2 RX** | GPIO 16 | STM32 Rear PA9 TX | Motor actual RPM telemetry packets |
| **Host Link (Pi 4)** | USB Port | Raspberry Pi 4 USB Port | Direct USB Cable (Serial CDC / UART0 @ 921.6k) |
| **IMU SPI SCK** | GPIO 12 | BNO08x SCK | Dedicated IMU SPI Clock (Header J1 Pin 18) |
| **IMU SPI MOSI** | GPIO 11 | BNO08x MOSI / DI | IMU SPI Data In (Header J1 Pin 17) |
| **IMU SPI MISO** | GPIO 13 | BNO08x MISO / DO | IMU SPI Data Out (Header J1 Pin 19) |
| **IMU SPI CS** | GPIO 10 | BNO08x CSN | Active-Low Chip Select (Header J1 Pin 16) |
| **IMU INT** | GPIO 9 | BNO08x HINTN | Data-Ready Host Interrupt (Header J1 Pin 15) |
| **IMU RST** | GPIO 14 | BNO08x NRST | Hardware Reset (Header J1 Pin 20) |
| **Steering PWM** | GPIO 21 | Front Steering Servo | 333 Hz high-rate digital PWM (Header J3 Pin 18) |

---

## 3. ESP32 ToF Hub: Dedicated Perception MCU

### Key Responsibilities
* **Quad VL53L8CX Sensor Management**:
  * Operates 4 multizone Time-of-Flight sensors (Front-Left, Front-Right, Side-Left, Side-Right).
  * Uses a **single shared SPI bus** for SCK and MOSI.
  * Employs **dedicated per-sensor MISO lines** to eliminate bus contention caused by unbuffered tri-state pins on standard breakout boards.
* **Real-Time Data Filtering & Matrix Extraction**:
  * Gathers 4x4 ranging matrices @ 60 Hz per sensor.
  * Applies outlier filtering, signal-to-noise gating, and multi-target extraction (closest obstacle selection).
  * Formats and packages a consolidated stream of **16 distance readings** for dynamic costmap creation on the Raspberry Pi 4.

### Hardware Pinout (ESP32-S3 DevKitC-1)
| Function | GPIO Pin | Header Location | Connected Sensor / Role |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Shared SPI SCK** | GPIO 13 | J1 Pin 19 | Common Clock to all 4 sensors |
| **Shared SPI MOSI** | GPIO 14 | J1 Pin 20 | Common Data to all 4 sensors |
| **ToF 1 MISO** | GPIO 4 | J1 Pin 4 | ToF 1 (Front Left) Dedicated Data Out |
| **ToF 1 LPN** | GPIO 5 | J1 Pin 5 | ToF 1 Power Enable / Reset |
| **ToF 1 INT** | GPIO 6 | J1 Pin 6 | ToF 1 Data Ready Interrupt |
| **ToF 1 CS** | GPIO 7 | J1 Pin 7 | ToF 1 Chip Select (Active LOW) |
| **ToF 2 MISO** | GPIO 9 | J1 Pin 15 | ToF 2 (Front Right) Dedicated Data Out |
| **ToF 2 LPN** | GPIO 10 | J1 Pin 16 | ToF 2 Power Enable / Reset |
| **ToF 2 INT** | GPIO 11 | J1 Pin 17 | ToF 2 Data Ready Interrupt |
| **ToF 2 CS** | GPIO 12 | J1 Pin 18 | ToF 2 Chip Select (Active LOW) |
| **ToF 3 MISO** | GPIO 1 | J3 Pin 4 | ToF 3 (Side Left) Dedicated Data Out |
| **ToF 3 LPN** | GPIO 2 | J3 Pin 5 | ToF 3 Power Enable / Reset |
| **ToF 3 INT** | GPIO 42 | J3 Pin 6 | ToF 3 Data Ready Interrupt |
| **ToF 3 CS** | GPIO 41 | J3 Pin 7 | ToF 3 Chip Select (Active LOW) |
| **ToF 4 MISO** | GPIO 40 | J3 Pin 8 | ToF 4 (Side Right) Dedicated Data Out |
| **ToF 4 LPN** | GPIO 39 | J3 Pin 9 | ToF 4 Power Enable / Reset |
| **ToF 4 INT** | GPIO 38 | J3 Pin 10 | ToF 4 Data Ready Interrupt |
| **ToF 4 CS** | GPIO 47 | J3 Pin 17 | ToF 4 Chip Select (Active LOW) |
| **Host Link (Pi 4)** | USB Port | USB Cable to Pi 4 | Direct USB connection (/dev/ttyUSB1 or /dev/ttyACM1 @ 921.6k) |

=== FILE: 4_stm32/README.md ===
# STM32 Dual-Motor FOC Architecture

The Folkrace drivetrain is driven by **two independent STM32G474CBT6 microcontrollers**, each controlling a single axle with two direct-drive brushless motors running hardware-accelerated Field Oriented Control (FOC):

1. **Front Axle Controller**: Drives Front-Left (M1) and Front-Right (M2) direct-drive motors.
2. **Rear Axle Controller**: Drives Rear-Left (M3) and Rear-Right (M4) direct-drive motors.

Both microcontrollers run identical high-performance firmware, receiving individual velocity setpoints from the **ESP32 Main** chassis master over high-speed UART and executing closed-loop velocity FOC at 20 kHz.

---

## 1. System Specifications & Features

* **MCU**: STM32G474CBT6 (Arm Cortex-M4F @ 170 MHz with hardware CORDIC and trig accelerators).
* **Motors**: GM3506 Brushless Gimbal Motors (24N22P, 11 pole pairs, 12V supply, zero-backlash direct-drive).
* **Encoders**: 2x MT6816 14-bit magnetic angle encoders connected via **two independent hardware SPI peripherals** (SPI1 and SPI2) for deterministic, low-latency position acquisition.
* **Control Frequencies**:
  * **20.0 kHz Hard Real-Time Commutation**: Center-aligned PWM generation on TIM2 and TIM3.
  * **4.0 kHz Velocity PID Loop**: Downsampled velocity tracking with back-EMF feedforward (`Kv = 130 RPM/V`).
  * **25 Hz Telemetry Stream**: Reports actual shaft RPM and diagnostic metrics.
* **Calibration & Non-Linearity Compensation**:
  * 128-point Stepped Harmonic Linearization Look-Up Table (LUT) to eliminate magnet non-linearity and cogging torque.
  * Automatic electrical zero alignment and phase symmetry tuning.

---

## 2. Hardware Architecture & Interfaces

| **PB13** | Encoder 2 SCK | SPI2_SCK | MT6816 #2 SPI Clock (AF5) |
| **PB14** | Encoder 2 MISO | SPI2_MISO | MT6816 #2 SPI Data In (AF5) |
| **PB15** | Encoder 2 MOSI | SPI2_MOSI | MT6816 #2 SPI Data Out (AF5) |
| **PA8** | User LED | GPIO Out | Active-Low onboard status indicator |
| **PC13** | User Button | GPIO In | Onboard user push button (KEY) |

---

## 4. Communication Protocol with ESP32 Main

Communication occurs over USART1 at **921,600 baud, 8N1** with structured binary packets:

### Downlink (ESP32 Main -> STM32):
* **Format**: 17-byte packet containing 0xAA sync byte, target Left RPM (float32), target Right RPM (float32), reserve fields, and an XOR checksum.
* **Rate**: 400 Hz synchronous loop.

### Uplink (STM32 -> ESP32 Main):
* **Format**: 18-byte packet containing 0x55 sync byte, actual Left shaft RPM (float32), actual Right shaft RPM (float32), voltage/health flags, and an XOR checksum.
* **Rate**: 25 to 100 Hz.

---

## 5. Firmware Build & USB DFU Flashing

The firmware is built using PlatformIO and uploaded over native USB via DFU:

```bash
# Build firmware
pio run -e stm32_dual_foc

# Flash over USB DFU bootloader
pio run -e stm32_dual_foc -t upload
```

> [!TIP]
> If flashing over USB DFU, ensure the board is in bootloader mode (BOOT0 pulled High on reset, or using the hands-free DFU jump routine).

=== FILE: 4_stm32/auto_symmetry_tuner.py ===
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
FOLKRACE — Automated Closed-Loop Phase Angle Equalizer & Symmetry Tuner (GM3506 @ 12V)
======================================================================================
Protocol:
  1. Sets gentle alignment voltage (2.5V @ ~0.35A).
  2. Runs baseline 11-Pole Hysteresis-Compensated Calibration ('c').
  3. Establishes baseline zero angle (theta_0) and safety bounds (+/- 0.10 rad / +/- 5.7 deg elec).
  4. Runs iterative closed-loop voltage tests (+/- 4.0V) to find directional asymmetry.
  5. Dynamically nudges motor.zero_electric_angle within safe bounds to maximize symmetry (>98%).
  6. Computes balanced True Motor KV and applies optimal settings to SimpleFOC controller.
"""

import sys
import time
import math
import re
import argparse
import serial
import serial.tools.list_ports


def find_stm32_port():
    ports = list(serial.tools.list_ports.comports())
    for p in ports:
        desc = (p.description or "").lower()
        if "stm" in desc or "ch340" in desc or "cp210" in desc or "usb" in desc:
            return p.device
    return ports[0].device if ports else None


class AutoSymmetryTuner:
    def __init__(self, port, baud=921600, test_voltage=4.0, max_nudge_rad=0.10):
        self.port = port
        self.baud = baud
        self.test_voltage = float(test_voltage)
        self.max_nudge_rad = float(max_nudge_rad) # Safety bound: +/- 0.10 rad (~ +/- 5.7 deg elec)
        self.ser = None
        self.base_zero_angle = None
        self.optimal_zero_angle = None

    def connect(self):
        print(f"\n[+] Connecting to STM32 on {self.port} @ {self.baud} baud...")
        self.ser = serial.Serial(self.port, self.baud, timeout=0.05)
        time.sleep(0.5)
        self.ser.reset_input_buffer()
        print("[+] Connected successfully.\n")

    def disconnect(self):
        if self.ser and self.ser.is_open:
            try:
                self.ser.write(b"u0.0\nx\n")
                self.ser.flush()
                self.ser.close()
            except Exception:
                pass

    def send_cmd(self, cmd_str):
        if self.ser and self.ser.is_open:
            self.ser.write(f"{cmd_str}\n".encode("utf-8"))
            self.ser.flush()

    def read_telemetry_sample(self, duration_s=0.6, settle_s=0.4):
        time.sleep(settle_s)
        t_end = time.time() + duration_s
        rpm_samples = []
        angle_samples = []

        while time.time() < t_end:
            line = self.ser.readline().decode("utf-8", errors="ignore").strip()
            if not line:
                continue

            # Check for stall
            if "SAFETY SHUTDOWN" in line:
                print("\n[!] EMERGENCY STALL DETECTED! Aborting test.")
                self.send_cmd("x")
                return 0.0, 0.0

            # Telemetry format: Ctrl: ... | Target: ... | Actual: +120.4 RPM | Angle: 45.2 deg | ...
            m_rpm = re.search(r'Actual:\s*([+-]?\d+\.?\d*)\s*RPM', line)
            m_ang = re.search(r'Angle:\s*([+-]?\d+\.?\d*)\s*deg', line)

            if m_rpm:
                try:
                    rpm_samples.append(float(m_rpm.group(1)))
                except ValueError:
                    pass
            if m_ang:
                try:
                    angle_samples.append(float(m_ang.group(1)))
                except ValueError:
                    pass

        mean_rpm = sum(rpm_samples) / max(1, len(rpm_samples))
        std_rpm = math.sqrt(sum((x - mean_rpm)**2 for x in rpm_samples) / max(1, len(rpm_samples)))
        return mean_rpm, std_rpm

    def run_baseline_calibration(self):
        print("================================================================================")
        print(" PHASE 1: 11-POLE BASELINE ELECTRICAL ZERO CALIBRATION")
        print("================================================================================")
        print("[*] Setting optimal alignment voltage: 3.70V (Current ~ 0.55A)")
        self.send_cmd("y3.7")
        time.sleep(0.1)

        print("[*] Triggering 11-Pole Multi-Point Calibration ('c')...")
        self.send_cmd("c")

        t_start = time.time()
        mean_zero_found = None

        while time.time() - t_start < 20.0:
            line = self.ser.readline().decode("utf-8", errors="ignore").strip()
            if not line:
                continue

            if "Pole #" in line or "GRADE" in line or "Alignment" in line or "SimpleFOC" in line:
                print(f"    {line}")

            if "motor.zero_electric_angle =" in line:
                m = re.search(r'motor\.zero_electric_angle\s*=\s*([0-9]+\.[0-9]+)', line)
                if m:
                    mean_zero_found = float(m.group(1))

            if "CALIBRATION REJECTED" in line:
                print("\n[!] Calibration rejected by firmware. Please check wiring / sensor.")
                return False

            if "SimpleFOC Static Code Parameters" in line:
                break

        if mean_zero_found is None:
            # Fallback default
            mean_zero_found = 0.97555
            print(f"[!] Warning: Using default base zero: {mean_zero_found:.5f} rad")

        self.base_zero_angle = mean_zero_found
        self.optimal_zero_angle = mean_zero_found

        print(f"\n[+] Baseline Electrical Zero Angle established: {self.base_zero_angle:.5f} rad ({self.base_zero_angle * 180.0 / math.pi:.2f} deg)")
        print(f"[+] Safety Nudge Range: [{self.base_zero_angle - self.max_nudge_rad:.5f} rad to {self.base_zero_angle + self.max_nudge_rad:.5f} rad] (±{self.max_nudge_rad * 180.0 / math.pi:.2f}°)")
        print("--------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n")
        return True

    def test_bidirectional_speed(self, test_voltage):
        # 1. Forward Spin (+V): 1.5s acceleration + 1.0s sampling
        self.send_cmd(f"u{test_voltage:.2f}")
        fwd_rpm, fwd_std = self.read_telemetry_sample(duration_s=1.0, settle_s=1.5)

        # Coast to zero
        self.send_cmd("u0.0")
        time.sleep(1.0)

        # 2. Reverse Spin (-V): 1.5s acceleration + 1.0s sampling
        self.send_cmd(f"u-{test_voltage:.2f}")
        rev_rpm, rev_std = self.read_telemetry_sample(duration_s=1.0, settle_s=1.5)

        # 3. Stop
        self.send_cmd("u0.0")
        time.sleep(0.8)

        fwd_mag = abs(fwd_rpm)
        rev_mag = abs(rev_rpm)
        delta_rpm = fwd_mag - rev_mag
        max_mag = max(fwd_mag, rev_mag, 1.0)
        symmetry_pct = (min(fwd_mag, rev_mag) / max_mag) * 100.0

        return {
            "fwd_rpm": fwd_mag,
            "rev_rpm": rev_mag,
            "delta_rpm": delta_rpm,
            "symmetry_pct": symmetry_pct,
            "fwd_std": fwd_std,
            "rev_std": rev_std
        }

    def optimize_symmetry(self, max_iterations=7):
        print("================================================================================")
        print(" PHASE 2: AUTOMATED CLOSED-LOOP PHASE ANGLE NUDGING & OPTIMIZATION")
        print(f" Target Test Voltage : ±{self.test_voltage:.2f} V")
        print(f" Target Symmetry     : > 98.0 % (|Δ RPM| < 12.0 RPM)")
        print(f" Maximum Bounds      : ±{self.max_nudge_rad:.4f} rad (±{self.max_nudge_rad * 180.0 / math.pi:.2f}° elec)")
        print("================================================================================")
        print("Iter | Zero Angle (rad) | Nudge (rad) | Forward RPM | Reverse RPM | Delta RPM | Symmetry | Status")
        print("-----+------------------+-------------+-------------+-------------+-----------+----------+-------")

        current_angle = self.base_zero_angle
        best_symmetry = 0.0
        best_angle = current_angle
        best_data = None

        history = []
        for it in range(1, max_iterations + 1):
            # Apply candidate zero electric angle
            self.send_cmd(f"j{current_angle:.5f}")
            time.sleep(0.05)

            data = self.test_bidirectional_speed(self.test_voltage)
            nudge_from_base = current_angle - self.base_zero_angle

            is_valid = (data["fwd_rpm"] > 100.0 and data["rev_rpm"] > 100.0)
            if is_valid:
                history.append({
                    "angle": current_angle,
                    "delta": data["delta_rpm"],
                    "fwd": data["fwd_rpm"],
                    "rev": data["rev_rpm"],
                    "sym": data["symmetry_pct"]
                })

            if is_valid and data["symmetry_pct"] > best_symmetry:
                best_symmetry = data["symmetry_pct"]
                best_angle = current_angle
                best_data = data

            status = "BALANCED" if (is_valid and (data["symmetry_pct"] >= 98.0 or abs(data["delta_rpm"]) < 10.0)) else "TUNING"

            print(f" #{it:02d} | {current_angle:16.5f} | {nudge_from_base:+11.5f} | {data['fwd_rpm']:10.1f}  | {data['rev_rpm']:10.1f}  | {data['delta_rpm']:+9.1f} | {data['symmetry_pct']:7.1f}% | [{status}]")

            if is_valid and (data["symmetry_pct"] >= 98.0 or abs(data["delta_rpm"]) < 10.0) and it >= 2:
                print("\n[+] Perfect 1:1 Directional Symmetry achieved!")
                break

            # Secant root finding interpolation
            pos_pts = [p for p in history if p["delta"] > 0]
            neg_pts = [p for p in history if p["delta"] < 0]

            if pos_pts and neg_pts:
                best_pos = min(pos_pts, key=lambda p: abs(p["delta"]))
                best_neg = min(neg_pts, key=lambda p: abs(p["delta"]))
                d_diff = best_pos["delta"] - best_neg["delta"]
                if abs(d_diff) > 2.0:
                    next_angle = best_neg["angle"] - best_neg["delta"] * (best_pos["angle"] - best_neg["angle"]) / d_diff
                else:
                    next_angle = (best_pos["angle"] + best_neg["angle"]) * 0.5
            else:
                probe_step = - data["delta_rpm"] * 0.000015
                probe_step = max(-0.0020, min(0.0020, probe_step))
                next_angle = current_angle + probe_step

            # Enforce safety bounds relative to base_zero_angle
            min_bound = self.base_zero_angle - self.max_nudge_rad
            max_bound = self.base_zero_angle + self.max_nudge_rad

            if next_angle < min_bound:
                next_angle = min_bound
                print(f"    [!] Reached lower safety bound ({min_bound:.5f} rad). Clamping.")
            elif next_angle > max_bound:
                next_angle = max_bound
                print(f"    [!] Reached upper safety bound ({max_bound:.5f} rad). Clamping.")

            current_angle = next_angle
            time.sleep(0.2)

        self.optimal_zero_angle = best_angle
        # Apply optimal angle
        self.send_cmd(f"j{self.optimal_zero_angle:.5f}")
        time.sleep(0.05)

        # Final Verification
        print("--------------------------------------------------------------------------------")
        print("\n================================================================================")
        print(" PHASE 3: FINAL VERIFICATION & BALANCED KV EXTRACTION")
        print("================================================================================")

        mean_speed = (best_data['fwd_rpm'] + best_data['rev_rpm']) * 0.5
        true_kv = mean_speed / self.test_voltage
        ke = 1.0 / (true_kv * (2.0 * math.pi / 60.0))
        kt = ke

        print(f" Baseline Zero Electric Angle : {self.base_zero_angle:.5f} rad ({self.base_zero_angle * 180.0 / math.pi:.2f}°)")
        print(f" Optimal Neutral Zero Angle   : {self.optimal_zero_angle:.5f} rad ({self.optimal_zero_angle * 180.0 / math.pi:.2f}°)")
        print(f" Optimal Applied Phase Nudge  : {self.optimal_zero_angle - self.base_zero_angle:+.5f} rad ({(self.optimal_zero_angle - self.base_zero_angle) * 180.0 / math.pi:+.2f}° elec)")
        print(f" Forward Speed @ ±{self.test_voltage:.1f}V       : {best_data['fwd_rpm']:.1f} RPM")
        print(f" Reverse Speed @ ±{self.test_voltage:.1f}V       : {best_data['rev_rpm']:.1f} RPM")
        print(f" Final Directional Symmetry   : {best_data['symmetry_pct']:.1f} % (Δ = {best_data['delta_rpm']:+.1f} RPM)")
        print(f" Balanced True Motor KV       : {true_kv:.1f} RPM/V")
        print(f" Back-EMF Constant (Ke)       : {ke:.5f} V*s/rad")
        print(f" Torque Constant (Kt)         : {kt:.5f} N*m/A")
        print("================================================================================")

        # Apply KV to SimpleFOC
        self.send_cmd(f"q{true_kv:.1f}")
        print(f"[+] Applied KV ({true_kv:.1f} RPM/V) and Neutral Zero Angle to STM32 controller.\n")


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Automated Closed-Loop Phase Angle Equalizer & Symmetry Tuner")
    parser.add_argument("--port", type=str, default=None, help="Serial COM port (default: auto-detect)")
    parser.add_argument("--baud", type=int, default=921600, help="Serial baud rate (default: 921600)")
    parser.add_argument("--volt", type=float, default=4.0, help="Test voltage in V (default: 4.0V)")
    parser.add_argument("--max-nudge", type=float, default=0.05, help="Max safe nudge in rad (default: 0.05 rad / ~2.86 deg)")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    port = args.port or find_stm32_port()
    if not port:
        print("[-] Error: No serial port found. Please connect STM32 and try again.")
        sys.exit(1)

    tuner = AutoSymmetryTuner(port=port, baud=args.baud, test_voltage=args.volt, max_nudge_rad=args.max_nudge)
    try:
        tuner.connect()
        if tuner.run_baseline_calibration():
            tuner.optimize_symmetry()
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        print("\n[!] Tuner interrupted by user.")
    finally:
        tuner.disconnect()
        print("[+] Done.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    # =========================================================================
    # RIGHT COLUMN: VELOCITY OSCILLOSCOPE, SECONDARY ENCODER & HARDWARE PINOUT
    # =========================================================================
    def _build_right_telemetry_column(self, parent):
        frame = tk.Frame(parent, bg=COLOR_CARD, width=500, bd=1, relief=tk.SOLID, highlightbackground=COLOR_BORDER)
        frame.pack_propagate(False)

        # 1. Real-Time Velocity Tracking Oscilloscope Card
        scope_hdr = tk.Frame(frame, bg=COLOR_CARD_SECONDARY, height=32)
        scope_hdr.pack(fill=tk.X, side=tk.TOP)
        scope_hdr.pack_propagate(False)
        self.scope_hdr_lbl = tk.Label(
            scope_hdr,
            text="📈 REAL-TIME VELOCITY TRACKING OSCILLOSCOPE (MOTOR 1)",
            font=("Segoe UI", 9, "bold"),
            bg=COLOR_CARD_SECONDARY,
            fg=COLOR_ACCENT_CYAN
        )
        self.scope_hdr_lbl.pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=10)

        self.scope_chart = VelocityOscilloscopeChart(frame, height=150)
        self.scope_chart.pack(fill=tk.X, padx=8, pady=6)

        # 2. Secondary Encoder Diagnostics Card
        hdr2 = tk.Frame(frame, bg=COLOR_CARD_SECONDARY, height=30)
        hdr2.pack(fill=tk.X)
        hdr2.pack_propagate(False)

        self.sec_hdr_lbl = tk.Label(
            hdr2,
            text="🧭 ENCODER 2 DIAGNOSTICS (TIM3 | SPI2: PB13/PB14/PB15 | CS2: PB11)",
            font=("Segoe UI", 9, "bold"),
            bg=COLOR_CARD_SECONDARY,
            fg=COLOR_ACCENT_GREEN
        )
        self.sec_hdr_lbl.pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=10)

        self.m2_status_badge = tk.Label(hdr2, text="STANDBY", font=("Consolas", 8, "bold"), bg="#37474F", fg="#FFFFFF", padx=6, pady=1)
        self.m2_status_badge.pack(side=tk.RIGHT, padx=8)

        dial_panel = tk.Frame(frame, bg=COLOR_CARD)
        dial_panel.pack(fill=tk.X, padx=8, pady=4)

        self.m2_dial = MotorAngleDial(dial_panel, size=165, title="ENC2", accent_color=COLOR_ACCENT_GREEN)
        self.m2_dial.pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=4)

        metrics_box = tk.Frame(dial_panel, bg=COLOR_CARD_SECONDARY, bd=1, relief=tk.SOLID, highlightbackground=COLOR_BORDER)
        metrics_box.pack(side=tk.RIGHT, fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True, padx=4, pady=2)

        spd_row = tk.Frame(metrics_box, bg=COLOR_CARD_SECONDARY)

        tk.Label(spd_row, text="ALTERNATE SHAFT SPEED:", font=("Segoe UI", 8, "bold"), bg=COLOR_CARD_SECONDARY, fg=COLOR_TEXT_MUTED).pack(anchor="w")
        self.m2_act_rpm_lbl = tk.Label(spd_row, text="+0.0 RPM", font=("Consolas", 16, "bold"), bg=COLOR_CARD_SECONDARY, fg=COLOR_ACCENT_GREEN)
        self.m2_act_rpm_lbl.pack(anchor="w")
        self.m2_tgt_rpm_lbl = tk.Label(spd_row, text="Target: +0.0 RPM", font=("Consolas", 8), bg=COLOR_CARD_SECONDARY, fg=COLOR_TEXT_MUTED)
        self.m2_tgt_rpm_lbl.pack(anchor="w")

        volt_row = tk.Frame(metrics_box, bg=COLOR_CARD_SECONDARY)
        volt_row.pack(fill=tk.X, padx=8, pady=2)
        self.m2_uq_lbl = tk.Label(volt_row, text="Uq: +0.00 V", font=("Consolas", 8), bg=COLOR_CARD_SECONDARY, fg=COLOR_TEXT)
        self.m2_uq_lbl.pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=(0, 8))
        self.m2_raw_lbl = tk.Label(volt_row, text="Raw: 0", font=("Consolas", 8), bg=COLOR_CARD_SECONDARY, fg=COLOR_TEXT_MUTED)
        self.m2_raw_lbl.pack(side=tk.LEFT)

        badge_row1 = tk.Frame(metrics_box, bg=COLOR_CARD_SECONDARY)
        badge_row1.pack(fill=tk.X, padx=8, pady=(4, 2))
        self.m2_badge_parity = tk.Label(badge_row1, text="PARITY: OK", font=("Consolas", 8, "bold"), bg="#1B5E20", fg="#FFFFFF", padx=4)
        self.m2_badge_parity.pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=2)
        self.m2_badge_mag = tk.Label(badge_row1, text="MAG: OK", font=("Consolas", 8, "bold"), bg="#1B5E20", fg="#FFFFFF", padx=4)
        self.m2_badge_mag.pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=2)
        self.m2_badge_lut = tk.Label(badge_row1, text="LUT: OFF", font=("Consolas", 8, "bold"), bg="#37474F", fg="#B0BEC5", padx=4)
        self.m2_badge_lut.pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=2)

        badge_row2.pack(fill=tk.X, padx=8, pady=(2, 6))

        tk.Button(e_btn_row, text="Watchdog (K)", command=lambda: self.serial_engine.send_command("K"), bg=COLOR_CARD_SECONDARY, fg=COLOR_TEXT, bd=0, padx=6, pady=2, font=("Segoe UI", 8)).pack(side=tk.LEFT, expand=True, fill=tk.X, padx=2)

        # 3. STM32 Active Pinout Documentation Card
        pin_sec = tk.LabelFrame(frame, text="HARDWARE ACTIVE PINOUT & ARCHITECTURE", bg=COLOR_CARD, fg=COLOR_ACCENT_AMBER, font=("Segoe UI", 8, "bold"))
        pin_sec.pack(fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True, padx=8, pady=4)

            highlightthickness=0
        )
        pin_text.pack(fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)

        pinout_info = (
            "STM32G474 @ 170MHz DUAL-MOTOR ACTIVE CONFIGURATION\n"
