    (void)*(__IO uint8_t *)&spi_inst->DR;
  }

  // 1. Read High Byte (Register 0x03)
  enc.csLow();
  MT6816Sensor::delayNanos(120);

  while (!(spi_inst->SR & SPI_SR_TXE))
    ;
  *(__IO uint8_t *)&spi_inst->DR = 0x83;
  *(__IO uint8_t *)&spi_inst->DR = 0x00;

  uint32_t to = 0;
  while ((spi_inst->SR & SPI_SR_BSY) && ++to < 2000)
    ;

  uint8_t d1 = *(__IO uint8_t *)&spi_inst->DR;
  uint8_t h  = *(__IO uint8_t *)&spi_inst->DR;

  MT6816Sensor::delayNanos(60);
  enc.csHigh();
  MT6816Sensor::delayNanos(150);

  // 2. Read Low Byte (Register 0x04)
  enc.csLow();
  MT6816Sensor::delayNanos(120);

  while (!(spi_inst->SR & SPI_SR_TXE))
    ;
  *(__IO uint8_t *)&spi_inst->DR = 0x84;
  *(__IO uint8_t *)&spi_inst->DR = 0x00;

  to = 0;
  while ((spi_inst->SR & SPI_SR_BSY) && ++to < 2000)
    ;

  uint8_t d2 = *(__IO uint8_t *)&spi_inst->DR;
  uint8_t l  = *(__IO uint8_t *)&spi_inst->DR;

  MT6816Sensor::delayNanos(60);
  enc.csHigh();

  enc.total_reads++;
  enc.parseRawData(h, l);
}

// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Hard Real-Time Parallel Dual-SPI Encoder Read (SPI1 & SPI2 Concurrent Burst)
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Simultaneously clocks out 16-bit register reads on SPI1 (Enc1) and SPI2
// (Enc2). Direct STM32G4 hardware FIFO register access (< 3.6 us total for BOTH
// encoders).
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
static inline void readDualEncodersParallel(MT6816Sensor &enc1,
                                            MT6816Sensor &enc2)
    __attribute__((always_inline));

static inline void readDualEncodersParallel(MT6816Sensor &enc1,
                                            MT6816Sensor &enc2) {
  // 1. Drain any residual bytes in RX FIFOs
  while (SPI1->SR & SPI_SR_RXNE) {
    (void)*(__IO uint8_t *)&SPI1->DR;
  }
  while (SPI2->SR & SPI_SR_RXNE) {
    (void)*(__IO uint8_t *)&SPI2->DR;
  }

  // 2. Assert both Chip Selects
  enc1.csLow();
  enc2.csLow();
  MT6816Sensor::delayNanos(120); // t_CSS setup time (>= 100 ns)

  // 3. Simultaneously queue 0x8300 on SPI1 and SPI2 TX FIFOs
  while (!(SPI1->SR & SPI_SR_TXE))
    ;
  *(__IO uint8_t *)&SPI1->DR = 0x83;
  *(__IO uint8_t *)&SPI1->DR = 0x00;

  while (!(SPI2->SR & SPI_SR_TXE))
    ;
  *(__IO uint8_t *)&SPI2->DR = 0x83;
  *(__IO uint8_t *)&SPI2->DR = 0x00;

  // Both SPI1 and SPI2 hardware engines are now shifting 16 bits in parallel!

  // 4. Wait for both SPI1 and SPI2 engines to finish shifting in parallel
  uint32_t to = 0;
  while (((SPI1->SR & SPI_SR_BSY) || (SPI2->SR & SPI_SR_BSY)) && ++to < 2000)
    ;

  uint8_t d1 = *(__IO uint8_t *)&SPI1->DR;
  uint8_t h1 = *(__IO uint8_t *)&SPI1->DR;
  uint8_t d2 = *(__IO uint8_t *)&SPI2->DR;
  uint8_t h2 = *(__IO uint8_t *)&SPI2->DR;

  // 5. Deassert both CS lines
  MT6816Sensor::delayNanos(60);
  enc1.csHigh();
  enc2.csHigh();

  MT6816Sensor::delayNanos(150); // t_CS_HIGH hold time (>= 150 ns)

  // --- Register 0x04 (Low Byte + Parity + Status) ---

  // 6. Assert both Chip Selects
  enc1.csLow();
  enc2.csLow();
  MT6816Sensor::delayNanos(120);

  // 7. Simultaneously queue 0x8400 on SPI1 and SPI2 TX FIFOs
  while (!(SPI1->SR & SPI_SR_TXE))
    ;
  *(__IO uint8_t *)&SPI1->DR = 0x84;
  *(__IO uint8_t *)&SPI1->DR = 0x00;

  while (!(SPI2->SR & SPI_SR_TXE))
    ;
  *(__IO uint8_t *)&SPI2->DR = 0x84;
  *(__IO uint8_t *)&SPI2->DR = 0x00;

  // 8. Wait for both SPI1 and SPI2 engines to finish shifting in parallel
  to = 0;
  while (((SPI1->SR & SPI_SR_BSY) || (SPI2->SR & SPI_SR_BSY)) && ++to < 2000)
    ;

  uint8_t d3 = *(__IO uint8_t *)&SPI1->DR;
  uint8_t l1 = *(__IO uint8_t *)&SPI1->DR;
  uint8_t d4 = *(__IO uint8_t *)&SPI2->DR;
  uint8_t l2 = *(__IO uint8_t *)&SPI2->DR;

  // 9. Deassert both CS lines
  MT6816Sensor::delayNanos(60);
  enc1.csHigh();
  enc2.csHigh();

  // 12. Parse angles and parity
  enc1.total_reads++;
  enc2.total_reads++;
  enc1.parseRawData(h1, l1);
  enc2.parseRawData(h2, l2);
}

#endif // MT6816_SPI_H


=== FILE: 4_stm32/test_pwm/src/main.cpp ===
#include <Arduino.h>
#include <SimpleFOC.h>
#include "config_pins.h"

// ============================================================================
// STM32G474 — EXACT PRODUCTION DRIVER REAL-TIME PWM & ENABLE TEST BENCH
// ============================================================================
// Uses the EXACT driver initialization as production stm32_dual_foc:
//   driver1: BLDCDriver3PWM(M1_PWM_A, M1_PWM_B, M1_PWM_C, M1_EN) -> TIM2 (PA5, PA1, PA2) + PA3
//   driver2: BLDCDriver3PWM(M2_PWM_A, M2_PWM_B, M2_PWM_C, M2_EN) -> TIM3 (PA6, PA4, PB0) + PA7
//
// Voltage power supply: 12.0V, PWM frequency: 25000 Hz Center-Aligned SpaceVector PWM.
// No sensor or FOC loop dependency - safe for multimeter measurements with PSU OFF!
// ============================================================================

BLDCDriver3PWM driver1(M1_PWM_A, M1_PWM_B, M1_PWM_C, M1_EN);
BLDCDriver3PWM driver2(M2_PWM_A, M2_PWM_B, M2_PWM_C, M2_EN);

static bool d1_en = true;
static bool d2_en = true;
static float d1_v = 6.0f; // 50% duty
static float d2_v = 6.0f; // 50% duty

static void jump_to_dfu() {
    Serial.println("\n>>> [DFU] JUMPING TO STM32 SYSTEM DFU BOOTLOADER...");
    Serial.flush();
    delay(50);
    __disable_irq();
    SysTick->CTRL = 0;
    SysTick->LOAD = 0;
    SysTick->VAL = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        NVIC->ICER[i] = 0xFFFFFFFF;
        NVIC->ICPR[i] = 0xFFFFFFFF;
    }
    const uint32_t boot_addr = 0x1FFF0000;
    uint32_t jump_addr = *(__IO uint32_t *)(boot_addr + 4);
    void (*boot_jump)(void) = (void (*)(void))jump_addr;
    __set_MSP(*(__IO uint32_t *)boot_addr);
    boot_jump();
    while (1);
}

static void apply_driver_states() {
    if (d1_en) {
        driver1.enable();
        // phase A (PA5) = 3.0V (25%), phase B (PA1) = 6.0V (50%), phase C (PA2) = 9.0V (75%)
        driver1.setPwm(3.0f, 6.0f, 9.0f);
    } else {
        driver1.disable();
    }

    if (d2_en) {
        driver2.enable();
        // phase A (PA6) = 3.0V (25%), phase B (PA4) = 6.0V (50%), phase C (PB0) = 9.0V (75%)
        driver2.setPwm(3.0f, 6.0f, 9.0f);
    } else {
        driver2.disable();
    }
}

static void print_pins() {
    Serial.println("\n====================================================================");
    Serial.println("  STM32 EXACT PRODUCTION DRIVER REAL-TIME PWM & ENABLE TEST BENCH   ");
    Serial.println("====================================================================");
    Serial.println("MOTOR 1 INVERTER (TIM2 @ 25 kHz Center-Aligned PWM):");
    Serial.println("  * PA3 (M1_EN)    : Pulses HIGH (3.3V) / LOW (0.0V) every 1s");
    Serial.println("  * PA5 (M1_PWM_A) : TIM2_CH1 PWM (Duty  25% -> 25 kHz, ~0.825V DC)");
    Serial.println("  * PA1 (M1_PWM_B) : TIM2_CH2 PWM (Duty  50% -> 25 kHz, ~1.650V DC)");
    Serial.println("  * PA2 (M1_PWM_C) : TIM2_CH3 PWM (Duty  75% -> 25 kHz, ~2.475V DC)");
    Serial.println("MOTOR 2 INVERTER (TIM3 @ 25 kHz Center-Aligned PWM):");
    Serial.println("  * PA7 (M2_EN)    : Pulses HIGH (3.3V) / LOW (0.0V) every 1s");
    Serial.println("  * PA6 (M2_PWM_A) : TIM3_CH1 PWM (Duty  25% -> 25 kHz, ~0.825V DC)");
    Serial.println("  * PA4 (M2_PWM_B) : TIM3_CH2 PWM (Duty  50% -> 25 kHz, ~1.650V DC)");
    Serial.println("  * PB0 (M2_PWM_C) : TIM3_CH3 PWM (Duty  75% -> 25 kHz, ~2.475V DC)");
    Serial.println("STATUS LED (PA8): OFF (No blink)");
    Serial.println("--------------------------------------------------------------------");
    Serial.println("Interactive Commands:");
    Serial.println("  e1 / d1 : Enable / Disable Motor 1 driver (PA3)");
    Serial.println("  e2 / d2 : Enable / Disable Motor 2 driver (PA7)");
    Serial.println("  e  / d  : Enable / Disable BOTH drivers");
    Serial.println("  h  / ?  : Print this pinout guide");
    Serial.println("  DFU     : Jump to STM32 DFU bootloader");
    Serial.println("====================================================================\n");
}

void setup() {
    // 1. LED off (PA8 LOW)
    pinMode(STATUS_LED, OUTPUT);
    digitalWrite(STATUS_LED, LOW);

    // 2. Exact production driver setup
    driver1.voltage_power_supply = MOTOR_SUPPLY_VOLTAGE;
    driver1.voltage_limit = MOTOR_SUPPLY_VOLTAGE;
    driver1.pwm_frequency = 25000;
    driver1.init();

    driver2.voltage_power_supply = MOTOR_SUPPLY_VOLTAGE;
    driver2.voltage_limit = MOTOR_SUPPLY_VOLTAGE;
    driver2.pwm_frequency = 25000;
    driver2.init();

    // 3. Enable both and output test PWMs
    d1_en = true;
    d2_en = true;
    apply_driver_states();

    // 4. USB CDC Serial
    Serial.begin(921600);
}

void loop() {
    static uint32_t last_toggle = 0;
    static uint32_t last_report = 0;
    static char rx_buf[32];
    static uint8_t rx_idx = 0;
    uint32_t now = millis();

    // Pulse enable pins HIGH / LOW every 1 second
    if (now - last_toggle >= 1000) {
        last_toggle = now;
        d1_en = !d1_en;
        d2_en = !d2_en;
        apply_driver_states();
    }

    // Continuous refresh of PWM duty cycles when enabled
    if (d1_en) driver1.setPwm(3.0f, 6.0f, 9.0f);
    if (d2_en) driver2.setPwm(3.0f, 6.0f, 9.0f);

    // Periodic reminder every 3 seconds
    if (now - last_report >= 3000) {
        last_report = now;
        if (Serial) {
            Serial.printf("[DMM TEST] M1_EN(PA3)=%s | M2_EN(PA7)=%s | M2_PWM: PA6=0.83V PA4=1.65V PB0=2.48V\n",
                          d1_en ? "3.3V" : "0V", d2_en ? "3.3V" : "0V");
        }
    }

    // Process serial commands
    while (Serial && Serial.available() > 0) {
        char c = (char)Serial.read();
        if (c == '\r' || c == '\n') {
            if (rx_idx > 0) {
                rx_buf[rx_idx] = '\0';
                if (strcasecmp(rx_buf, "DFU") == 0) {
                    jump_to_dfu();
                } else if (strcasecmp(rx_buf, "e1") == 0) {
                    d1_en = true;
                    apply_driver_states();
                    Serial.println(">>> M1 Driver ENABLED (PA3 = HIGH)");
                } else if (strcasecmp(rx_buf, "d1") == 0) {
                    d1_en = false;
                    apply_driver_states();
                    Serial.println(">>> M1 Driver DISABLED (PA3 = LOW)");
                } else if (strcasecmp(rx_buf, "e2") == 0) {
                    d2_en = true;
                    apply_driver_states();
                    Serial.println(">>> M2 Driver ENABLED (PA7 = HIGH)");
                } else if (strcasecmp(rx_buf, "d2") == 0) {
                    d2_en = false;
                    apply_driver_states();
                    Serial.println(">>> M2 Driver DISABLED (PA7 = LOW)");
                } else if (strcasecmp(rx_buf, "e") == 0) {
                    d1_en = true;
                    d2_en = true;
                    apply_driver_states();
                    Serial.println(">>> BOTH Drivers ENABLED");
                } else if (strcasecmp(rx_buf, "d") == 0) {
                    d1_en = false;
                    d2_en = false;
                    apply_driver_states();
                    Serial.println(">>> BOTH Drivers DISABLED");
                } else if (strcasecmp(rx_buf, "h") == 0 || strcmp(rx_buf, "?") == 0) {
                    print_pins();
                }
                rx_idx = 0;
            }
        } else if (rx_idx < sizeof(rx_buf) - 1) {
            rx_buf[rx_idx++] = c;
        }
    }
}


=== FILE: 5_webots/README.md ===
# Webots Simulation & Control Architecture

This directory contains the Webots physics simulation environments, robot models, autonomous controllers, C++ Curvilinear SL-MPC trajectory optimizers, genetic algorithm optimization pipelines, and validation test benches for the Folkrace vehicle.

---

## 1. Coordinate Systems & Sign Conventions

All Webots controllers, MPC algorithms, sensor fusion models, and recovery managers adhere strictly to the following conventions:

### A. Robot Body Frame (Vehicle Local Frame)
* **+Y Axis**: **Forward** (Longitudinal vehicle motion)
* **-Y Axis**: **Backward** (Reverse motion)
* **+X Axis**: **Right** (Lateral displacement to the right of the vehicle)
* **-X Axis**: **Left** (Lateral displacement to the left of the vehicle)
* **+Z Axis**: **Up** (Normal to track surface)

### B. Steering Angle Convention (`cmd_steer_rad`, `steer_deg`)
* **Positive (+)**: **Steer LEFT** (Counter-Clockwise / CCW yaw turn)
* **Negative (-)**: **Steer RIGHT** (Clockwise / CW yaw turn)

### C. Yaw & Angular Rates (`yaw`, `gyro_z`, `theta_g`)
* **Positive (+)**: **Turning Left** (CCW)
* **Negative (-)**: **Turning Right** (CW)

---

## 2. Simulation Architecture & Controller Suite

The Webots simulation stack models the distributed physical architecture (Raspberry Pi 4 brain, ESP32 dynamics, and quad ToF perception hub):

* **`simulation/my_project/controllers/tof_path_planner/`**:
  * **Curvilinear SL-MPC (`planner_sl_mpc.py` & `cpp/curvilinear_sl_mpc.cpp`)**: High-performance Frenet-frame trajectory planner formulated as a Quadratic Program (QP) and solved via OSQP in compiled C++ (`curvilinear_sl_mpc.dll`). Matches the deployment on the Raspberry Pi 4.
  * **Quad ToF Perception Model (`cpp_smart_hybrid_costmap.py`)**: Simulates the 4x VL53L8CX multizone ToF array (16 distance readings), performing closest-obstacle extraction and dynamic costmap updates.
  * **4WD Electronic Differential (`electronic_diff_4wd.py`)**: Replicates the ESP32 Main dynamics engine, computing individual wheel velocities for all 4 direct-drive motors under true Ackermann geometry.
  * **Anti-Wrong-Way Watchdog (`anti_wrong_way_watchdog.py`)**: Monitors track heading progress and commands immediate 180-degree recovery spins if inverted.
  * **Stuck Recovery Manager (`stuck_recovery_manager.py`)**: Multi-stage escape state machine executing reverse maneuvers and clearance scans if the vehicle stalls.
* **`optimization/ga_planner_optimizer/`**:
  * Multi-core headless Genetic Algorithm tuning pipeline optimizing MPC weights, lookahead horizons, and speed profiles.
* **`worlds/`**:
  * Active Webots simulation worlds (e.g. `track_racing.wbt` with modular 1200mm track walls and dynamic obstacles).

---

## 3. Directory Layout

```
5_webots/
├── simulation/
│   └── my_project/
│       ├── controllers/
│       │   └── tof_path_planner/     # Main autonomous driving controller suite
│       │       ├── cpp/              # C++ SL-MPC & OSQP solver source code
│       │       └── data/             # Track reference curves and champion genomes
│       ├── worlds/                   # Active simulation worlds (track_racing.wbt)
│       └── protos/                   # Robot model and dynamic obstacle protos
├── optimization/
│   └── ga_planner_optimizer/         # Multi-core genetic algorithm parameter optimizer
├── robotics/
│   └── ros2_cartographer/            # Legacy / experimental mapping reference (Note: Physical car uses ToF, no LiDAR)
└── assets/                           # CAD models, 3D meshes, and track geometries
```

---

## 4. Quick Usage

Launch the full simulation stack with live telemetry from the repository root:

```bash
# Launch champion drive with 3 dynamic obstacles and live telemetry GUI
python 1_launchers/1_champion_preview.py

# Launch ultra-lean champion drive without GUI overhead
python 1_launchers/2_fast_champion_drive.py

# Launch headless Genetic Algorithm optimizer dashboard
python 1_launchers/3_ga_dashboard.py
```


=== FILE: 5_webots/assets/track_builder/export_webots.py ===
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
================================================================================
   FOLKRACE - TRACK BUILDER JSON TO WEBOTS WORLD EXPORTER (.wbt)
================================================================================
Converts track layout JSON from Modular Track Studio into a fully playable,
watertight Webots 3D Simulation World with ENU Standard Coordinates (Z is Up).
================================================================================
"""

import os
import sys
import json
import argparse
import math
import numpy as np

# Direction & Left Vectors (East, North, West, South)
DIR_VECTORS = [
    np.array([1.0, 0.0]),   # 0: East (+X)
    np.array([0.0, 1.0]),   # 1: North (+Y)
    np.array([-1.0, 0.0]),  # 2: West (-X)
    np.array([0.0, -1.0])   # 3: South (-Y)
]

LEFT_VECTORS = [
    np.array([0.0, 1.0]),   # 0: North
    np.array([-1.0, 0.0]),  # 1: West
    np.array([0.0, -1.0]),  # 2: South
    np.array([1.0, 0.0])    # 3: East
]

def build_track_wall_polygons(track_data, step_size=0.04):
    """
    Computes left and right wall vertices and centerline points.
    """
    params = track_data.get("parameters", {})
    tile_size = float(params.get("tileSize", 1.2))
    track_width = float(params.get("trackWidth", 1.0))
    blocks = track_data.get("blocks", [])
    
    half_width = track_width / 2.0
    left_wall = []
    right_wall = []
    centerline = []
    
    for b in blocks:
        b_type = b.get("type", "straight")
        start_x = float(b.get("startX", 0.0))
        start_y = float(b.get("startY", 0.0))
        cur_h = int(b.get("startHeading", 0)) % 4
        fwd = DIR_VECTORS[cur_h]
        left = LEFT_VECTORS[cur_h]
        
        if b_type == "straight":
            steps = max(8, int(math.ceil(tile_size / step_size)))
            for i in range(1, steps + 1):
                t = i / steps
                px = start_x + fwd[0] * tile_size * t
                py = start_y + fwd[1] * tile_size * t
                left_wall.append([px + left[0] * half_width, py + left[1] * half_width])
                right_wall.append([px - left[0] * half_width, py - left[1] * half_width])
                centerline.append([px, py])
                
        elif b_type == "turn_left":
            r_center = tile_size / 2.0
            c_data = b.get("center", {})
            cx = float(c_data.get("x", start_x + left[0] * r_center))
            cy = float(c_data.get("y", start_y + left[1] * r_center))
            start_angle = math.atan2(start_y - cy, start_x - cx)
            arc_len = (math.pi / 2.0) * r_center
            steps = max(12, int(math.ceil(arc_len / step_size)))
            
            for i in range(1, steps + 1):
                angle = start_angle + (math.pi / 2.0) * (i / steps)
                cos_a = math.cos(angle)
                sin_a = math.sin(angle)
                left_wall.append([cx + (r_center - half_width) * cos_a, cy + (r_center - half_width) * sin_a])
                right_wall.append([cx + (r_center + half_width) * cos_a, cy + (r_center + half_width) * sin_a])
                centerline.append([cx + r_center * cos_a, cy + r_center * sin_a])
                
        elif b_type == "turn_right":
            r_center = tile_size / 2.0
            c_data = b.get("center", {})
            cx = float(c_data.get("x", start_x - left[0] * r_center))
            cy = float(c_data.get("y", start_y - left[1] * r_center))
            start_angle = math.atan2(start_y - cy, start_x - cx)
            arc_len = (math.pi / 2.0) * r_center
            steps = max(12, int(math.ceil(arc_len / step_size)))
            
            for i in range(1, steps + 1):
                angle = start_angle - (math.pi / 2.0) * (i / steps)
                cos_a = math.cos(angle)
                sin_a = math.sin(angle)
                left_wall.append([cx + (r_center + half_width) * cos_a, cy + (r_center + half_width) * sin_a])
                right_wall.append([cx + (r_center - half_width) * cos_a, cy + (r_center - half_width) * sin_a])
                centerline.append([cx + r_center * cos_a, cy + r_center * sin_a])
                
    return np.array(left_wall), np.array(right_wall), np.array(centerline)

def build_indexed_faceset_wall(pts, name, color_str, wall_height=0.12):
    """
    Builds watertight 3D wall node in ENU coordinates (Z is Up).
    """
    N = len(pts)
    if N < 2:
        return ""
        
    dist_loop = math.hypot(pts[0, 0] - pts[-1, 0], pts[0, 1] - pts[-1, 1])
    is_closed = dist_loop < 0.25

    # Bottom vertices at z=0.0000
    coord_lines = [f"{p[0]:.4f} {p[1]:.4f} 0.0000" for p in pts]
    # Top vertices at z=wall_height
    coord_lines.extend([f"{p[0]:.4f} {p[1]:.4f} {wall_height:.4f}" for p in pts])
    coord_str = ", ".join(coord_lines)

    index_lines = []
    max_i = N if is_closed else (N - 1)
    for i in range(max_i):
        i_next = (i + 1) % N
        # Quad front face: (bottom_i, bottom_next, top_next, top_i)
        index_lines.append(f"{i}, {i_next}, {i_next + N}, {i + N}, -1")
        # Quad reverse face for 2-sided LiDAR collision
        index_lines.append(f"{i}, {i + N}, {i_next + N}, {i_next}, -1")

    index_str = ", ".join(index_lines)

    node = f'''Solid {{
  name "{name}"
  contactMaterial "wall"
  children [
    Shape {{
      appearance PBRAppearance {{
        baseColor {color_str}
        roughness 0.5
        metalness 0.1
      }}
      geometry IndexedFaceSet {{
        coord Coordinate {{
          point [ {coord_str} ]
        }}
        coordIndex [ {index_str} ]
      }}
    }}
  ]
  boundingObject IndexedFaceSet {{
    coord Coordinate {{
      point [ {coord_str} ]
    }}
    coordIndex [ {index_str} ]
  }}
}}'''
    return node

def convert_json_to_webots_wbt(json_path, output_wbt_path=None, wall_height=0.12):
    with open(json_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        track_data = json.load(f)

    params = track_data.get("parameters", {})
    track_width = float(params.get("trackWidth", 1.0))
    wall_height = float(params.get("wallHeight", wall_height))
    init_pose = track_data.get("initial_pose", {})
    start_x = float(init_pose.get("x", 0.60))
    start_y = float(init_pose.get("y", 0.00))
    start_yaw = float(init_pose.get("yaw_rad", float(init_pose.get("yaw_deg", 0.0)) * math.pi / 180.0))
    
    obstacles = track_data.get("obstacles", [])
    start_line = track_data.get("startLine", None)
    blocks = track_data.get("blocks", [])

    left_wall, right_wall, centerline = build_track_wall_polygons(track_data)

    all_x = [start_x - 2.0, start_x + 2.0]
    all_y = [start_y - 2.0, start_y + 2.0]
    if len(left_wall) > 0:
        all_x.extend(left_wall[:, 0])
        all_y.extend(left_wall[:, 1])
    if len(right_wall) > 0:
        all_x.extend(right_wall[:, 0])
        all_y.extend(right_wall[:, 1])

    min_x, max_x = min(all_x), max(all_x)
    min_y, max_y = min(all_y), max(all_y)
    span_x = max(5.0, max_x - min_x)
    span_y = max(5.0, max_y - min_y)
    mid_x = (min_x + max_x) / 2.0
    mid_y = (min_y + max_y) / 2.0

    arena_w = max(16, int(math.ceil(span_x + 8)))
    arena_h = max(16, int(math.ceil(span_y + 8)))
    view_dist = max(7.0, max(span_x, span_y) * 1.35)

    wbt_lines = [
        '#VRML_SIM R2025a utf8',
        'EXTERNPROTO "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cyberbotics/webots/R2025a/projects/objects/backgrounds/protos/TexturedBackground.proto"',
        'EXTERNPROTO "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cyberbotics/webots/R2025a/projects/objects/backgrounds/protos/TexturedBackgroundLight.proto"',
        'EXTERNPROTO "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cyberbotics/webots/R2025a/projects/objects/floors/protos/RectangleArena.proto"',
        'EXTERNPROTO "../protos/only_front_tofs.proto"',
        '',
        'WorldInfo {',
        '  info [',
        '    "Folkrace Modular Race Track Studio World"',
        '    "Coordinate System: ENU (East-North-Up Standard, Z is Elevation)"',
        '  ]',
        '  title "Folkrace Track World"',
        '  basicTimeStep 8.333333',
        '  optimalThreadCount 4',
        '  contactProperties [',
        '    ContactProperties {',
        '      material1 "tire"',
        '      coulombFriction [',
        '        0.8',
        '      ]',
        '      bounce 0',
        '      softERP 0.35',
        '    }',
        '    ContactProperties {',
        '      material1 "tire"',
        '      material2 "wall"',
        '      coulombFriction [',
        '        0.6',
        '      ]',
        '      bounce 0',
        '      softERP 0.3',
        '      softCFM 0.0005',
        '    }',
        '    ContactProperties {',
        '      material1 "chassis"',
        '      material2 "wall"',
        '      coulombFriction [',
        '        0.25',
        '      ]',
        '      bounce 0',
        '    }',
        '    ContactProperties {',
        '      material1 "chassis"',
        '      coulombFriction [',
        '        0.25',
        '      ]',
        '      bounce 0',
        '    }',
        '    ContactProperties {',
        '      material1 "chassis"',
        '      material2 "chassis"',
        '      coulombFriction [',
        '        0.15',
        '      ]',
        '      bounce 0.05',
        '    }',
        '    ContactProperties {',
        '      material1 "tire"',
        '      material2 "chassis"',
        '      coulombFriction [',
        '        0.25',
        '      ]',
        '      bounce 0.02',
        '    }',
        '  ]',
        '}',
        'Viewpoint {',
        '  orientation 0.65 0.35 0.67 1.85',
        f'  position {mid_x:.2f} {(mid_y - view_dist * 0.55):.2f} {(view_dist * 0.95):.2f}',
        '}',
        'TexturedBackground {',
        '  texture "dusk"',
        '}',
        'TexturedBackgroundLight {',
        '  luminosity 1.2',
        '  castShadows FALSE',
        '}',
        'RectangleArena {',
        f'  floorSize {arena_w} {arena_h}',
        '  floorTileSize 1 1',
        '  floorAppearance PBRAppearance {',
        '    baseColor 0.08 0.10 0.15',
        '    roughness 0.8',
        '  }',
        '}',
        ''
    ]

    # Watertight Walls
    if len(left_wall) > 1:
        wbt_lines.append(build_indexed_faceset_wall(left_wall, "track_left_wall", "0.95 0.15 0.35", wall_height))
    if len(right_wall) > 1:
        wbt_lines.append(build_indexed_faceset_wall(right_wall, "track_right_wall", "0.20 0.60 0.95", wall_height))

    # Obstacles
    for idx, obs in enumerate(obstacles):
        obs_type = obs.get("type", "circle")
        if obs_type == "circle":
            cx = float(obs.get("cx", 0.0))
            cy = float(obs.get("cy", 0.0))
            r = float(obs.get("radius", 0.10))
            wbt_lines.append(f'''Solid {{
  name "slalom_pillar_{idx}"
  contactMaterial "wall"
  translation {cx:.4f} {cy:.4f} {(wall_height / 2.0):.4f}
  children [
    Shape {{
      appearance PBRAppearance {{
        baseColor 1.0 0.75 0.0
        roughness 0.25
        metalness 0.1
      }}
      geometry Cylinder {{
        height {wall_height:.4f}
        radius {r:.4f}
      }}
    }}
  ]
  boundingObject Cylinder {{
    height {wall_height:.4f}
    radius {r:.4f}
  }}
}}''')
        elif obs_type == "rect":
            x1 = float(obs.get("x1", 0.0))
            x2 = float(obs.get("x2", 0.0))
            y1 = float(obs.get("y1", 0.0))
            y2 = float(obs.get("y2", 0.0))
            cx = (x1 + x2) / 2.0
            cy = (y1 + y2) / 2.0
            w = abs(x2 - x1)
            h = abs(y2 - y1)
            wbt_lines.append(f'''Solid {{
  name "obstacle_box_{idx}"
  contactMaterial "wall"
  translation {cx:.4f} {cy:.4f} {(wall_height / 2.0):.4f}
  children [
    Shape {{
      appearance PBRAppearance {{
        baseColor 1.0 0.45 0.0
        roughness 0.35
      }}
      geometry Box {{
        size {w:.4f} {h:.4f} {wall_height:.4f}
      }}
    }}
  ]
  boundingObject Box {{
    size {w:.4f} {h:.4f} {wall_height:.4f}
  }}
}}''')

    # Start Line
    if start_line or len(blocks) > 0:
        sx = float(start_line.get("x", blocks[0].get("startX", 0.0))) if start_line else float(blocks[0].get("startX", 0.0))
        sy = float(start_line.get("y", blocks[0].get("startY", 0.0))) if start_line else float(blocks[0].get("startY", 0.0))
        sh = float(start_line.get("heading", blocks[0].get("startHeading", 0))) if start_line else float(blocks[0].get("startHeading", 0))
        syaw = sh * (math.pi / 2.0)
        wbt_lines.append(f'''Pose {{
  translation {sx:.4f} {sy:.4f} 0.002
  rotation 0 0 1 {syaw:.4f}
  children [
    Shape {{
      appearance PBRAppearance {{
        baseColor 0.0 1.0 0.55
        roughness 0.4
      }}
      geometry Box {{
        size 0.08 {track_width:.4f} 0.003
      }}
    }}
  ]
}}''')

    # Autonomous Folkrace Robot (only_front_tofs proto, front is local +Y so yaw=0 -> -pi/2)
    robot_rot_z = start_yaw - (math.pi / 2.0)
    wbt_lines.append(f'''only_front_tofs {{
  translation {start_x:.4f} {start_y:.4f} 0.0275
  rotation 0 0 1 {robot_rot_z:.4f}
  name "Folkrace"
  controller "tof_path_planner"
  supervisor TRUE
}}''')

    if output_wbt_path is None:
        base, _ = os.path.splitext(json_path)
        output_wbt_path = base + ".wbt"

    with open(output_wbt_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write("\n".join(wbt_lines))

    print(f"[OK] Generated Webots 3D World (ENU Standard): {output_wbt_path}")
    return output_wbt_path

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Convert Modular Track JSON to Webots .wbt world file")
    parser.add_argument("json_file", help="Path to track layout JSON file")
    parser.add_argument("-o", "--output", help="Output .wbt file path", default=None)
    parser.add_argument("--wall-height", help="Wall height in meters (default: 0.12)", type=float, default=0.12)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    if not os.path.exists(args.json_file):
        print(f"Error: JSON file not found: {args.json_file}")
        sys.exit(1)

    convert_json_to_webots_wbt(args.json_file, args.output, args.wall_height)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()


=== FILE: 5_webots/optimization/ga_planner_optimizer/README.md ===
# Headless Genetic Algorithm (GA) Optimizer for Autonomous ToF Racing

A dedicated high-throughput multi-core Genetic Algorithm framework designed specifically for optimizing autonomous ToF path planners in Webots without MPPI.

---

## 1. Quick Start

### Launch GA Optimization (1-Click)
```bash
# Optimize Option 1 (BVP Dynamic State Lattice)
python launch_ga_optimization.py --planner option1

# Optimize Option 2 (Curvilinear Frenet SL-MPC)
python launch_ga_optimization.py --planner option2

# Optimize Option 3 (7th-Order Septic Spline) with custom cores and generations
python launch_ga_optimization.py --planner option3 --cores 6 --generations 40 --pop-size 24
```

### Resume an Interrupted Run
```bash
python launch_ga_optimization.py --planner option1 --resume
```

### Plot Convergence Progress
```bash
python plot_ga_results.py
```

---

## 2. Configuration & Parameter Tuning: `ga_planner_config.py`

All GA hyperparameters, worker allocations, evaluation horizons, and path planner gene tables are centralized in [ga_planner_config.py](file:///c:/Users/nurmi/Documents/Folkrace/5_5_webots/optimization/ga_planner_optimizer/ga_planner_config.py).

### Core GA Hyperparameters
- `NUM_CPU_CORES`: Number of parallel Webots instances running across CPU cores (default: auto-detect physical/logical cores).
- `POPULATION_SIZE`: Number of candidate chromosomes evaluated per generation (default: 24).
- `NUM_GENERATIONS`: Maximum optimization generations (default: 30).
- `EVALUATION_DURATION_S`: Simulation evaluation duration per candidate (strictly 20.0 seconds).
- `ACTIVE_PLANNER`: `"OPTION_1_BVP"`, `"OPTION_2_SL_MPC"`, or `"OPTION_3_SEPTIC"`.
- `CROSSOVER_RATE`: Arithmetic blend crossover probability (default: 0.80).
- `MUTATION_RATE`: Gene mutation probability (default: 0.18).
- `ELITISM_COUNT`: Number of top elite candidates preserved untouched (default: 2).

### Moving Obstacle Reverse Motion
- `ENABLE_MOVING_OBSTACLES = True`
- `MOVING_OBSTACLE_SPEED_MPS = 0.50`
- Obstacles travel **against the robot heading** along the track racing line (`cyan_champion_trajectory.csv`) at 0.50 m/s. The racing line is used solely for moving obstacles, not for path planners.

### 20-Second Distance Fitness Function
- Fitness = `(distance_m * 100.0) + (mean_speed_mps * 25.0) + (laps_completed * 1500.0)`
- Hard Penalty on Crash: `-5000.0`
- Hard Penalty on Stall (`v < 0.15 m/s` for `> 1.5 s`): `-3000.0`

---

## 3. Directory Layout

```
5_webots/optimization/ga_planner_optimizer/
├── ga_planner_config.py         # All exposed GA parameters and gene bounds
├── ga_optimizer.py              # Parallel GA engine (tournament selection, elitism, checkpointing)
├── ga_evaluator.py              # Headless Webots worker pool manager
├── test_ga_optimizer_offline.py # Offline verification tests
└── data/
    └── cyan_champion_trajectory.csv # Racing line for moving obstacles
```

---

## 4. Output Artifacts & Checkpoints
- `best_planner_genome.json`: JSON file containing the highest-fitness champion chromosome and metrics.
- `ga_checkpoint.json`: Checkpoint saved after each generation to allow resuming anytime.
- `ga_history.csv`: Generational progression table (Best Fitness, Distance, Velocity, Crashes).
- `ga_convergence_summary.png`: Visual plots generated by `plot_ga_results.py`.

class GAWorkerThread(QThread):
    """Background execution thread running the parallel GA / CMA-ES optimizer."""
    gen_completed = pyqtSignal(int, str, dict, dict, list, float, int)
    status_changed = pyqtSignal(str)
    finished_all = pyqtSignal()

    def __init__(
        self,
        planner_name: str,
        cores: int,
        pop_size: int,
        generations: int,
        duration: float,
        resume: bool,
        preview: bool = False,
        algorithm: str = ALGORITHM,
        use_best_genome: bool = False,
        seed_file: Optional[str] = None,
        use_track2: bool = USE_TRACK2,
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.planner_name = planner_name
        self.cores = cores
        self.pop_size = pop_size
        self.generations = generations
        self.duration = duration
        self.resume = resume
        self.preview = preview
        self.algorithm = algorithm
        self.use_best_genome = use_best_genome
        self.seed_file = seed_file
        self.use_track2 = use_track2
        self.controller = GAController()
        self.controller.on_generation_done = self._on_gen_done
        self.controller.on_status_change = self._on_status_change

    def _on_gen_done(self, gen: int, planner: str, metrics: dict, genome: dict, fits: list, elapsed: float, crashes: int = 0):
        self.gen_completed.emit(gen, planner, metrics, genome, fits, elapsed, crashes)

    def _on_status_change(self, status: str):
        self.status_changed.emit(status)

    def run(self):
        try:
            self.status_changed.emit("RUNNING")
            run_genetic_algorithm(
                planner_name=self.planner_name,
                num_cores=self.cores,
                pop_size=self.pop_size,
                num_generations=self.generations,
                eval_duration_s=self.duration,
                resume=self.resume,
                preview_rendered=self.preview,
                controller=self.controller,
                algorithm=self.algorithm,
                use_best_genome=self.use_best_genome,
                seed_genome_file=self.seed_file,
                use_track2=self.use_track2,
            )
            if self.controller.abort_requested:
                self.status_changed.emit("ABORTED")
            elif self.controller.stop_requested:
                self.status_changed.emit("STOPPED & SAVED")
            else:
                self.status_changed.emit("COMPLETED")
        except Exception as e:
            if self.controller and self.controller.abort_requested:
                self.status_changed.emit("ABORTED")
            else:
                print(f"[Worker Thread Error] {e}", flush=True)
                self.status_changed.emit(f"ERROR: {str(e)[:30]}")
        finally:
            self.finished_all.emit()

    def pause(self):
        self.controller.pause()

    def resume_opt(self):
        self.controller.resume()

    def stop_and_save(self):
        self.controller.stop_and_save()

    def abort(self):
        self.controller.abort()

    def stop(self):
        self.controller.stop_and_save()


class MatplotlibCanvas(FigureCanvas):
    """Dark-themed multi-curve real-time Matplotlib canvas."""

    def __init__(self, parent=None, width=9, height=5, dpi=100):
        self.fig = Figure(figsize=(width, height), dpi=dpi, facecolor="#0F172A")
        super().__init__(self.fig)
        self.setParent(parent)

        self.axs = self.fig.subplots(2, 2)
        self.fig.tight_layout(pad=3.0)
        self._setup_dark_axes()

    def _setup_dark_axes(self):
        for ax_row in self.axs:
            for ax in ax_row:
                ax.set_facecolor("#1E293B")
                ax.tick_params(colors="#94A3B8", labelsize=8)
                for spine in ax.spines.values():
                    spine.set_color("#334155")
                ax.grid(True, linestyle=":", alpha=0.3, color="#64748B")

    def update_plots(self, data_by_planner: Dict[str, Dict[str, List[Any]]]):
        for ax_row in self.axs:
            for ax in ax_row:
                ax.clear()
        self._setup_dark_axes()

        # Titles
        self.axs[0, 0].set_title("Fitness Score Progression", color="#F8FAFC", fontsize=10, fontweight="bold")
        self.axs[0, 1].set_title("Distance in 30.0s (m)", color="#F8FAFC", fontsize=10, fontweight="bold")
        self.axs[1, 0].set_title("Average Velocity (m/s)", color="#F8FAFC", fontsize=10, fontweight="bold")
        self.axs[1, 1].set_title("Fatal Failure / Crash Count", color="#F8FAFC", fontsize=10, fontweight="bold")

        # Reference lines on distance plot
        self.axs[0, 1].axhline(y=14.109, color="#F59E0B", linestyle="--", alpha=0.7, label="1 Lap (14.1m)")
        self.axs[0, 1].axhline(y=28.218, color="#EF4444", linestyle=":", alpha=0.7, label="2 Laps (28.2m)")

        n_planners = len(data_by_planner)
        for i, (p_name, p_data) in enumerate(data_by_planner.items()):
            c_main = PLANNER_COLORS.get(p_name, "#38BDF8")
            gens = p_data["gen"]
            short_name = p_name.replace("OPTION_", "Opt").replace("_BVP", "-BVP").replace("_SL_MPC", "-MPC").replace("_SEPTIC", "-Septic")

            # 1. Fitness
            self.axs[0, 0].plot(gens, p_data["best_fit"], "-o", color=c_main, label=f"{short_name}", markersize=4, linewidth=1.8)

            # 2. Distance
            self.axs[0, 1].plot(gens, p_data["dist"], "-s", color=c_main, label=f"{short_name}", markersize=4, linewidth=1.8)

            # 3. Speed
            self.axs[1, 0].plot(gens, p_data["speed"], "-^", color=c_main, label=f"{short_name}", markersize=4, linewidth=1.8)

            # 4. Crashes
            width = 0.25
            offset = (i - (n_planners - 1) / 2.0) * width
            self.axs[1, 1].bar(np.array(gens) + offset, p_data["crashes"], width=width, color=c_main, alpha=0.8, label=f"{short_name}")

        for ax_row in self.axs:
            for ax in ax_row:
                if ax.has_data():
                    ax.legend(facecolor="#0F172A", edgecolor="#334155", labelcolor="#E2E8F0", fontsize=7)

        self.fig.tight_layout(pad=2.2)
        self.draw()

    # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # CONTROLLER SLOTS
    # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def start_ga(self):
        p_name = "OPTION_2_SL_MPC"
        cores = self.cores_spin.value()
        pop_size = self.pop_spin.value()
        generations = self.gen_spin.value()
        resume = self.chk_resume.isChecked()
        preview = self.chk_preview.isChecked()
        seed_best = self.chk_seed_best.isChecked()
        use_track2 = self.chk_track2.isChecked()
        algo_choice = str(self.algo_combo.currentData())

        self.data_by_planner.clear()
        self.table.setRowCount(0)
        self.start_time = time.time()

        self.btn_start.setEnabled(False)
        self.btn_pause.setEnabled(True)
        self.btn_resume.setEnabled(False)
        self.btn_stop.setEnabled(True)
        self.btn_abort.setEnabled(True)
        self.planner_combo.setEnabled(False)
        self.algo_combo.setEnabled(False)
        self.cores_spin.setEnabled(False)
        self.pop_spin.setEnabled(False)
        self.gen_spin.setEnabled(False)
        self.chk_resume.setEnabled(False)
        self.chk_seed_best.setEnabled(False)
        self.chk_preview.setEnabled(False)
        self.chk_track2.setEnabled(False)

        self.worker = GAWorkerThread(
            planner_name=p_name,
            cores=cores,
            pop_size=pop_size,
            generations=generations,
            duration=EVALUATION_DURATION_S,
            resume=resume,
            preview=preview,
            algorithm=algo_choice,
            use_best_genome=seed_best,
            use_track2=use_track2,
        )
        self.worker.gen_completed.connect(self.on_generation_update)
        self.worker.status_changed.connect(self.on_status_change)
        self.worker.finished_all.connect(self.on_ga_finished)
        self.worker.start()

    def pause_ga(self):
        if self.worker:
            self.worker.pause()
            self.btn_pause.setEnabled(False)
            self.btn_resume.setEnabled(True)

    def resume_ga(self):
        if self.worker:
            self.worker.resume_opt()
            self.btn_pause.setEnabled(True)
            self.btn_resume.setEnabled(False)

    def stop_ga(self):
        """Smoothly completes current generation, saves checkpoint & champions, and stops."""
        if self.worker:
            self.worker.stop_and_save()
            self.btn_pause.setEnabled(False)
            self.btn_resume.setEnabled(False)
            self.btn_stop.setEnabled(False)

    def abort_ga(self):
        """Immediately force-kills all Webots processes, discards unsaved data, and terminates."""
        if self.worker:
            self.worker.abort()
            self.btn_pause.setEnabled(False)
            self.btn_resume.setEnabled(False)
            self.btn_stop.setEnabled(False)
            self.btn_abort.setEnabled(False)


    def on_status_change(self, status: str):
        self.status_pill.setText(f" {status} ")
        if status == "RUNNING":
            self.status_pill.setStyleSheet("background-color: #065F46; color: #34D399; font-weight: bold; font-size: 12px; border-radius: 12px; padding: 4px 12px;")
        elif status == "PAUSED":
            self.status_pill.setStyleSheet("background-color: #78350F; color: #FBBF24; font-weight: bold; font-size: 12px; border-radius: 12px; padding: 4px 12px;")
        elif status == "COMPLETED":
            self.status_pill.setStyleSheet("background-color: #1E3A8A; color: #60A5FA; font-weight: bold; font-size: 12px; border-radius: 12px; padding: 4px 12px;")
        elif "PREVIEW" in status:
            self.status_pill.setStyleSheet("background-color: #3730A3; color: #A5B4FC; font-weight: bold; font-size: 12px; border-radius: 12px; padding: 4px 12px;")
        elif "STOPPING" in status:
            self.status_pill.setStyleSheet("background-color: #78350F; color: #FDBA74; font-weight: bold; font-size: 12px; border-radius: 12px; padding: 4px 12px;")
        elif "ABORT" in status:
            self.status_pill.setStyleSheet("background-color: #7F1D1D; color: #FCA5A5; font-weight: bold; font-size: 12px; border-radius: 12px; padding: 4px 12px;")
        elif "STOPPED" in status:
            self.status_pill.setStyleSheet("background-color: #78350F; color: #FDBA74; font-weight: bold; font-size: 12px; border-radius: 12px; padding: 4px 12px;")

    def on_ga_finished(self):
        self.btn_start.setEnabled(True)
        self.btn_pause.setEnabled(False)
        self.btn_resume.setEnabled(False)
        self.btn_stop.setEnabled(False)
        self.btn_abort.setEnabled(False)
        self.planner_combo.setEnabled(True)
        self.cores_spin.setEnabled(True)
        self.pop_spin.setEnabled(True)
        self.gen_spin.setEnabled(True)
        self.chk_resume.setEnabled(True)
        self.chk_seed_best.setEnabled(True)
        self.chk_preview.setEnabled(True)
        self.chk_track2.setEnabled(True)
        self.algo_combo.setEnabled(True)

    def on_generation_update(self, gen: int, planner: str, metrics: dict, genome: dict, fits: list, elapsed: float, crashes: int = 0):
        # 1. Update Data Structure
        if planner not in self.data_by_planner:
            self.data_by_planner[planner] = {
                "gen": [],
                "best_fit": [],
                "mean_fit": [],
                "dist": [],
                "speed": [],
                "crashes": [],
            }

        best_fit = float(max(fits)) if fits else 0.0
        mean_fit = float(np.mean(fits)) if fits else 0.0
        dist_m = float(metrics.get("distance_m", 0.0))
        speed_mps = float(metrics.get("mean_speed_mps", 0.0))
        crashes_count = int(crashes) if crashes > 0 else sum(1 for f in fits if f < -2000.0)

        self.data_by_planner[planner]["gen"].append(gen)
        self.data_by_planner[planner]["best_fit"].append(best_fit)
        self.data_by_planner[planner]["mean_fit"].append(mean_fit)
        self.data_by_planner[planner]["dist"].append(dist_m)
        self.data_by_planner[planner]["speed"].append(speed_mps)
        self.data_by_planner[planner]["crashes"].append(crashes_count)

        # 2. Update Table
        row_idx = self.table.rowCount()
        self.table.insertRow(row_idx)
        self.table.setItem(row_idx, 0, QTableWidgetItem(str(gen)))
        self.table.setItem(row_idx, 1, QTableWidgetItem(planner.replace("OPTION_", "Opt").replace("_SL_MPC", "-MPC")))
        self.table.setItem(row_idx, 2, QTableWidgetItem(f"{best_fit:.1f}"))
        self.table.setItem(row_idx, 3, QTableWidgetItem(f"{mean_fit:.1f}"))
        self.table.setItem(row_idx, 4, QTableWidgetItem(f"{dist_m:.2f}"))
        self.table.setItem(row_idx, 5, QTableWidgetItem(f"{speed_mps:.2f}"))
        self.table.setItem(row_idx, 6, QTableWidgetItem(str(crashes)))
        self.table.setItem(row_idx, 7, QTableWidgetItem(f"{elapsed:.1f}"))
        self.table.scrollToBottom()

        # 3. Update Plots
        self.canvas.update_plots(self.data_by_planner)

        # 4. Update Champion JSON Card
        self.champions[planner] = {
            "gen": gen,
            "best_fit": best_fit,
            "dist_m": dist_m,
            "speed_mps": speed_mps,
            "genes": genome,
        }

        json_obj = {
            "generation": gen,
            "planner": planner,
            "fitness": round(best_fit, 1),
            "distance_m": round(dist_m, 2),
            "mean_speed_mps": round(speed_mps, 2),
            "engine": "Curvilinear Slack-Constrained SL-MPC (C++ OSQP)",
            "genes_count": len(genome),
            "genes": genome,
        }
        json_str = json.dumps(json_obj, indent=2)
        self.txt_champion.setPlainText(json_str)

        # 5. Update Progress Bar & Overall Stats
        total_gens = self.gen_spin.value()
        pct = min(100, int((gen / max(1, total_gens)) * 100))
        self.progress_bar.setValue(pct)

        tot_elapsed = time.time() - self.start_time
        max_dist_overall = max([max(p["dist"]) for p in self.data_by_planner.values()] or [0.0])
        max_speed_overall = max([max(p["speed"]) for p in self.data_by_planner.values()] or [0.0])

        self.lbl_stats.setText(
            f"Gen: {gen} / {total_gens} | Max Dist: {max_dist_overall:.2f} m | Max Speed: {max_speed_overall:.2f} m/s | Elapsed: {tot_elapsed:.1f}s"
        )

    def _load_initial_champion_previews(self):
        """Pre-populates the parameter card with Option 2 SL-MPC champion genome or defaults."""
        p_name = "OPTION_2_SL_MPC"
        try:
            ckpt_path = os.path.join(CURR_DIR, f"best_genome_{p_name.lower()}.json")
            if not os.path.exists(ckpt_path):
                ckpt_path = os.path.join(OPTIMIZER_PROJECT_DIR, f"best_genome_{p_name.lower()}.json")
            if not os.path.exists(ckpt_path):
                ckpt_path = os.path.join(CURR_DIR, "ga_checkpoint.json")
            if not os.path.exists(ckpt_path):
                ckpt_path = os.path.join(OPTIMIZER_PROJECT_DIR, "ga_checkpoint.json")
            genome_cls = get_genome_class(p_name)
            if os.path.exists(ckpt_path):
                with open(ckpt_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                    data = json.load(f)
                raw_genes = data.get("genes", data.get("best_genome", {}))
                full_genes = genome_cls(raw_genes).to_dict()
                data["genes"] = full_genes
                data["total_genes"] = len(full_genes)
                data["engine"] = "Curvilinear Slack-Constrained SL-MPC (OSQP)"
                self.txt_champion.setPlainText(json.dumps(data, indent=2))
            else:
                default_genes = genome_cls().to_dict()
                preview = {
                    "planner": p_name,
                    "status": "Ready for initial evaluation",
                    "engine": "Curvilinear Slack-Constrained SL-MPC (OSQP)",
                    "total_genes": len(default_genes),
                    "genes": default_genes,
                }
                self.txt_champion.setPlainText(json.dumps(preview, indent=2))
        except Exception as e:
            self.txt_champion.setPlainText(f"Error loading {p_name} preview: {e}")

    def _load_history_on_startup(self):
        """Loads historical generation records from ga_history.csv if available."""
        if not os.path.exists(HISTORY_CSV_FILE):
            return
        try:
            with open(HISTORY_CSV_FILE, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                reader = csv.DictReader(f)
                rows = list(reader)

            if not rows:
                return

            for row in rows:
                gen = int(row.get("Generation", 0))
                planner = row.get("Planner", "OPTION_2_SL_MPC")
                best_fit = float(row.get("Best_Fitness", 0.0))
                mean_fit = float(row.get("Mean_Fitness", 0.0))
                dist_m = float(row.get("Best_Distance_m", 0.0))
                speed_mps = float(row.get("Best_Speed_mps", 0.0))
                crashes = int(float(row.get("Crash_Count", 0)))
                gen_time = float(row.get("Gen_Time_s", 0.0))

                if planner not in self.data_by_planner:
                    self.data_by_planner[planner] = {
                        "gen": [],
                        "best_fit": [],
                        "mean_fit": [],
                        "dist": [],
                        "speed": [],
                        "crashes": [],
                    }

                self.data_by_planner[planner]["gen"].append(gen)
                self.data_by_planner[planner]["best_fit"].append(best_fit)
                self.data_by_planner[planner]["mean_fit"].append(mean_fit)
                self.data_by_planner[planner]["dist"].append(dist_m)
                self.data_by_planner[planner]["speed"].append(speed_mps)
                self.data_by_planner[planner]["crashes"].append(crashes)

                row_idx = self.table.rowCount()
                self.table.insertRow(row_idx)
                self.table.setItem(row_idx, 0, QTableWidgetItem(str(gen)))
                self.table.setItem(row_idx, 1, QTableWidgetItem(planner.replace("OPTION_", "Opt").replace("_SL_MPC", "-MPC")))
                self.table.setItem(row_idx, 2, QTableWidgetItem(f"{best_fit:.1f}"))
                self.table.setItem(row_idx, 3, QTableWidgetItem(f"{mean_fit:.1f}"))
                self.table.setItem(row_idx, 4, QTableWidgetItem(f"{dist_m:.2f}"))
                self.table.setItem(row_idx, 5, QTableWidgetItem(f"{speed_mps:.2f}"))
                self.table.setItem(row_idx, 6, QTableWidgetItem(str(crashes)))
                self.table.setItem(row_idx, 7, QTableWidgetItem(f"{gen_time:.1f}"))

            self.table.scrollToBottom()
            self.canvas.update_plots(self.data_by_planner)

            last_row = rows[-1]
            last_gen = int(last_row.get("Generation", len(rows)))
            max_dist_overall = max([max(p["dist"]) for p in self.data_by_planner.values()] or [0.0])
            max_speed_overall = max([max(p["speed"]) for p in self.data_by_planner.values()] or [0.0])
            best_fit_overall = max([max(p["best_fit"]) for p in self.data_by_planner.values()] or [0.0])
            self.lbl_stats.setText(
                f"History Loaded: Gen {last_gen} | Best Fit: {best_fit_overall:.1f} | Max Dist: {max_dist_overall:.2f} m | Max Speed: {max_speed_overall:.2f} m/s"
            )
            pct = min(100, int((last_gen / max(1, self.gen_spin.value())) * 100))
            self.progress_bar.setValue(pct)
            self.on_status_change(f"READY (Gen {last_gen} Loaded)")
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"[GA Dashboard] Note: Could not load history from {HISTORY_CSV_FILE}: {e}", flush=True)

    def closeEvent(self, event):
        """Cleanly abort and kill all Webots processes if window is closed."""
        if self.worker:
            self.worker.abort()
        event.accept()


def main():
    app = QApplication(sys.argv)
    window = GADashboardGUI()
    window.show()
    sys.exit(app.exec_())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""
================================================================================
  HEADLESS WEBOTS EVALUATOR & PARALLEL WORKER POOL
================================================================================
  Spawns and manages long-lived headless Webots processes across CPU cores.
  Communicates with supervisor workers via local TCP sockets for sub-second trial
  dispatch, collecting 20-second distance metrics and scalar fitness.
================================================================================
"""

import os
import sys
import json
import time
import socket
import subprocess
import queue
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Tuple, Any
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed
import numpy as np

CURR_DIR = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))

def _find_world_path(start_dir: str) -> str:
    p = start_dir
    for _ in range(6):
        cand = os.path.join(p, "5_webots", "simulation", "my_project", "worlds", "track_racing.wbt")
        if os.path.exists(cand):
            return cand
        cand2 = os.path.join(p, "simulation", "my_project", "worlds", "track_racing.wbt")
        if os.path.exists(cand2):
            return cand2
        parent = os.path.dirname(p)
        if parent == p:
            break
        p = parent
    return os.path.join(start_dir, "track_racing.wbt")

DEFAULT_WORLD_PATH = _find_world_path(CURR_DIR)
OPTIMIZER_PROJECT_DIR = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(DEFAULT_WORLD_PATH)) if os.path.exists(DEFAULT_WORLD_PATH) else CURR_DIR
MY_PROJECT_DIR = OPTIMIZER_PROJECT_DIR
WEBOTS_DIR = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(MY_PROJECT_DIR))
WORKSPACE_ROOT = os.path.dirname(WEBOTS_DIR)

for p in [OPTIMIZER_PROJECT_DIR, CURR_DIR]:
    if p not in sys.path and os.path.exists(p):
        sys.path.insert(0, p)

from ga_planner_config import (
    NUM_CPU_CORES,
    WEBOTS_BINARY,
    BASE_WORKER_PORT,
    POPULATION_SIZE,
    NUM_GENERATIONS,
    EVALUATION_DURATION_S,
    TIMEOUT_PER_TRIAL_WALL_S,
    ACTIVE_PLANNER,
    compute_scalar_fitness,
    get_genome_class,
    BasePlannerGenome,
    USE_TRACK2,
)


class HeadlessWebotsWorker:
    """Manages a single long-lived headless Webots process on a dedicated port."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        worker_id: int,
        base_port: int = BASE_WORKER_PORT,
        webots_bin: str = WEBOTS_BINARY,
        world_path: str = DEFAULT_WORLD_PATH,
        rendered: bool = False,
        controller: Optional[any] = None,
    ):
        self.worker_id = worker_id
        self.port = base_port + worker_id
        self.webots_bin = webots_bin
        self.world_path = world_path
        self.rendered = rendered
        self.controller = controller
        self.proc: Optional[subprocess.Popen] = None
        self.log_file = None
        self._is_stopped = False
        self.start_process()

    def _kill_proc(self):
        """Kills active process tree and closes log file without marking worker permanently stopped."""
        if self.proc is not None:
            pid = self.proc.pid
            # Try graceful TCP shutdown first
            try:
                s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
                s.settimeout(0.5)
                s.connect(("127.0.0.1", self.port))
                s.sendall((json.dumps({"cmd": "SHUTDOWN"}) + "\n").encode("utf-8"))
                s.close()
            except Exception:
                pass

            # Force-kill the entire process tree
            if sys.platform == "win32":
                try:
                    subprocess.run(
                        ["taskkill", "/F", "/T", "/PID", str(pid)],
                        capture_output=True,
                        timeout=5,
                    )
                except Exception:
                    pass
            else:
                try:
                    import signal as _signal
                    os.killpg(os.getpgid(pid), _signal.SIGKILL)
                except Exception:
                    pass

            try:
                self.proc.wait(timeout=2.0)
            except Exception:
                try:
                    self.proc.kill()
                except Exception:
                    pass
            self.proc = None

        if self.log_file is not None and not self.log_file.closed:
            try:
                self.log_file.close()
            except Exception:
                pass
            self.log_file = None

    def start_process(self):
        """Launches Webots in fast headless batch mode or rendered real-time preview mode."""
        if self._is_stopped:
            return
        if self.controller and (getattr(self.controller, "abort_requested", False) or getattr(self.controller, "stop_requested", False)):
            self._is_stopped = True
            return

        self._kill_proc()

        env = os.environ.copy()
        webots_bin_dir = os.path.dirname(self.webots_bin)
        webots_home = r"C:\Program Files\Webots"
        py_dir = os.path.dirname(sys.executable)
        py_scripts = os.path.join(py_dir, "Scripts")
        env["WEBOTS_HOME"] = webots_home
        env["PATH"] = webots_bin_dir + os.pathsep + py_dir + os.pathsep + py_scripts + os.pathsep + env.get("PATH", "")
        env["PYTHONPATH"] = os.pathsep.join([
            CURR_DIR,
            OPTIMIZER_PROJECT_DIR,
            os.path.join(OPTIMIZER_PROJECT_DIR, "controllers", "tof_path_planner"),
            os.path.join(CURR_DIR, "data"),
            WORKSPACE_ROOT,
        ])
        env["GA_WORKER_PORT"] = str(self.port)
        env["GA_WORKER_ID"] = str(self.worker_id)
        env["WEBOTS_CONTROLLER_MODE"] = "ga_eval"
        env["PYTHONUNBUFFERED"] = "1"

        if self.rendered:
            # Rendered real-time visual mode for human inspection
            cmd = [
                self.webots_bin,
                f"--port={self.port}",
                "--mode=realtime",
                "--batch",
                self.world_path,
            ]
            startupinfo = None
            creationflags = 0
        else:
            # Headless multi-core fast batch mode
            cmd = [
                self.webots_bin,
                f"--port={self.port}",
                "--mode=fast",
                "--no-rendering",
                "--batch",
                "--minimize",
                "--stdout",
                "--stderr",
                self.world_path,
            ]
            startupinfo = None
            creationflags = 0
            if sys.platform == "win32":
                startupinfo = subprocess.STARTUPINFO()
                startupinfo.dwFlags |= subprocess.STARTF_USESHOWWINDOW
                startupinfo.wShowWindow = 0  # SW_HIDE
                creationflags = getattr(subprocess, "CREATE_NO_WINDOW", 0x08000000)

        if self._is_stopped or (self.controller and getattr(self.controller, "abort_requested", False)):
            return

        try:
            log_dir = os.path.join(CURR_DIR, "logs")
            os.makedirs(log_dir, exist_ok=True)
            self.log_path = os.path.join(log_dir, f"worker_{self.worker_id}.log")
            self.log_file = open(self.log_path, "w", encoding="utf-8")

            self.proc = subprocess.Popen(
                cmd,
                env=env,
                cwd=OPTIMIZER_PROJECT_DIR,
                startupinfo=startupinfo,
                creationflags=creationflags,
                stdout=self.log_file,
                stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
            )
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"[Worker {self.worker_id}] Error launching Webots executable: {e}", flush=True)
            return

        # Poll socket until worker is up (up to 45 seconds)
        t0 = time.time()
        connected = False
        while time.time() - t0 < 45.0:
            if self._is_stopped or (self.controller and getattr(self.controller, "abort_requested", False)):
                self.stop_process()
                return
            if self.ping():
                connected = True
                break
            time.sleep(0.3)

        if not connected and not self._is_stopped:
            print(f"[Worker {self.worker_id}] Warning: Timed out connecting to port {self.port}.", flush=True)
        elif connected:
            print(f"  [Worker {self.worker_id}] Connected and ready on Port {self.port}.", flush=True)

    def ping(self) -> bool:
        """Checks if Webots supervisor worker server is listening."""
        try:
            s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
            s.settimeout(1.0)
            s.connect(("127.0.0.1", self.port))
            req = json.dumps({"cmd": "PING"}) + "\n"
            s.sendall(req.encode("utf-8"))
            data = s.recv(1024)
            s.close()
            return b"PONG" in data
        except Exception:
            return False

    def evaluate(
        self,
        planner_name: str,
        gene_dict: Dict[str, Any],
        duration_s: float = EVALUATION_DURATION_S,
        use_track2: bool = USE_TRACK2,
    ) -> Tuple[float, Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Sends candidate genome to Webots supervisor and receives 20s run metrics."""
        fallback_metrics = {
            "distance_m": 0.0,
            "mean_speed_mps": 0.0,
            "laps_completed": 0,
            "crashed": True,
            "stalled": False,
            "aborted": True,
            "fitness": -5000.0,
        }

        if self._is_stopped or (self.controller and getattr(self.controller, "abort_requested", False)):
            return -5000.0, fallback_metrics

        for attempt in range(2):
            if self._is_stopped or (self.controller and getattr(self.controller, "abort_requested", False)):
                return -5000.0, fallback_metrics

            try:
                s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
                s.settimeout(TIMEOUT_PER_TRIAL_WALL_S)
                s.connect(("127.0.0.1", self.port))

                req = json.dumps({
                    "cmd": "EVAL",
                    "planner": planner_name,
                    "genes": gene_dict,
                    "duration_s": duration_s,
                    "use_track2": use_track2,
                }) + "\n"

                s.sendall(req.encode("utf-8"))

                # Read response until newline
                buf = ""
                while "\n" not in buf:
                    if self._is_stopped or (self.controller and getattr(self.controller, "abort_requested", False)):
                        try:
                            s.close()
                        except Exception:
                            pass
                        return -5000.0, fallback_metrics
                    chunk = s.recv(4096).decode("utf-8", errors="ignore")
                    if not chunk:
                        break
                    buf += chunk
                s.close()

                resp = json.loads(buf.strip())
                if resp.get("status") == "OK":
                    metrics = resp.get("metrics", {})
                    # Worker computes composite fitness (min across Track 1 and Track 2)
                    if "fitness" in metrics:
                        fitness = float(metrics["fitness"])
                    else:
                        fitness = compute_scalar_fitness(metrics, gene_dict=gene_dict, eval_duration_s=duration_s)
                        metrics["fitness"] = fitness
                    return fitness, metrics
                else:
                    err_msg = resp.get("error", "Unknown error from Webots worker")
                    print(f"[Worker {self.worker_id}] Webots server error response: {err_msg}", flush=True)
                    time.sleep(0.5)
                    if not self._is_stopped and not (self.controller and getattr(self.controller, "abort_requested", False)):
                        self.start_process()
            except Exception as e:
                if self._is_stopped or (self.controller and getattr(self.controller, "abort_requested", False)):
                    break
                print(f"[Worker {self.worker_id}] Attempt {attempt + 1} communication failure: {e}", flush=True)
                time.sleep(1.0)
                if not self._is_stopped and not (self.controller and getattr(self.controller, "abort_requested", False)):
                    self.start_process()

        return -5000.0, fallback_metrics

    def stop_process(self):
        """Terminates Webots process, kills child processes, and permanently marks as stopped."""
        self._is_stopped = True
        self._kill_proc()


class ParallelWorkerPool:
    """Manages pool of headless Webots workers for multi-core parallel GA evaluations."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        num_workers: int = NUM_CPU_CORES,
        base_port: int = BASE_WORKER_PORT,
        webots_bin: str = WEBOTS_BINARY,
        world_path: str = DEFAULT_WORLD_PATH,
        controller: Optional[any] = None,
    ):
        self.num_workers = num_workers
        self.controller = controller
        self.workers: List[HeadlessWebotsWorker] = []
        self._shutdown_called = False

        # Wire pool into controller immediately so abort() can shut down workers even during init
        if self.controller is not None:
            self.controller._pool = self

        if self.controller and getattr(self.controller, "abort_requested", False):
            self._shutdown_called = True
            return

        print("=" * 80, flush=True)
        print(f"  INITIALIZING PARALLEL GA WORKER POOL ({num_workers} Webots Instances in Parallel)", flush=True)
        print("=" * 80, flush=True)

        def _init_worker(w_idx: int) -> Optional[HeadlessWebotsWorker]:
            if self._shutdown_called or (self.controller and getattr(self.controller, "abort_requested", False)):
                return None
            w = HeadlessWebotsWorker(
                worker_id=w_idx,
                base_port=base_port,
                webots_bin=webots_bin,
                world_path=world_path,
                controller=self.controller,
            )
            if self._shutdown_called or (self.controller and getattr(self.controller, "abort_requested", False)):
                w.stop_process()
                return None
            return w

        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=num_workers) as executor:
            futures = [executor.submit(_init_worker, i) for i in range(num_workers)]
            for f in futures:
                if self._shutdown_called or (self.controller and getattr(self.controller, "abort_requested", False)):
                    break
                try:
                    w = f.result()
                    if w is not None:
                        self.workers.append(w)
                except Exception as e:
                    print(f"[WorkerPool Init Error] {e}", flush=True)

        if self._shutdown_called or (self.controller and getattr(self.controller, "abort_requested", False)):
            self.shutdown()

    def evaluate_population(
        self,
        planner_name: str,
        population_genomes: List[BasePlannerGenome],
        duration_s: float = EVALUATION_DURATION_S,
        controller: Optional[any] = None,
        use_track2: bool = USE_TRACK2,
    ) -> List[Tuple[float, Dict[str, Any]]]:
        """Evaluates an entire generation of candidate genomes in parallel."""
        ctrl = controller or self.controller
        if ctrl and getattr(ctrl, "abort_requested", False):
            return []
        if self._shutdown_called or not self.workers:
            return []

        results: List[Optional[Tuple[float, Dict[str, Any]]]] = [None] * len(population_genomes)

        worker_q = queue.Queue()
        for w in self.workers:
            worker_q.put(w)

        def eval_task(cand_idx: int, genome: BasePlannerGenome):
            if ctrl and getattr(ctrl, "abort_requested", False):
                return cand_idx, -5000.0, {"crashed": True, "aborted": True}
            if self._shutdown_called or not self.workers:
                return cand_idx, -5000.0, {"crashed": True, "aborted": True}
            worker = worker_q.get()
            try:
                fitness, metrics = worker.evaluate(planner_name, genome.to_dict(), duration_s, use_track2=use_track2)
                return cand_idx, fitness, metrics
            finally:
                worker_q.put(worker)

        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=len(self.workers)) as executor:
            futures = []
            for idx, genome in enumerate(population_genomes):
                if ctrl and getattr(ctrl, "abort_requested", False):
                    break
                futures.append(executor.submit(eval_task, idx, genome))

            for future in as_completed(futures):
                if ctrl and getattr(ctrl, "abort_requested", False):
                    for f in futures:
                        f.cancel()
                    break
                try:
                    cand_idx, fitness, metrics = future.result()
                    results[cand_idx] = (fitness, metrics)
                except Exception:
                    pass

        return [r for r in results if r is not None]

    def health_check(self) -> int:
        """Pings all workers in the pool; restarts any unresponsive workers. Returns healthy worker count."""
        if self._shutdown_called or not self.workers:
            return 0
        healthy = 0
        for w in self.workers:
            if w and w.ping():
                healthy += 1
            elif w and not self._shutdown_called:
                print(f"[WorkerPool HealthCheck] Worker {w.worker_id} (Port {w.port}) unresponsive. Auto-restarting...", flush=True)
                try:
                    w.start_process()
                    if w.ping():
                        healthy += 1
                except Exception as e:
                    print(f"[WorkerPool HealthCheck] Failed to restart Worker {w.worker_id}: {e}", flush=True)
        return healthy

    def shutdown(self):
        """Stops all Webots worker processes."""
        self._shutdown_called = True
        print("[ParallelWorkerPool] Shutting down all Webots instances...", flush=True)
        for w in list(self.workers):
            if w is not None:
                try:
                    w.stop_process()
                except Exception:
                    pass
        self.workers.clear()


def run_rendered_preview(
    planner_name: str,
    gene_dict: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
    duration_s: float = 20.0,
    port: int = 10299,
    controller: Optional[any] = None,
    use_track2: bool = False,
) -> Tuple[float, Dict[str, Any]]:
    """
    Executes a single rendered, real-time 20-second run of the specified planner in Webots GUI.
    Allows user to observe vehicle behavior and abort if anything is wrong.
    """
    if gene_dict is None:
        genome_cls = get_genome_class(planner_name)
        gene_dict = genome_cls().to_dict()

    if controller and (getattr(controller, "abort_requested", False) or getattr(controller, "stop_requested", False)):
        return -5000.0, {"crashed": True, "aborted": True}

    print(f"\n[Preview] Starting 20s Rendered Real-Time Preview for {planner_name} on Port {port}...", flush=True)
    worker = HeadlessWebotsWorker(
        worker_id=99,
        base_port=port,
        rendered=True,
        controller=controller,
    )

    if controller is not None:
        controller._preview_worker = worker

    try:
        if controller and (getattr(controller, "abort_requested", False) or getattr(controller, "stop_requested", False)):
            return -5000.0, {"crashed": True, "aborted": True}

        fitness, metrics = worker.evaluate(
            planner_name=planner_name,
            gene_dict=gene_dict,
            duration_s=duration_s,
            use_track2=use_track2,
        )
        return fitness, metrics
    finally:
        if controller is not None:
            controller._preview_worker = None
        worker.stop_process()

"""
================================================================================
  HIGH-THROUGHPUT PARALLEL GENETIC ALGORITHM (GA) OPTIMIZER
================================================================================
  Optimizes autonomous ToF path planner parameters in headless Webots.
  Features:
    - Multi-core parallel simulation across CPU cores (20s duration)
    - Moving obstacles traveling against robot heading at 0.50 m/s
    - Tournament selection, arithmetic crossover, Gaussian mutation, elitism
    - Real-time checkpointing (ga_checkpoint.json, ga_history.csv, best_genome.json)
================================================================================
"""

def _find_optimizer_dir(start_dir: str) -> str:
    if os.path.exists(os.path.join(start_dir, "worlds", "Cyan_Champion_GA.wbt")):
        return start_dir
    p = start_dir
    for _ in range(6):
        cand = os.path.join(p, "5_webots", "optimization", "ga_planner_optimizer")
        if os.path.exists(os.path.join(cand, "worlds", "Cyan_Champion_GA.wbt")):
            return cand
        cand2 = os.path.join(p, "optimization", "ga_planner_optimizer")
        if os.path.exists(os.path.join(cand2, "worlds", "Cyan_Champion_GA.wbt")):
            return cand2
        parent = os.path.dirname(p)
        if parent == p:
            break
        p = parent
    return start_dir
